- [ ] **Step 6: Write the runner side**

Create `desktop/windows/runner/tray.h`:

```cpp
#ifndef RUNNER_TRAY_H_
#define RUNNER_TRAY_H_

#include <flutter/binary_messenger.h>
#include <flutter/encodable_value.h>
#include <flutter/method_channel.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

// Harness in the notification area, on `harness/status_menu` (Windows only).
//
// Its menu shows what HarnessStatusMenu.swift shows: the unread rows (at most
// five), "All caught up" or "Open Harness to get started", the working rows,
// then Open Harness and Quit. Dart owns the rows and what a choice does. This
// side only presents a snapshot and hands the chosen row back.
//  - Dart -> native: `update({entries, workingEntries, workspaceAvailable})`,
//    `quit`.
//  - Native -> Dart: `selected(<row>)`, `openApp`, `hidden`.
class HarnessTray {
 public:
  HarnessTray(flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND window,
              std::function<void()> request_quit);
  ~HarnessTray();

  HarnessTray(const HarnessTray&) = delete;
  HarnessTray& operator=(const HarnessTray&) = delete;

  // The tray's own messages on the main window. True when handled.
  bool HandleMessage(UINT message, WPARAM wparam, LPARAM lparam,
                     LRESULT* result);

  // Whether the icon is in the notification area. Only then does the close
  // button hide the window instead of quitting.
  bool installed() const { return installed_; }

  // The close button just hid the window. Dart shows the one-time notice.
  void OnHidden();

 private:
  void Install();
  void Update(const flutter::EncodableMap& state);
  void ShowMenu(int x, int y);
  void ShowApp();
  void Select(const flutter::EncodableValue& row);
  std::wstring Tooltip() const;

  std::unique_ptr<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>> channel_;
  HWND window_;
  std::function<void()> request_quit_;
  UINT taskbar_created_;
  HICON icon_ = nullptr;
  bool installed_ = false;
  bool workspace_available_ = false;
  flutter::EncodableList entries_;
  flutter::EncodableList working_;
};

#endif  // RUNNER_TRAY_H_
```

Create `desktop/windows/runner/tray.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "tray.h"

#include <flutter/standard_method_codec.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <windowsx.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

#include "resource.h"
#include "single_instance.h"
#include "utils.h"

namespace {

constexpr UINT kTrayCallbackMessage = WM_APP + 0x52;
constexpr UINT kTrayIconId = 1;
constexpr UINT kEntryCommand = 1000;
constexpr UINT kWorkingCommand = 2000;
constexpr UINT kOpenCommand = 3001;
constexpr UINT kQuitCommand = 3002;
constexpr size_t kMaxEntries = 5;
constexpr size_t kMaxWorking = 10;

const flutter::EncodableValue* Field(const flutter::EncodableMap& map,
                                     const char* key) {
  auto entry = map.find(flutter::EncodableValue(key));
  return entry == map.end() ? nullptr : &entry->second;
}

std::string StringField(const flutter::EncodableMap& map, const char* key) {
  const auto* value = Field(map, key);
  const auto* text = value == nullptr ? nullptr : std::get_if<std::string>(value);
  return text == nullptr ? std::string() : *text;
}

bool BoolField(const flutter::EncodableMap& map, const char* key) {
  const auto* value = Field(map, key);
  const auto* flag = value == nullptr ? nullptr : std::get_if<bool>(value);
  return flag != nullptr && *flag;
}

// Milliseconds since the epoch. Dart sends a small int as int32 and a large
// one as int64.
int64_t TimeField(const flutter::EncodableMap& map, const char* key) {
  const auto* value = Field(map, key);
  if (value == nullptr) {
    return 0;
  }
  if (const auto* wide = std::get_if<int64_t>(value)) {
    return *wide;
  }
  if (const auto* narrow = std::get_if<int32_t>(value)) {
    return *narrow;
  }
  return 0;
}

const flutter::EncodableList* ListField(const flutter::EncodableMap& map,
                                        const char* key) {
  const auto* value = Field(map, key);
  return value == nullptr ? nullptr : std::get_if<flutter::EncodableList>(value);
}

// "now", "42s", "5m", "3h", "2d": HarnessStatusMenuRow.refreshTime's labels.
std::wstring Age(int64_t stamp_ms, bool unread) {
  if (stamp_ms <= 0) {
    return std::wstring();
  }
  FILETIME file_time;
  ::GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&file_time);
  ULARGE_INTEGER now;
  now.LowPart = file_time.dwLowDateTime;
  now.HighPart = file_time.dwHighDateTime;
  // FILETIME counts 100 ns from 1601; the Unix epoch is 11644473600 s later.
  const int64_t now_ms =
      static_cast<int64_t>(now.QuadPart / 10000ULL) - 11644473600000LL;
  const int64_t age = std::max<int64_t>(0, (now_ms - stamp_ms) / 1000);
  if (age < 60) {
    return unread ? std::wstring(L"now") : std::to_wstring(age) + L"s";
  }
  if (age < 3600) {
    return std::to_wstring(age / 60) + L"m";
  }
  if (age < 86400) {
    return std::to_wstring(age / 3600) + L"h";
  }
  return std::to_wstring(age / 86400) + L"d";
}

// One line, at most 60 characters, with no `&` read as a mnemonic.
std::wstring MenuText(const std::string& utf8) {
  std::wstring text = Utf16FromUtf8(utf8);
  for (auto& c : text) {
    if (c == L'\r' || c == L'\n' || c == L'\t') {
      c = L' ';
    }
  }
  if (text.size() > 60) {
    size_t cut = 59;
    // Never split a surrogate pair.
    if (text[cut - 1] >= 0xD800 && text[cut - 1] <= 0xDBFF) {
      cut--;
    }
    text = text.substr(0, cut) + L"…";
  }
  std::wstring escaped;
  escaped.reserve(text.size());
  for (wchar_t c : text) {
    if (c == L'&') {
      escaped += L'&';
    }
    escaped += c;
  }
  return escaped;
}

void AppendRow(HMENU menu, UINT_PTR command, const flutter::EncodableValue& row,
               bool unread) {
  const auto* entry = std::get_if<flutter::EncodableMap>(&row);
  if (entry == nullptr) {
    return;
  }
  std::string title = StringField(*entry, "title");
  if (title.empty()) {
    title = "Unavailable harness";
  }
  std::wstring label = MenuText(title);
  const std::wstring age =
      Age(TimeField(*entry, unread ? "receivedAt" : "startedAt"), unread);
  if (!age.empty()) {
    label += L"\t" + age;
  }
  const auto* unavailable = Field(*entry, "unavailable");
  const bool greyed =
      unavailable != nullptr && std::get_if<std::string>(unavailable) != nullptr;
  const UINT flags = greyed ? (MF_STRING | MF_GRAYED) : MF_STRING;
  ::AppendMenuW(menu, flags, command, label.c_str());
}

void AppendHeading(HMENU menu, const std::wstring& text) {
  ::AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING | MF_GRAYED, 0, text.c_str());
}

}  // namespace

HarnessTray::HarnessTray(flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND window,
                         std::function<void()> request_quit)
    : window_(window),
      request_quit_(std::move(request_quit)),
      taskbar_created_(::RegisterWindowMessageW(L"TaskbarCreated")) {
  icon_ = static_cast<HICON>(::LoadImageW(
      ::GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP_ICON), IMAGE_ICON,
      ::GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON), ::GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON),
      LR_DEFAULTCOLOR));
  channel_ = std::make_unique<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>>(
      messenger, "harness/status_menu",
      &flutter::StandardMethodCodec::GetInstance());
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler([this](const auto& call, auto result) {
    if (call.method_name() == "update") {
      if (const auto* state =
              std::get_if<flutter::EncodableMap>(call.arguments())) {
        Update(*state);
      }
      result->Success();
      return;
    }
    if (call.method_name() == "quit") {
      result->Success();
      if (request_quit_) {
        request_quit_();
      }
      return;
    }
    result->NotImplemented();
  });
  Install();
}

HarnessTray::~HarnessTray() {
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler(nullptr);
  if (installed_) {
    NOTIFYICONDATAW data = {};
    data.cbSize = sizeof(data);
    data.hWnd = window_;
    data.uID = kTrayIconId;
    ::Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &data);
  }
  if (icon_ != nullptr) {
    ::DestroyIcon(icon_);
  }
}

std::wstring HarnessTray::Tooltip() const {
  return workspace_available_
             ? L"Harness · " + std::to_wstring(entries_.size()) + L" unread"
             : std::wstring(L"Harness");
}

void HarnessTray::Install() {
  NOTIFYICONDATAW data = {};
  data.cbSize = sizeof(data);
  data.hWnd = window_;
  data.uID = kTrayIconId;
  data.uFlags = NIF_ICON | NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_TIP | NIF_SHOWTIP;
  data.uCallbackMessage = kTrayCallbackMessage;
  data.hIcon = icon_;
  wcsncpy_s(data.szTip, Tooltip().c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
  installed_ = ::Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, &data) != FALSE;
  if (installed_) {
    data.uVersion = NOTIFYICON_VERSION_4;
    ::Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_SETVERSION, &data);
  }
}

void HarnessTray::Update(const flutter::EncodableMap& state) {
  workspace_available_ = BoolField(state, "workspaceAvailable");
  entries_.clear();
  if (const auto* rows = ListField(state, "entries")) {
    for (const auto& row : *rows) {
      const auto* entry = std::get_if<flutter::EncodableMap>(&row);
      if (entry != nullptr && BoolField(*entry, "unread")) {
        entries_.push_back(row);
      }
    }
  }
  working_.clear();
  if (workspace_available_) {
    if (const auto* rows = ListField(state, "workingEntries")) {
      working_ = *rows;
    }
  }
  if (installed_) {
    NOTIFYICONDATAW data = {};
    data.cbSize = sizeof(data);
    data.hWnd = window_;
    data.uID = kTrayIconId;
    data.uFlags = NIF_TIP | NIF_SHOWTIP;
    wcsncpy_s(data.szTip, Tooltip().c_str(), _TRUNCATE);
    ::Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &data);
  }
}

bool HarnessTray::HandleMessage(UINT message, WPARAM wparam, LPARAM lparam,
                                LRESULT* result) {
  if (taskbar_created_ != 0 && message == taskbar_created_) {
    // Explorer restarted and forgot every icon.
    installed_ = false;
    Install();
    *result = 0;
    return true;
  }
  if (message != kTrayCallbackMessage) {
    return false;
  }
  switch (LOWORD(lparam)) {
    case NIN_SELECT:
    case NIN_KEYSELECT:
      ShowApp();
      break;
    case WM_CONTEXTMENU:
      ShowMenu(GET_X_LPARAM(wparam), GET_Y_LPARAM(wparam));
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
  *result = 0;
  return true;
}

void HarnessTray::ShowMenu(int x, int y) {
  // The rows as they are now. A choice answers with this snapshot's row, and
  // Dart checks that it is still current (statusMenuReceiptIsCurrent).
  const flutter::EncodableList entries = entries_;
  const flutter::EncodableList working = working_;
  HMENU menu = ::CreatePopupMenu();
  if (menu == nullptr) {
    return;
  }
  if (entries.empty()) {
    AppendHeading(menu, workspace_available_ ? L"All caught up"
                                             : L"Open Harness to get started");
  } else {
    AppendHeading(menu, L"Ready (" + std::to_wstring(entries.size()) + L")");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < entries.size() && i < kMaxEntries; i++) {
      AppendRow(menu, static_cast<UINT_PTR>(kEntryCommand + i), entries[i], true);
    }
    if (entries.size() > kMaxEntries) {
      AppendHeading(menu, std::to_wstring(entries.size() - kMaxEntries) + L" more");
    }
  }
  if (workspace_available_ && !working.empty()) {
    ::AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
    AppendHeading(menu, L"Working (" + std::to_wstring(working.size()) + L")");
    for (size_t i = 0; i < working.size() && i < kMaxWorking; i++) {
      AppendRow(menu, static_cast<UINT_PTR>(kWorkingCommand + i), working[i],
                false);
    }
  }
  ::AppendMenuW(menu, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, nullptr);
  ::AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, kOpenCommand, L"Open Harness");
  ::AppendMenuW(menu, MF_STRING, kQuitCommand, L"Quit");
  ::SetMenuDefaultItem(menu, kOpenCommand, FALSE);
  // A tray menu closes on a click elsewhere only if its owner is in front.
  ::SetForegroundWindow(window_);
  const UINT align = ::GetSystemMetrics(SM_MENUDROPALIGNMENT) != 0
                         ? TPM_RIGHTALIGN
                         : TPM_LEFTALIGN;
  const UINT command = static_cast<UINT>(::TrackPopupMenuEx(
      menu, TPM_RETURNCMD | TPM_NONOTIFY | TPM_RIGHTBUTTON | TPM_BOTTOMALIGN |
                align,
      x, y, window_, nullptr));
  ::PostMessageW(window_, WM_NULL, 0, 0);
  ::DestroyMenu(menu);
  if (command == kOpenCommand) {
    ShowApp();
  } else if (command == kQuitCommand) {
    if (request_quit_) {
      request_quit_();
    }
  } else if (command >= kEntryCommand &&
             static_cast<size_t>(command - kEntryCommand) < entries.size()) {
    Select(entries[command - kEntryCommand]);
  } else if (command >= kWorkingCommand &&
             static_cast<size_t>(command - kWorkingCommand) < working.size()) {
    Select(working[command - kWorkingCommand]);
  }
}

void HarnessTray::ShowApp() {
  HarnessSingleInstance::BringToFront(window_);
  channel_->InvokeMethod("openApp", nullptr);
}

void HarnessTray::Select(const flutter::EncodableValue& row) {
  // Dart opens the destination, then reveals the window: activating the tab
  // shown before cannot acknowledge the wrong notification.
  channel_->InvokeMethod("selected",
                         std::make_unique<flutter::EncodableValue>(row));
}

void HarnessTray::OnHidden() {
  channel_->InvokeMethod("hidden", nullptr);
}
```

### Task C3.5: Clipboard image, copied files and fonts

**Files:**
- Create: `desktop/windows/runner/clipboard_image.h`, `desktop/windows/runner/clipboard_image.cpp`,
  `desktop/windows/runner/fonts.h`, `desktop/windows/runner/fonts.cpp`
- Modify:
  - `desktop/windows/runner/flutter_window.h`, `desktop/windows/runner/flutter_window.cpp`
  - `desktop/windows/runner/CMakeLists.txt`
  - `desktop/lib/clipboard/native_clipboard.dart`
  - `desktop/lib/terminal/installed_fonts.dart`
- Test: `desktop/test/windows_clipboard_fonts_test.dart` (create), `desktop/test/windows_runner_contract_test.dart`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the method names Dart already calls.
- Produces, on `harness/clipboard_image` (the names `MainFlutterWindow.swift` and `my_application.cc` answer):
  - `readImagePng` → PNG bytes or null. It reads the registered `PNG` (or `image/png`) format as is. Otherwise a 24- or
    32-bit `CF_DIBV5`/`CF_DIB` is encoded to PNG with WIC, and any other bitmap goes through `CF_BITMAP` and WIC.
  - `writeImagePng(bytes)` → bool. It puts the PNG back as `PNG` plus a 32-bit `CF_DIBV5`. This is the local half of
    image drag-drop (`_dropImage` in `pane_grid.dart`), which macOS and Linux also answer.
  - `readFilePaths` → `List<String>`, the paths of a `CF_HDROP`.
- Produces, on `harness/fonts`: `listFonts` → `[{family, mono}]`, the macOS shape. It comes from `EnumFontFamiliesExW`,
  de-duplicated by family and sorted (ordinal).
  - A face is monospaced by `lfPitchAndFamily & FIXED_PITCH`.
  - A symbol-charset family is never monospaced, as on macOS.
  - Bitmap (`.fon`) faces, which Flutter cannot draw, and vertical `@` faces are left out.
- These are the method names Dart and both other runners already use; the channel's names do not change.
- Produces, Dart: `@visibleForTesting static bool NativeClipboard.runnerAnswers(String operatingSystem)` and

```cpp
#ifndef RUNNER_CLIPBOARD_IMAGE_H_
#define RUNNER_CLIPBOARD_IMAGE_H_

#include <flutter/binary_messenger.h>
#include <flutter/encodable_value.h>
#include <flutter/method_channel.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include <memory>

// The clipboard's picture and its copied files, on `harness/clipboard_image`:
// the calls MainFlutterWindow.swift and my_application.cc answer. Flutter's
// own Clipboard only sees text.
//  - `readImagePng`: the picture as PNG bytes, or null. The registered `PNG`
//    format as it was put there, else a DIB encoded with WIC.
//  - `writeImagePng(bytes)`: the picture back as `PNG` and CF_DIBV5. This is
//    the local half of image drag-drop.
//  - `readFilePaths`: the paths of a CF_HDROP (files copied in Explorer).
class HarnessClipboardImage {
 public:
  HarnessClipboardImage(flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND owner);
  ~HarnessClipboardImage();

  HarnessClipboardImage(const HarnessClipboardImage&) = delete;
  HarnessClipboardImage& operator=(const HarnessClipboardImage&) = delete;

 private:
  std::unique_ptr<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>> channel_;
  HWND owner_;
};

#endif  // RUNNER_CLIPBOARD_IMAGE_H_
```

Create `desktop/windows/runner/clipboard_image.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "clipboard_image.h"

#include <flutter/standard_method_codec.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <wincodec.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "utils.h"

namespace {

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
using Bytes = std::vector<uint8_t>;

// The largest picture taken from, or put on, the clipboard: 8192 x 8192.
constexpr uint64_t kMaxPixels = 8192ull * 8192ull;

constexpr uint8_t kPngSignature[] = {0x89, 'P', 'N', 'G', 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A};

// OpenClipboard fails while another program holds it, so ask a few times.
class ClipboardLock {
 public:
  explicit ClipboardLock(HWND owner) {
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 5 && !open_; attempt++) {
      open_ = ::OpenClipboard(owner) != FALSE;
      if (!open_) {
        ::Sleep(10);
      }
    }
  }
  ~ClipboardLock() {
    if (open_) {
      ::CloseClipboard();
    }
  }
  bool open() const { return open_; }

 private:
  bool open_ = false;
};

// A clipboard handle's memory, locked for the scope.
class GlobalView {
 public:
  explicit GlobalView(HANDLE handle)
      : handle_(handle),
        data_(handle == nullptr ? nullptr : ::GlobalLock(handle)),
        size_(handle == nullptr ? 0 : ::GlobalSize(handle)) {}
  ~GlobalView() {
    if (data_ != nullptr) {
      ::GlobalUnlock(handle_);
    }
  }
  const uint8_t* data() const { return static_cast<const uint8_t*>(data_); }
  size_t size() const { return data_ == nullptr ? 0 : size_; }

 private:
  HANDLE handle_;
  void* data_;
  size_t size_;
};

ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> Factory() {
  ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory;
  ::CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                     IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory));
  return factory;
}

// A PNG's own length. A clipboard block can be longer than what was put in it.
size_t PngLength(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
  size_t offset = sizeof(kPngSignature);
  while (offset + 12 <= size) {
    const size_t length = (size_t{data[offset]} << 24) |
                          (size_t{data[offset + 1]} << 16) |
                          (size_t{data[offset + 2]} << 8) | data[offset + 3];
    if (length > size - offset - 12) {
      return size;
    }
    const bool end = std::memcmp(data + offset + 4, "IEND", 4) == 0;
    offset += 12 + length;
    if (end) {
      return offset;
    }
  }
  return size;
}

std::optional<Bytes> EncodePng(IWICImagingFactory* factory,
                               IWICBitmapSource* source) {
  ComPtr<IWICFormatConverter> converter;
  ComPtr<IStream> stream;
  ComPtr<IWICBitmapEncoder> encoder;
  ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameEncode> frame;
  UINT width = 0;
  UINT height = 0;
  WICPixelFormatGUID format = GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA;
  if (FAILED(factory->CreateFormatConverter(&converter)) ||
      FAILED(converter->Initialize(source, GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA,
                                   WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0.0,
                                   WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom)) ||
      FAILED(converter->GetSize(&width, &height)) ||
      FAILED(::CreateStreamOnHGlobal(nullptr, TRUE, &stream)) ||
      FAILED(factory->CreateEncoder(GUID_ContainerFormatPng, nullptr,
                                    &encoder)) ||
      FAILED(encoder->Initialize(stream.Get(), WICBitmapEncoderNoCache)) ||
      FAILED(encoder->CreateNewFrame(&frame, nullptr)) ||
      FAILED(frame->Initialize(nullptr)) ||
      FAILED(frame->SetSize(width, height)) ||
      FAILED(frame->SetPixelFormat(&format)) ||
      FAILED(frame->WriteSource(converter.Get(), nullptr)) ||
      FAILED(frame->Commit()) || FAILED(encoder->Commit())) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  STATSTG stat = {};
  if (FAILED(stream->Stat(&stat, STATFLAG_NONAME)) ||
      stat.cbSize.QuadPart > 512ull * 1024 * 1024) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  Bytes png(static_cast<size_t>(stat.cbSize.QuadPart));
  LARGE_INTEGER start = {};
  ULONG read = 0;
  if (FAILED(stream->Seek(start, STREAM_SEEK_SET, nullptr)) ||
      FAILED(stream->Read(png.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(png.size()), &read)) ||
      read != png.size()) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  return png;
}

// A 24- or 32-bit DIB (CF_DIB, CF_DIBV5) as PNG. Other depths, compressions
// and channel orders answer nullopt, and the caller tries CF_BITMAP instead.
std::optional<Bytes> PngFromDib(IWICImagingFactory* factory,
                                const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
  if (data == nullptr || size < sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER)) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  BITMAPINFOHEADER header;
  std::memcpy(&header, data, sizeof(header));
  if (header.biSize < sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER) || header.biSize > size ||
      header.biWidth <= 0 || header.biHeight == 0 || header.biPlanes != 1) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  const bool bits32 = header.biBitCount == 32;
  const bool plain24 = header.biBitCount == 24 && header.biCompression == BI_RGB;
  const bool plain32 = bits32 && (header.biCompression == BI_RGB ||
                                  header.biCompression == BI_BITFIELDS);
  if (!plain24 && !plain32) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  size_t offset = header.biSize;
  if (header.biCompression == BI_BITFIELDS) {
    DWORD masks[3] = {};
    if (header.biSize >= sizeof(BITMAPV4HEADER)) {
      std::memcpy(masks, data + offsetof(BITMAPV4HEADER, bV4RedMask),
                  sizeof(masks));
    } else {
      if (offset + sizeof(masks) > size) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }
      std::memcpy(masks, data + offset, sizeof(masks));
      offset += sizeof(masks);
    }
    if (masks[0] != 0x00FF0000 || masks[1] != 0x0000FF00 ||
        masks[2] != 0x000000FF) {
      return std::nullopt;
    }
  }
  offset += static_cast<size_t>(header.biClrUsed) * sizeof(RGBQUAD);
  const bool bottom_up = header.biHeight > 0;
  const uint64_t width = static_cast<uint64_t>(header.biWidth);
  const uint64_t height = static_cast<uint64_t>(
      bottom_up ? static_cast<int64_t>(header.biHeight)
                : -static_cast<int64_t>(header.biHeight));
  if (width * height > kMaxPixels) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  const uint64_t stride = ((width * header.biBitCount + 31) / 32) * 4;
  if (offset + stride * height > size) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  const size_t columns = static_cast<size_t>(width);
  const size_t rows = static_cast<size_t>(height);
  const size_t pixel_size = bits32 ? 4 : 3;
  Bytes pixels(columns * rows * 4);
  bool any_alpha = false;
  for (size_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    const uint8_t* row = data + offset +
                         static_cast<size_t>(stride) *
                             (bottom_up ? rows - 1 - y : y);
    uint8_t* out = pixels.data() + y * columns * 4;
    for (size_t x = 0; x < columns; x++) {
      const uint8_t* in = row + x * pixel_size;
      out[x * 4 + 0] = in[0];
      out[x * 4 + 1] = in[1];
      out[x * 4 + 2] = in[2];
      out[x * 4 + 3] = bits32 ? in[3] : 0xFF;
      any_alpha = any_alpha || (bits32 && in[3] != 0);
    }
  }
  // A 32-bit DIB whose every alpha is 0 is an opaque picture whose fourth
  // byte is padding.
  if (bits32 && !any_alpha) {
    for (size_t i = 3; i < pixels.size(); i += 4) {
      pixels[i] = 0xFF;
    }
  }
  ComPtr<IWICBitmap> bitmap;
  if (FAILED(factory->CreateBitmapFromMemory(
          static_cast<UINT>(columns), static_cast<UINT>(rows),
          GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA, static_cast<UINT>(columns * 4),
          static_cast<UINT>(pixels.size()), pixels.data(), &bitmap))) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }
  return EncodePng(factory, bitmap.Get());
}

flutter::EncodableValue ReadImagePng(HWND owner) {
  ClipboardLock lock(owner);
  if (!lock.open()) {
    return flutter::EncodableValue();
  }
  // The picture as its program encoded it: browsers put PNG beside the bitmap.
  for (const wchar_t* name : {L"PNG", L"image/png"}) {
    const UINT format = ::RegisterClipboardFormatW(name);
    if (format == 0 || !::IsClipboardFormatAvailable(format)) {
      continue;
    }
    GlobalView view(::GetClipboardData(format));
    if (view.size() > sizeof(kPngSignature) &&
        std::memcmp(view.data(), kPngSignature, sizeof(kPngSignature)) == 0) {
      const size_t length = PngLength(view.data(), view.size());
      return flutter::EncodableValue(Bytes(view.data(), view.data() + length));
    }
  }
  ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory = Factory();
  if (!factory) {
    return flutter::EncodableValue();
  }
  const UINT dib_formats[] = {CF_DIBV5, CF_DIB};
  for (const UINT format : dib_formats) {
    if (!::IsClipboardFormatAvailable(format)) {
      continue;
    }
    GlobalView view(::GetClipboardData(format));
    if (auto png = PngFromDib(factory.Get(), view.data(), view.size())) {
      return flutter::EncodableValue(std::move(*png));
    }
  }
  if (::IsClipboardFormatAvailable(CF_BITMAP)) {
    auto bitmap = static_cast<HBITMAP>(::GetClipboardData(CF_BITMAP));
    ComPtr<IWICBitmap> source;
    if (bitmap != nullptr &&
        SUCCEEDED(factory->CreateBitmapFromHBITMAP(
            bitmap, nullptr, WICBitmapIgnoreAlpha, &source))) {
      if (auto png = EncodePng(factory.Get(), source.Get())) {
        return flutter::EncodableValue(std::move(*png));
      }
    }
  }
  // No picture (the normal case for a text paste): Dart pastes the text.
  return flutter::EncodableValue();
}

bool WriteImagePng(HWND owner, const Bytes& png) {
  ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> factory = Factory();
  if (!factory || png.size() < sizeof(kPngSignature)) {
    return false;
  }
  ComPtr<IWICStream> stream;
  ComPtr<IWICBitmapDecoder> decoder;
  ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameDecode> frame;
  ComPtr<IWICFormatConverter> converter;
  UINT width = 0;
  UINT height = 0;
  if (FAILED(factory->CreateStream(&stream)) ||
      FAILED(stream->InitializeFromMemory(const_cast<BYTE*>(png.data()),
                                          static_cast<DWORD>(png.size()))) ||
      FAILED(factory->CreateDecoderFromStream(
          stream.Get(), nullptr, WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnDemand, &decoder)) ||
      FAILED(decoder->GetFrame(0, &frame)) ||
      FAILED(factory->CreateFormatConverter(&converter)) ||
      FAILED(converter->Initialize(frame.Get(), GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA,
                                   WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0.0,
                                   WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom)) ||
      FAILED(converter->GetSize(&width, &height)) || width == 0 ||
      height == 0 || static_cast<uint64_t>(width) * height > kMaxPixels) {
    return false;
  }
  const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(width) * 4;
  const size_t rows = height;
  const size_t pixel_bytes = stride * rows;
  Bytes top_down(pixel_bytes);
  if (FAILED(converter->CopyPixels(nullptr, static_cast<UINT>(stride),
                                   static_cast<UINT>(pixel_bytes),
                                   top_down.data()))) {
    return false;
  }
  HGLOBAL dib =
      ::GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, sizeof(BITMAPV5HEADER) + pixel_bytes);
  HGLOBAL encoded = ::GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, png.size());
  auto* dib_bytes =
      dib == nullptr ? nullptr : static_cast<uint8_t*>(::GlobalLock(dib));
  auto* png_bytes = encoded == nullptr
                        ? nullptr
                        : static_cast<uint8_t*>(::GlobalLock(encoded));
  if (dib_bytes == nullptr || png_bytes == nullptr) {
    if (dib_bytes != nullptr) ::GlobalUnlock(dib);
    if (png_bytes != nullptr) ::GlobalUnlock(encoded);
    if (dib != nullptr) ::GlobalFree(dib);
    if (encoded != nullptr) ::GlobalFree(encoded);
    return false;
  }
  BITMAPV5HEADER header = {};
  header.bV5Size = sizeof(header);
  header.bV5Width = static_cast<LONG>(width);
  // Bottom-up, as every reader of CF_DIBV5 expects.
  header.bV5Height = static_cast<LONG>(height);
  header.bV5Planes = 1;
  header.bV5BitCount = 32;
  header.bV5Compression = BI_BITFIELDS;
  header.bV5SizeImage = static_cast<DWORD>(pixel_bytes);
  header.bV5RedMask = 0x00FF0000;
  header.bV5GreenMask = 0x0000FF00;
  header.bV5BlueMask = 0x000000FF;
  header.bV5AlphaMask = 0xFF000000;
  header.bV5CSType = LCS_sRGB;
  header.bV5Intent = LCS_GM_IMAGES;
  std::memcpy(dib_bytes, &header, sizeof(header));
  for (size_t y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    std::memcpy(dib_bytes + sizeof(header) + (rows - 1 - y) * stride,
                top_down.data() + y * stride, stride);
  }
  std::memcpy(png_bytes, png.data(), png.size());
  ::GlobalUnlock(dib);
  ::GlobalUnlock(encoded);
  ClipboardLock lock(owner);
  if (!lock.open() || !::EmptyClipboard()) {
    ::GlobalFree(dib);
    ::GlobalFree(encoded);
    return false;
  }
  // The clipboard owns each handle it accepts.
  if (::SetClipboardData(::RegisterClipboardFormatW(L"PNG"), encoded) ==
      nullptr) {
    ::GlobalFree(encoded);
  }
  if (::SetClipboardData(CF_DIBV5, dib) == nullptr) {
    ::GlobalFree(dib);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

flutter::EncodableValue ReadFilePaths(HWND owner) {
  flutter::EncodableList paths;
  ClipboardLock lock(owner);
  if (lock.open() && ::IsClipboardFormatAvailable(CF_HDROP)) {
    auto drop = static_cast<HDROP>(::GetClipboardData(CF_HDROP));
    if (drop != nullptr) {
      const UINT count = ::DragQueryFileW(drop, 0xFFFFFFFF, nullptr, 0);
      for (UINT i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const UINT length = ::DragQueryFileW(drop, i, nullptr, 0);
        if (length == 0) {
          continue;
        }
        std::wstring path(static_cast<size_t>(length) + 1, L'\0');
        ::DragQueryFileW(drop, i, path.data(), length + 1);
        path.resize(length);
        paths.emplace_back(Utf8FromUtf16(path.c_str()));
      }
    }
  }
  return flutter::EncodableValue(std::move(paths));
}

}  // namespace

HarnessClipboardImage::HarnessClipboardImage(
    flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND owner)
    : owner_(owner) {
  channel_ = std::make_unique<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>>(
      messenger, "harness/clipboard_image",
      &flutter::StandardMethodCodec::GetInstance());
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler([this](const auto& call, auto result) {
    const std::string& method = call.method_name();
    if (method == "readImagePng") {
      result->Success(ReadImagePng(owner_));
      return;
    }
    if (method == "readFilePaths") {
      result->Success(ReadFilePaths(owner_));
      return;
    }
    if (method == "writeImagePng") {
      const auto* bytes = std::get_if<Bytes>(call.arguments());
      if (bytes == nullptr) {
        result->Error("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "expected PNG bytes");
        return;
      }
      result->Success(flutter::EncodableValue(WriteImagePng(owner_, *bytes)));
      return;
    }
    result->NotImplemented();
  });
}

HarnessClipboardImage::~HarnessClipboardImage() {
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler(nullptr);
}
```

Create `desktop/windows/runner/fonts.h`:

```cpp
#ifndef RUNNER_FONTS_H_
#define RUNNER_FONTS_H_

#include <flutter/binary_messenger.h>
#include <flutter/encodable_value.h>
#include <flutter/method_channel.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include <memory>

// The installed font families, for the terminal's font picker, on
// `harness/fonts`: `listFonts` answers `[{family, mono}]`, as
// MainFlutterWindow.swift does. The families are enumerated on a worker
// thread, and the answer is posted back to the window, so the platform thread
// never waits for a large font catalogue.
class HarnessFonts {
 public:
  HarnessFonts(flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND window);
  ~HarnessFonts();

  HarnessFonts(const HarnessFonts&) = delete;
  HarnessFonts& operator=(const HarnessFonts&) = delete;

  // The worker's answer, arriving on the platform thread. True when handled.
  bool HandleMessage(UINT message, LPARAM lparam);

 private:
  std::unique_ptr<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>> channel_;
  HWND window_;
};

#endif  // RUNNER_FONTS_H_
```

Create `desktop/windows/runner/fonts.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "fonts.h"

#include <flutter/standard_method_codec.h>

#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <thread>

#include "utils.h"

namespace {

constexpr UINT kFontsReadyMessage = WM_APP + 0x53;

struct Family {
  bool mono = false;
  bool symbol = false;
};

using Families = std::map<std::wstring, Family>;

struct FontsAnswer {
  std::unique_ptr<flutter::MethodResult<flutter::EncodableValue>> result;
  Families families;
};

int CALLBACK AddFamily(const LOGFONTW* font, const TEXTMETRICW*, DWORD type,
                       LPARAM param) {
  // Bitmap (.fon) faces cannot be drawn by Flutter's text engine. `@` faces
  // are the same family turned for vertical CJK, and `.` names are hidden.
  const wchar_t first = font->lfFaceName[0];
  if ((type & RASTER_FONTTYPE) != 0 || first == L'\0' || first == L'@' ||
      first == L'.') {
    return 1;
  }
  Family& family = (*reinterpret_cast<Families*>(param))[font->lfFaceName];
  // A symbol font (Wingdings and the like) is never monospaced: its letters
  // are pictures.
  family.symbol = family.symbol || font->lfCharSet == SYMBOL_CHARSET;
  family.mono = family.mono || (font->lfPitchAndFamily & 0x3) == FIXED_PITCH;
  return 1;
}

Families InstalledFamilies() {
  Families families;
  HDC dc = ::GetDC(nullptr);
  if (dc == nullptr) {
    return families;
  }
  LOGFONTW query = {};
  query.lfCharSet = DEFAULT_CHARSET;
  ::EnumFontFamiliesExW(dc, &query, AddFamily,
                        reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(&families), 0);
  ::ReleaseDC(nullptr, dc);
  return families;
}

flutter::EncodableValue Encode(const Families& families) {
  flutter::EncodableList list;
  for (const auto& [name, family] : families) {
    list.emplace_back(flutter::EncodableMap{
        {flutter::EncodableValue("family"),
         flutter::EncodableValue(Utf8FromUtf16(name.c_str()))},
        {flutter::EncodableValue("mono"),
         flutter::EncodableValue(family.mono && !family.symbol)},
    });
  }
  return flutter::EncodableValue(std::move(list));
}

}  // namespace

HarnessFonts::HarnessFonts(flutter::BinaryMessenger* messenger, HWND window)
    : window_(window) {
  channel_ = std::make_unique<flutter::MethodChannel<flutter::EncodableValue>>(
      messenger, "harness/fonts", &flutter::StandardMethodCodec::GetInstance());
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler([this](const auto& call, auto result) {
    if (call.method_name() != "listFonts") {
      result->NotImplemented();
      return;
    }
    auto* answer = new FontsAnswer{std::move(result), {}};
    HWND window = window_;
    std::thread([window, answer]() {
      answer->families = InstalledFamilies();
      if (!::PostMessageW(window, kFontsReadyMessage, 0,
                          reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(answer))) {
        // The window is gone, and nobody is left to answer.
        delete answer;
      }
    }).detach();
  });
}

HarnessFonts::~HarnessFonts() {
  channel_->SetMethodCallHandler(nullptr);
}

bool HarnessFonts::HandleMessage(UINT message, LPARAM lparam) {
  if (message != kFontsReadyMessage) {
    return false;
  }
  std::unique_ptr<FontsAnswer> answer(reinterpret_cast<FontsAnswer*>(lparam));
  answer->result->Success(Encode(answer->families));
  return true;
}
```

**Windows keys.** A plain Ctrl+letter is always answered by some terminal program on Windows:
- readline: ^A ^E ^K ^U ^W ^Y ^R ^L;
- PSReadLine: ^C ^V ^Z ^Y ^L ^R;
- Claude Code: ^T ^O ^B ^G;
- Codex: ^T ^J.

By the spec's rule (§2.8, "a chord a terminal program answers is never taken"), no plain Ctrl+letter is free. So Windows
uses Ctrl like this:
- A letter takes **Ctrl+Shift**, as Windows Terminal's own commands do. A legacy terminal cannot tell Ctrl+Shift+X from
  Ctrl+X, so taking it costs the program nothing.
- Only keys no terminal program answers with Ctrl take **plain Ctrl**: the tab digits 1–9 and Settings' comma.
- Where that would put two commands on one chord, the Mac's shifted twin moves to **Alt+Shift**, Linux's own second rung.
- Ctrl-arrows are PowerShell's word motions, so the ⌘-arrows move to **Alt** and **Alt+Shift**, Windows Terminal's pane
  keys.
- ⌥⌘-arrows (tabs) become **Ctrl+Page Down/Up**, as in every Windows browser.
- ⌘⏎ (zoom) becomes **Ctrl+Shift+Z**, tmux's `prefix z`, as Linux's Alt+Z. Ctrl+Enter is PowerShell's "insert line
  above".

The terminal keeps:
- every plain Ctrl+letter, including the spec's Ctrl-C/D/Z/R/W/U/L/A;
- Ctrl-arrows, Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+/ (undo), Ctrl+[ (Esc);
- Ctrl+Shift+C (Copy), Ctrl+Shift+V (Paste) and Ctrl+Shift+A (Select all), as in Windows Terminal;
- Alt+Enter (the engine prompt's newline) and Alt+Backspace (delete the previous word).

A browser on Windows keeps today's behaviour. Every Windows branch checks `!kIsWeb`.

The full Windows binding table (the workspace, default keymap):

| Command | macOS | Windows |
|---|---|---|
| Find in terminal | ⌘F | Ctrl+Shift+F |
| Next match | ⌘G | Ctrl+Shift+G |
| Previous match | ⇧⌘G | Alt+Shift+G |
| Focus pane left / down / up / right | ⌘H ⌘J ⌘K ⌘L | Ctrl+Shift+H / J / K / L |
| Focus pane by arrow | ⌘← ↓ ↑ → | Alt+← ↓ ↑ → |
| Move pane by arrow | ⇧⌘← ↓ ↑ → | Alt+Shift+← ↓ ↑ → |
| Move pane to another tab | ⇧⌘M | Alt+Shift+M |
| Zoom pane | ⌘⏎ | Ctrl+Shift+Z |
| Choose layout | ⇧⌘L | Alt+Shift+L |
| Back / Forward | ⌘[ / ⌘] | Ctrl+Shift+[ / Ctrl+Shift+] |
| New Harness | ⌘N | Ctrl+Shift+N |
| Route a task | ⌘B | Ctrl+Shift+B |
| Keyboard shortcuts | ⌘/ | Ctrl+Shift+/ |
| Share harness | ⇧⌘S | Alt+Shift+S |
| Open Project | ⌘O | Ctrl+Shift+O |
| New Tab | ⌘T | Ctrl+Shift+T |
| New Terminal | ⇧⌘T | Alt+Shift+T |
| Restart Harness | ⇧⌘E | Ctrl+Shift+E |
| Clone Harness | ⇧⌘N | Alt+Shift+N |
| Close Tab | ⌘W | Ctrl+Shift+W |
| Rename Tab | ⇧⌘R | Alt+Shift+R |
| Next / Previous Tab | ⌥⌘→ / ⌥⌘← | Ctrl+Page Down / Ctrl+Page Up |
| Next / Previous Tab | ⌃⇥ / ⌃⇧⇥ | Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab |
| Harnesses needing input | ⇧⌘I | Alt+Shift+I |
| Close pane | ⇧⌘W | Alt+Shift+W |
| Settings | ⌘, | Ctrl+, |
| Select tab 1–9 | ⌘1–9 | Ctrl+1–9 |
| Debug log (debug builds) | ⇧⌘D | Alt+Shift+D |
| Search commands | ⇧⌘P | Ctrl+Shift+P |
| Open Harness (picker) | ⌘P | Alt+Shift+P |
| Split right / down | ⌘R / ⌘D | Ctrl+Shift+R / Ctrl+Shift+D |
| Machines / Models / Store | ⌘M / ⌘I / ⌘S | Ctrl+Shift+M / I / S |
| Tab Activity | ⇧⌘Y | Ctrl+Shift+Y |
| Pane shading | ⇧⌘F | Alt+Shift+F |
| Talk to daemon | ⌘⌥T | Alt+Shift+A |
| Review onboarding (debug) | ⌘⌥⇧O | Alt+Shift+O |
| Picker: refresh | ⌘R, ⌃R | Ctrl+R |
| Picker: start or add here | ⌘⏎ | Ctrl+Shift+⏎ |
| Picker: more options | ⌘. | Ctrl+Shift+. |
| Picker: delete harness | ⇧⌘⌫ | Alt+Shift+⌫ |

The picker's own Ctrl rows (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+Shift+R and the others) are unchanged.

Labels on Windows are spelled out (`Ctrl+Shift+T`). The Windows key reads `Win`. Windows binds no font-size keys, so
Settings shows no `⌘0`.

```dart
/// The native Windows app takes Ctrl where the Mac takes ⌘. But a plain

/// ^U ^W, PowerShell's ^C ^V ^Z ^Y ^L ^R, Claude Code's ^T ^O ^B ^G, Codex's

/// do. A legacy terminal cannot tell Ctrl+Shift+X from Ctrl+X, so taking it
/// costs the program nothing. Only keys no terminal program answers with Ctrl
/// take plain Ctrl: the tab digits and Settings' comma. Copy, Paste and Select

  LogicalKeyboardKey.digit3,
  LogicalKeyboardKey.digit4,

  '5',
  '6',

  '8',
  '9',
  'comma',

/// key a Windows terminal program answers, the command moves. The table is
/// keyed by the Mac chord's action and key, because one action can have two
/// chords.
/// - A shifted twin of a ⌘ letter takes Alt+Shift, Linux's own second rung.
/// - The ⌘-arrows focus and move panes with Alt and Alt+Shift, Windows
///   Terminal's pane keys, because Ctrl-arrows are PowerShell's word motions.
/// - The ⌥⌘-arrows (tabs) take Ctrl+Page Down/Up, as in every Windows browser.
/// - ⌘⏎ (zoom) takes Ctrl+Shift+Z, tmux's `prefix z` as on Linux, because
///   Ctrl+Enter is PowerShell's "insert line above".
final _windowsShortcuts = <(ShortcutAction, LogicalKeyboardKey), SingleActivator>{
  (ShortcutAction.findPrevious, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyG): const SingleActivator(
    LogicalKeyboardKey.keyG,
    alt: true,
    shift: true,

  (ShortcutAction.focusPaneLeft, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft):

  (ShortcutAction.focusPaneRight, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight, alt: true),
  (ShortcutAction.focusPaneAbove, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp, alt: true),
  (ShortcutAction.focusPaneBelow, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown, alt: true),
  (ShortcutAction.movePaneLeft, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft, alt: true, shift: true),
  (ShortcutAction.movePaneRight, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight):
      const SingleActivator(
        LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight,
        alt: true,
        shift: true,
      ),
  (ShortcutAction.movePaneUp, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowUp, alt: true, shift: true),
  (ShortcutAction.movePaneDown, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowDown, alt: true, shift: true),
  (ShortcutAction.movePaneToTab, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM): const SingleActivator(
    LogicalKeyboardKey.keyM,
    alt: true,
    shift: true,
  ),
  (ShortcutAction.zoomPane, LogicalKeyboardKey.enter): const SingleActivator(
    LogicalKeyboardKey.keyZ,
    control: true,
    shift: true,
  ),
  (ShortcutAction.showLayout, LogicalKeyboardKey.keyL): const SingleActivator(
    LogicalKeyboardKey.keyL,
    alt: true,
    shift: true,

    alt: true,
    shift: true,
  ),
  (ShortcutAction.nextSwarm, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowRight):
      const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.pageDown, control: true),
  (ShortcutAction.previousSwarm, LogicalKeyboardKey.arrowLeft):
```

with:

```dart
String platformWorkspaceBinding(String keys) {
  final parts = keys.split('+');
  if (!parts.contains('cmd')) return keys;
  if (ctrlWorkspacePrefix) {
    final plain = _windowsPlainCtrlKeyNames.contains(parts.last);
    return {
      for (final part in parts)
        if (part == 'cmd') ...['ctrl', if (!plain) 'shift'] else part,
    }.join('+');
  }
  if (!altWorkspacePrefix) return keys;
  return {
    for (final part in parts) part == 'cmd' ? workspaceCommandModifier : part,
  }.join('+');
}

/// [keys], a Mac chord, as this platform binds it.
SingleActivator platformActivator(SingleActivator keys) {
  if (!keys.meta) return keys;
  if (ctrlWorkspacePrefix) {
    return SingleActivator(
      keys.trigger,
      control: true,
      alt: keys.alt,
      shift: keys.shift || !_windowsPlainCtrlKeys.contains(keys.trigger),
      includeRepeats: keys.includeRepeats,
    );
  }
  if (!altWorkspacePrefix) return keys;
  final modifier = workspaceCommandModifier;
```

### Task C3.7: The runner on Windows CI

**Files:**
- Create: `desktop/integration_test/windows_runner_test.dart`
- Modify: `.github/workflows/windows-desktop.yml` (job `build-test`, created by C1.4: one step added at its end, after
  C2.4's)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: every C3 channel, the single instance and `harness-desktop.exe --quit` (C3.1–C3.5); the `build-test` job
  and its x64/arm64 matrix (C1.4).
- Produces:
  - a CI step that runs the runner's channels and its single instance on a real Windows desktop;
  - a child mode of the same executable, `HARNESS_RUNNER_TEST_CHILD=<log>`, which records every link it is handed.

The integration test runs these checks (spec §4.3):
- fonts list at least one family, and Consolas is monospaced;
- the clipboard round-trips a PNG, turns a bitmap with no PNG beside it into one, and reads a `CF_HDROP` whose paths
  hold a space, `&`, `%`, `!`, an apostrophe and non-ASCII letters;
- a link sent by a later launch reaches Dart once, and that launch exits;
- **Review Focus 4**: a second launch while the first is still starting waits for it. Each link arrives once, in order.
  One app stays running, and `--quit` ends it;
- notifications and the tray answer their calls.

`HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTANCE` keeps every instance in the run apart from any Harness already on the machine.

Toast clicks, the tray menu, hiding to the tray, the one-time notice, a link opened from a browser and pasting a
screenshot need a person at a real session. They are C5's E2E (`docs/testing/windows-desktop-e2e.md`, scenario 3, on
the VM). This task does not run them.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the integration test**

Create `desktop/integration_test/windows_runner_test.dart`:

```dart
// The Windows runner on a real Windows desktop: its channels and its single
// instance. Windows CI runs it (windows-desktop.yml, job build-test):
//
//   FLUTTER_TEST=1 HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTANCE=ci flutter test -d windows --no-pub integration_test/windows_runner_test.dart
//
// HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTANCE keeps this app's instance apart from an installed
// Harness. The executable doubles as a child (HARNESS_RUNNER_TEST_CHILD=<log>):
// it appends every link it is handed to <log>, one per line, and runs until
// `--quit` reaches it. That is how two launches racing each other are watched
// from outside. Toast clicks, the tray menu and hiding to the tray need a
// person at a real session: docs/testing/windows-desktop-e2e.md (C5).
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:harness/clipboard/native_clipboard.dart';
import 'package:integration_test/integration_test.dart';

const _links = MethodChannel('harness/community_links');
const _fork =
    'harness://fork/starter-runner-test?request=0b6b4b8e-6f6a-4c64-9d1b-6f0d0c1a2b3c';

void main() {
  final childLog = Platform.environment['HARNESS_RUNNER_TEST_CHILD'];
  if (childLog != null) {
    _runChild(childLog);
    return;
  }
  IntegrationTestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final skip = !Platform.isWindows;

  testWidgets('fonts: the installed families, Consolas monospaced', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    final raw =
        await const MethodChannel(
          'harness/fonts',
        ).invokeListMethod<Object?>('listFonts') ??
        const [];
    final families = {
      for (final entry in raw.whereType<Map>())
        entry['family'] as String: entry['mono'] == true,
    };
    expect(families, isNotEmpty);
    expect(families['Consolas'], isTrue);
    expect(families['Arial'], isFalse);
    expect(families.keys.where((name) => name.startsWith('@')), isEmpty);
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('clipboard: a PNG goes on and comes back byte for byte', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      final png = await _png(3, 2, const Color(0xFF3366CC));
      expect(await NativeClipboard.writeImagePng(png), isTrue);
      expect(await NativeClipboard.readImagePng(), png);
    });
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('clipboard: a bitmap with no PNG beside it comes back as PNG', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      await _powershell(r'''
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms,System.Drawing
$bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap 5,4
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
$graphics.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(255, 200, 30, 40))
$graphics.Dispose()
[System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetImage($bitmap)
''');
      final png = await NativeClipboard.readImagePng();
      expect(png, isNotNull);
      final codec = await ui.instantiateImageCodec(png!);
      final image = (await codec.getNextFrame()).image;
      expect((image.width, image.height), (5, 4));
      final pixels = (await image.toByteData(
        format: ui.ImageByteFormat.rawRgba,
      ))!;
      expect(
        [for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) pixels.getUint8(i)],
        [200, 30, 40, 255],
      );
    });
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('clipboard: files copied in Explorer come back as their paths', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      final root = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('harness clip ');
      addTearDown(() => root.delete(recursive: true));
      final odd = await Directory('${root.path}\\Nguyễn Văn A\'').create();
      final files = [
        await File('${odd.path}\\one & two %x% !.txt').writeAsString('1'),
        await File('${root.path}\\shot.png').writeAsBytes([0x89]),
      ];
      await _powershell(
        [
          'Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms',
          r'$files = New-Object System.Collections.Specialized.StringCollection',
          for (final file in files)
            "[void]\$files.Add('${file.path.replaceAll("'", "''")}')",
          r'[System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetFileDropList($files)',
        ].join('\n'),
      );
      expect(await NativeClipboard.readFilePaths(), [
        for (final file in files) file.path,
      ]);
    });
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('links: a later launch hands its link over, once, and exits', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      final opened = <String>[];
      _links.setMethodCallHandler((call) async {
        if (call.method == 'open' && call.arguments is String) {
          opened.add(call.arguments as String);
        }
      });
      addTearDown(() => _links.setMethodCallHandler(null));
      await _links.invokeListMethod<String>('ready');
      final later = await Process.start(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [_fork]);
      // A launch that became the app itself would still be running.
      final code = await later.exitCode.timeout(
        const Duration(seconds: 30),
        onTimeout: () {
          later.kill();
          return -1;
        },
      );
      expect(code, 0);
      await _until(() => opened.isNotEmpty);
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2));
      expect(opened, [_fork]);
    });
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('links: a launch while the first is still starting waits for '
      'it; one app, each link once', (tester) async {
    await tester.runAsync(() async {
      final root = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('harness race ');
      addTearDown(() => root.delete(recursive: true));
      final log = File('${root.path}\\links.txt');
      final environment = {
        'HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTANCE': 'race-$pid',
        'HARNESS_RUNNER_TEST_CHILD': log.path,
      };
      const cold =
          'harness://fork/starter-cold?request=1b6b4b8e-6f6a-4c64-9d1b-6f0d0c1a2b3c';
      const warm =
          'harness://fork/starter-warm?request=2b6b4b8e-6f6a-4c64-9d1b-6f0d0c1a2b3c';
      final first = await Process.start(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [
        cold,
      ], environment: environment);
      // At once: the first holds its mutex but has no window yet.
      final second = await Process.start(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [
        warm,
      ], environment: environment);
      try {
        final code = await second.exitCode.timeout(
          const Duration(seconds: 40),
          onTimeout: () {
            second.kill();
            return -1;
          },
        );
        expect(code, 0, reason: 'the second launch forwarded and exited');
        List<String> lines() => log.existsSync()
            ? log.readAsLinesSync().where((line) => line.isNotEmpty).toList()
            : const [];
        await _until(
          () => lines().length >= 2,
          within: const Duration(seconds: 60),
        );
        await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 3));
        expect(lines(), [cold, warm]);
        final quit = await Process.run(Platform.resolvedExecutable, [
          '--quit',
        ], environment: environment);
        expect(quit.exitCode, 0, reason: 'no Harness left running');
        final firstCode = await first.exitCode.timeout(
          const Duration(seconds: 20),
          onTimeout: () => -1,
        );
        expect(firstCode, isNot(-1), reason: 'the first app quit');
      } finally {
        first.kill();
        second.kill();
      }
    });
  }, skip: skip);

  testWidgets('notifications and the tray answer their calls', (tester) async {
    final answer = await const MethodChannel(
      'harness/notifications',
    ).invokeMethod<String>('authorize');
    // CI has no Start Menu shortcut carrying the AUMID: usually unavailable.
    expect(['granted', 'denied', 'unavailable'], contains(answer));
    await const MethodChannel('harness/status_menu').invokeMethod<void>(
      'update',
      {
        'entries': [
          {
            'machineId': 'm',
            'agentId': 'a',
            'title': 'Fix & ship',
            'unread': true,
            'receivedAt': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
          },
        ],
        'workingEntries': <Object?>[],
        'workspaceAvailable': true,
      },
    );
  }, skip: skip);
}

/// The child: records each link it is handed, in the order handed.
void _runChild(String log) {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final file = File(log);
  var tail = Future<void>.value();
  void record(Object? url) {
    if (url is! String) return;
    tail = tail.then(
      (_) => file.writeAsString('$url\n', mode: FileMode.append, flush: true),
    );
  }

  _links.setMethodCallHandler((call) async {
    if (call.method == 'open') record(call.arguments);
  });
  runApp(
    const MaterialApp(
      home: Scaffold(body: Center(child: Text('Harness runner test child'))),
    ),
  );
  unawaited(
    _links.invokeListMethod<String>('ready').then((urls) {
      for (final url in urls ?? const <String>[]) {
        record(url);
      }
    }),
  );
}

Future<void> _until(
  bool Function() done, {
  Duration within = const Duration(seconds: 20),
}) async {
  final deadline = DateTime.now().add(within);
  while (!done() && DateTime.now().isBefore(deadline)) {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));
  }
  expect(done(), isTrue, reason: 'not within $within');
}

/// Runs [script] in Windows PowerShell, passed as -EncodedCommand (UTF-16LE
/// in base64), so no path in it is re-parsed by any shell on the way.
Future<void> _powershell(String script) async {
  final units = script.codeUnits;
  final bytes = Uint8List(units.length * 2);
  for (var i = 0; i < units.length; i++) {
    bytes[2 * i] = units[i] & 0xff;
    bytes[2 * i + 1] = units[i] >> 8;
  }
  final result = await Process.run('powershell.exe', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-NonInteractive',
    '-STA',
    '-EncodedCommand',
    base64Encode(bytes),
  ]);
  expect(result.exitCode, 0, reason: '${result.stdout}\n${result.stderr}');
}

Future<Uint8List> _png(int width, int height, Color color) async {
  final recorder = ui.PictureRecorder();
  ui.Canvas(recorder).drawRect(
    Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, width.toDouble(), height.toDouble()),
    Paint()..color = color,
  );
  final image = await recorder.endRecording().toImage(width, height);
  final data = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);
  return data!.buffer.asUint8List(data.offsetInBytes, data.lengthInBytes);
}
```

### Phase C3 rulings

- **Channel names** are the ones Dart already calls: `readImagePng`, `writeImagePng` and `readFilePaths`; `listFonts`; `ready` and `open`; `authorize`, `show` and `withdraw`. `show` and `withdraw` carry two Windows-only keys, `tag` and `launch`, which Dart computes.
- **The quit contract (reconciliation).** `WM_HARNESS_QUIT` is `RegisterWindowMessageW(L"Autonomous.Harness.Quit")`, not `WM_APP + 0x51`. The app answers it on its main window (class `FLUTTER_RUNNER_WIN32_WINDOW`) and on its single-instance window. C3.1 and C4.3 state the contract word for word, and C3.1's contract test pins the name that `win.rs` registers.
- **`harness/status_menu`.** Dart → native `update` and `quit`; native → Dart `selected`, `openApp` and `hidden`. `quit` travels Dart → native because the runner owns the hide-to-tray flag.
- **Hide to tray** is decided on WM_CLOSE in the runner, before `HandleTopLevelWindowProc`, not through `window_manager.setPreventClose`. Without a tray icon (no Explorer) the close button quits.
- **Delivery bound.** A later launch waits 15 s for the first one's window, then gives up without a window. A send that timed out counts as delivered and is never repeated.
- **A toast click that launches Harness only opens it**, as `HarnessNotifications.swift` does.
- **Tag and launch link** are computed in Dart (FNV-1a tag, at most 64 characters) and bounds-checked in the runner.
- **Tray rows** are the ones spec §2.4 lists. "N more" replaces "View all". The tray's "Open Harness" shows the window.
- **The one-time tray notice** bypasses the notifications switch and is counted only once Windows has shown it.
- **`writeImagePng`** is implemented on Windows too, for image drag-drop's local half.
- **Fonts.** A family is monospaced when one face is `FIXED_PITCH`, never when it has a symbol-charset face. Raster and vertical `@` faces are left out.
- **Windows keys.** Ctrl+Shift for every letter command, plain Ctrl only for digits and comma, Alt+Shift for a shifted twin, Alt(+Shift)+arrows for panes, Ctrl+Page Down/Up for tabs, Ctrl+Shift+Z for zoom. Every Windows key branch checks `!kIsWeb`.
- **A debug build's instance name ends in `-debug`**, and `HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTANCE` (tests) adds a suffix.
- **The `harness://` key** is written and healed by C4.2's launcher, not by the runner.
- **The moved menu-bar tests' baseline entries** move with the file (C3.6 Step 3).
- **Known gaps, for a follow-up:** `daemon_slot.dart`'s chord tooltip and `box_chrome.dart`'s lower-case chord form still print Linux text on Windows. Neither changes a binding.

---

## Phase C4: Install and update

This phase makes the Windows desktop app install, update, roll back and uninstall itself, per user and with no
administrator rights. It delivers `Harness.exe`, a small GUI-subsystem Rust launcher in the `pty/` workspace that owns
every step that touches Windows (the version folders and pointers, the Start Menu shortcut with the AUMID, the
`harness://` key, the Settings ▸ Apps entry, rollback and removal), tested by `cargo test` on every OS and, for the
Windows-only steps, on Windows CI. On the Dart side it adds the `.started` marker, the updater's Windows branch (a new
version folder beside the running one, then renames), the app's self-install hand-over from a zip folder, and the
workflow's staging release of both zips. C4.8 adds the one-command install, `irm …/desktop/install.ps1 | iex`.

Phase-wide notes:
- Every Rust file below was compiled for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` and `aarch64-pc-windows-msvc` from a Mac
  (`cargo check --target …`; both targets are installed there), and the Windows tests were run on the arm64 VM in a
  throwaway folder while this plan was written. Each Rust task repeats that check before its CI run.
- Rust code uses edition 2024 as the crate does: `unsafe {}` inside `unsafe fn`, `let` chains, no `static mut`
  references, `std::env::set_var` only in a test's single-threaded main.
- The tests that run the real launcher never show a message box (`HARNESS_DESKTOP_NO_DIALOG=1`), never write the real

  `desktop_common::main`, so its own executable is the desktop app as well: copied to `app\<ver>\harness-desktop.exe`

  rewrites `argv[1]` into a path before any preload runs).

````rust
//! Shared by the tests that run the real `Harness.exe` (the `harness-desktop-launcher` bin). Each such test file has
//! `harness = false` and calls [main], so its own executable doubles as the desktop app: copied to
//! `app\<ver>\harness-desktop.exe`, and started with [STANDIN_OUT] set, it writes what it was given and exits.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub const LAUNCHER: &str = env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_harness-desktop-launcher");
/// Where the stand-in writes `{ "args": [...], "cwd": "..." }`.
pub const STANDIN_OUT: &str = "HARNESS_STANDIN_OUT";
/// The stand-in waits this many ms after writing, so a test can watch a running app.
pub const STANDIN_SLEEP_MS: &str = "HARNESS_STANDIN_SLEEP_MS";

/// Review Focus 1: a profile with a space, an apostrophe, `&`, `%`, `!` and letters outside ASCII.
pub const ODD_NAME: &str = "Nguyễn Văn A' & 100% !x";

/// The test runner, or the stand-in when [STANDIN_OUT] is set. A failing test panics, which ends the run non-zero.
pub fn main(tests: &[(&str, fn())]) {
    if let Some(out) = std::env::var_os(STANDIN_OUT) {
        stand_in(Path::new(&out));
        return;
    }
    let filter = std::env::args().skip(1).find(|arg| !arg.starts_with('-'));
    for (name, test) in tests {
        if filter.as_deref().is_none_or(|filter| name.contains(filter)) {
            println!("test {name} ...");
            test();
            println!("test {name} ... ok");
        }
    }
}

fn stand_in(out: &Path) {
    let report = serde_json::json!({
        "args": std::env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        "cwd": std::env::current_dir().unwrap(),
    });
    let tmp = out.with_extension("tmp");
    fs::write(&tmp, report.to_string()).unwrap();
    fs::rename(&tmp, out).unwrap();
    if let Some(ms) = std::env::var(STANDIN_SLEEP_MS).ok().and_then(|ms| ms.parse().ok()) {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(ms));
    }
}

/// [this test's own executable] as `<root>\app\<version>\harness-desktop.exe`.
pub fn put_app(root: &Path, version: &str) -> PathBuf {
    let dir = root.join("app").join(version);
    fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
    let exe = dir.join("harness-desktop.exe");
    fs::copy(std::env::current_exe().unwrap(), &exe).unwrap();
    exe
}

/// `current` naming [version], as the launcher writes it.
pub fn point(root: &Path, name: &str, version: &str) {
    fs::write(root.join(name), format!("{version}\r\n")).unwrap();
}

/// The stand-in's report at [out], once it is whole.
pub fn report(out: &Path) -> serde_json::Value {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
    loop {
        if let Ok(text) = fs::read_to_string(out)
            && let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str(&text)
        {
            return value;
        }
        assert!(Instant::now() < deadline, "the app never started: no {}", out.display());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
    }
}

/// The launcher, with message boxes off.
pub fn launcher() -> Command {
    let mut command = Command::new(LAUNCHER);
    command.env("HARNESS_DESKTOP_NO_DIALOG", "1");
    command
}

pub fn same(a: &Path, b: &Path) -> bool {
    fs::canonicalize(a).unwrap() == fs::canonicalize(b).unwrap()
}
````

  Create `pty/tests/desktop_launch.rs`:

````rust
//! The real `Harness.exe` launch path: it starts `app\<current>\harness-desktop.exe` from its version folder with the
//! link it was given and exits; `--wait-pid` waits for the app being replaced; a broken install
//! exits 3 and says why in launch.log. The app is this test's own executable (desktop_common).
mod desktop_common;

use std::fs;
use std::process::Command;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use desktop_common::*;

fn main() {
    desktop_common::main(&[
        ("starts_the_current_version_with_the_link_from_its_folder", starts_the_current_version_with_the_link_from_its_folder),
        ("waits_for_the_app_being_replaced", waits_for_the_app_being_replaced),
        ("a_broken_install_exits_3_and_says_why_in_the_log", a_broken_install_exits_3_and_says_why_in_the_log),
        ("a_usage_error_exits_2", a_usage_error_exits_2),
    ]);
}

fn starts_the_current_version_with_the_link_from_its_folder() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = dir.path().join(ODD_NAME).join("Harness");
    put_app(&root, "1.2.3");
    point(&root, "current", "1.2.3");
    let out = dir.path().join("report.json");
    let started = Instant::now();
    let status = launcher()
        .arg("harness://notification/machine 1/agent")
        .env("HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT", &root)
        .env(STANDIN_OUT, &out)
        .env(STANDIN_SLEEP_MS, "3000")
        .status()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(status.success(), "{status:?}");
    // It does not wait for the app.
    assert!(started.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3), "{:?}", started.elapsed());
    let report = report(&out);
    assert_eq!(report["args"], serde_json::json!(["harness://notification/machine 1/agent"]));
    assert!(same(report["cwd"].as_str().unwrap().as_ref(), &root.join("app").join("1.2.3")));
    // The one line allowed is a job's refused breakaway: an SSH session's job is one, and the app then starts in it.
    let log = fs::read_to_string(root.join("launch.log")).unwrap_or_default();
    assert!(log.lines().all(|line| line.contains("refuses a breakaway")), "{log}");
}

fn waits_for_the_app_being_replaced() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let root = dir.path().join("Harness");
    put_app(&root, "1.2.3");
    point(&root, "current", "1.2.3");
    // The app being replaced: this executable as the stand-in, for two seconds.
    let mut old = Command::new(std::env::current_exe().unwrap())
        .env(STANDIN_OUT, dir.path().join("old.json"))
        .env(STANDIN_SLEEP_MS, "2000")
        .spawn()
        .unwrap();
    let started = Instant::now();
    let out = dir.path().join("new.json");
    let status = launcher()
        .args(["--wait-pid", &old.id().to_string()])
        .env("HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT", &root)
        .env(STANDIN_OUT, &out)
        .status()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(status.success());
    assert!(started.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(1500), "{:?}", started.elapsed());
    old.wait().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(report(&out)["args"], serde_json::json!([]));
}

fn a_broken_install_exits_3_and_says_why_in_the_log() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let output = launcher().env("HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT", dir.path()).output().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(output.status.code(), Some(3));
    assert!(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).contains("Download Harness again"));
    assert!(fs::read_to_string(dir.path().join("launch.log")).unwrap().contains("`current` is missing"));
}

fn a_usage_error_exits_2() {
    let status = launcher().args(["--install", "now"]).status().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(status.code(), Some(2));
}
````
