````ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

// desktop/scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh, the Windows desktop's staging publish (desktop spec 3.6).
const script = join(process.cwd(), '..', 'desktop', 'scripts', 'publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh')
const dirs: string[] = []
afterEach(() => { for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }) })

function scratch() {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'harness-desktop-staging-'))
  dirs.push(root)
  return root
}

/** A zip as package-windows.ps1 builds it, through Python's zipfile (the script reads it the same way). */
function zip(root: string, version: string, arch: string, over: { current?: string; leave?: string } = {}) {
  const folder = join(root, `src-${arch}`)
  const files: Record<string, string> = {
    'Harness.exe': 'launcher',
    'Harness.ico': 'icon',
    current: `${over.current ?? version}\r\n`,
    [`app/${version}/harness-desktop.exe`]: `app ${arch}`,
  }
  for (const [name, text] of Object.entries(files)) {
    if (name === over.leave) continue
    mkdirSync(join(folder, name, '..'), { recursive: true })
    writeFileSync(join(folder, name), text)
  }
  const out = join(root, `harness-desktop-${version}-windows-${arch}.zip`)
  const made = spawnSync('python3', ['-c', 'import shutil, sys; shutil.make_archive(sys.argv[1][:-4], "zip", sys.argv[2])', out, folder], { encoding: 'utf8' })
  expect(made.status, made.stderr).toBe(0)
  return out
}

/**
 * A gcloud on PATH that logs its arguments and answers `ls` with [ls] (a shell snippet). Its `cp` copies an upload to
 * `<root>/uploaded-<name>`, and a download writes a manifest that already has a macOS key.
 */
function shim(root: string, ls: string) {
  const dir = join(root, 'shim')
  mkdirSync(dir)
  const cp = `for a in "$@"; do src="$dst"; dst="$a"; done
  case "$dst" in
    gs://*) cp "$src" '${join(root, 'uploaded-')}'"$(basename "$dst")" ;;
    *) echo '{"desktop-macos":{"version":"1.2.89"}}' > "$dst" ;;
  esac`
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'gcloud'), `#!/bin/sh\necho "$@" >> '${join(root, 'gcloud.log')}'\nif [ "$2" = ls ]; then ${ls}; fi\nif [ "$2" = cp ]; then ${cp}\nfi\nexit 0\n`, { mode: 0o755 })
  return dir
}

const run = (args: string[], env: Record<string, string> = {}) => {
  const base = { ...process.env }
  delete base.STAGING_PREFIX
  delete base.DRY_RUN
  return spawnSync('bash', [script, ...args], { encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...base, GCS_BUCKET: 's3-autonomous-upgrade-3', ...env } })
}

const sha = (path: string) => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex')

describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')('publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh', () => {
  it('refuses a prefix outside harness/staging/, a bad version, a missing zip and a DRY_RUN that is not 0 or 1', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const [x64, arm64] = [zip(root, '1.2.90', 'x64'), zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')]
    for (const prefix of ['harness', 'harness/desktop', 'harness/stagingx', 'harness/staging/../desktop']) {
      const result = run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { STAGING_PREFIX: prefix })
      expect(result.status, prefix).toBe(2)
      expect(result.stderr).toContain('is not harness/staging or a folder under it')
    }
    expect(run(['v1.2.90', x64, arm64]).status).toBe(2)
    expect(run(['1.2.90', x64]).status).toBe(2)
    expect(run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64, 'extra']).status).toBe(2)
    expect(run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { DRY_RUN: 'yes' }).status).toBe(2)
    expect(run(['1.2.90', join(root, 'none.zip'), arm64], { DRY_RUN: '1', DRY_RUN_OUT: join(root, 'out') }).stderr).toContain('is missing')
  })

  it('refuses a zip that is not named for its version and architecture, or not in the install shape', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const arm64 = zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')
    const dry = { DRY_RUN: '1', DRY_RUN_OUT: join(root, 'out') }
    expect(run(['1.2.90', arm64, arm64], dry).stderr).toContain('must be named harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-x64.zip')
    const other = scratch()
    expect(run(['1.2.90', zip(other, '1.2.90', 'x64', { leave: 'Harness.exe' }), arm64], dry).stderr).toContain('has no Harness.exe')
    const wrong = scratch()
    expect(run(['1.2.90', zip(wrong, '1.2.90', 'x64', { current: '1.2.89' }), arm64], dry).stderr).toContain("says current is '1.2.89'")
    expect(existsSync(join(root, 'out'))).toBe(false)
  })

  it('writes both zips and the two manifest keys in a dry run, touching no bucket', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const [x64, arm64] = [zip(root, '1.2.90', 'x64'), zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')]
    const out = join(root, 'out')
    const path = `${shim(root, 'exit 1')}:${process.env.PATH}`
    const result = run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { DRY_RUN: '1', DRY_RUN_OUT: out, PATH: path })
    expect(result.status, result.stderr).toBe(0)
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(out, 'metadata.json'), 'utf8'))
    expect(manifest['desktop-windows-x64']).toEqual({
      version: '1.2.90',
      url: 'https://cdn.autonomous.ai/harness/staging/desktop/1.2.90/harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-x64.zip',
      sha256: sha(x64),
      size: readFileSync(x64).length,
    })
    expect(manifest['desktop-windows-arm64'].url).toBe('https://cdn.autonomous.ai/harness/staging/desktop/1.2.90/harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-arm64.zip')
    expect(existsSync(join(out, 'harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-arm64.zip'))).toBe(true)
    expect(existsSync(join(root, 'gcloud.log'))).toBe(false)
  })

  it('refuses a version that is already there, before any upload', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const [x64, arm64] = [zip(root, '1.2.90', 'x64'), zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')]
    const path = `${shim(root, 'case "$3" in *arm64.zip) exit 0;; *) echo "One or more URLs matched no objects" >&2; exit 1;; esac')}:${process.env.PATH}`
    const result = run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { PATH: path })
    expect(result.status).toBe(1)
    expect(result.stderr).toContain('gs://s3-autonomous-upgrade-3/harness/staging/desktop/1.2.90/harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-arm64.zip already exists')
    expect(readFileSync(join(root, 'gcloud.log'), 'utf8')).not.toMatch(/ cp /)
  })

  it('aborts, uploading nothing, when gcloud fails for a reason other than not found', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const [x64, arm64] = [zip(root, '1.2.90', 'x64'), zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')]
    const path = `${shim(root, 'echo "ERROR: Reauthentication failed" >&2; exit 1')}:${process.env.PATH}`
    const result = run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { PATH: path })
    expect(result.status).toBe(1)
    expect(result.stderr).toContain('Reauthentication failed')
    expect(readFileSync(join(root, 'gcloud.log'), 'utf8')).not.toMatch(/ cp /)
  })

  it('uploads both zips, then the manifest over the existing one, keeping its other keys', () => {
    const root = scratch()
    const [x64, arm64] = [zip(root, '1.2.90', 'x64'), zip(root, '1.2.90', 'arm64')]
    // The zips are absent; the manifest is there.
    const ls = 'case "$3" in *metadata.json) exit 0;; *) echo "One or more URLs matched no objects" >&2; exit 1;; esac'
    const result = run(['1.2.90', x64, arm64], { PATH: `${shim(root, ls)}:${process.env.PATH}` })
    expect(result.status, result.stderr).toBe(0)
    const log = readFileSync(join(root, 'gcloud.log'), 'utf8').split('\n').filter((line) => line.startsWith('storage cp'))
    expect(log[0]).toContain('gs://s3-autonomous-upgrade-3/harness/staging/desktop/metadata.json')
    expect(log[1]).toContain("public, max-age=31536000, immutable")
    expect(log[1]).toContain('harness/staging/desktop/1.2.90/harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-x64.zip')
    expect(log[2]).toContain('harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-arm64.zip')
    expect(log[3]).toContain('--cache-control=no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'uploaded-metadata.json'), 'utf8'))
    expect(Object.keys(manifest).sort()).toEqual(['desktop-macos', 'desktop-windows-arm64', 'desktop-windows-x64'])
    expect(readFileSync(join(root, 'uploaded-harness-desktop-1.2.90-windows-x64.zip'))).toEqual(readFileSync(x64))
  })
})
````

  Create `desktop/scripts/package-windows.ps1`:

````powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Package a `flutter build windows --release` bundle as the Windows desktop zip (desktop spec section 3.3).

.DESCRIPTION
  The zip has the per-user install's shape, so `Harness.exe --install` copies it as it is and the updater unpacks
  the same layout (lib/update/windows_update_swap.dart):

    Harness.exe      the launcher (pty: the harness-desktop-launcher bin, renamed)
    Harness.ico      the icon the Start Menu shortcut and Settings show
    current          one line naming <version>, UTF-8 with no BOM
    app\<version>\   the Flutter bundle: harness-desktop.exe, its DLLs, data\

  The version is stamped by the build (`flutter build windows --build-name <version>`): Windows keeps it in the
  executable's version resource, which package_info_plus reads at run time (lib/core/app_version.dart), as Linux
  keeps it in version.txt. This script checks the stamp before packaging, so a manifest never names a zip whose app
  reports another version. Entries are written with `/`, whatever the PowerShell.

.EXAMPLE
  pwsh desktop/scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Version 1.2.90 -Arch x64 -Launcher pty/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/harness-desktop-launcher.exe
#>
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Version,
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][ValidateSet('x64', 'arm64')][string]$Arch,
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Launcher,
  # flutter build windows writes build\windows\<arch>\runner\Release.
  [string]$Bundle = '',
  [string]$OutDir = ''
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$desktop = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $Bundle) { $Bundle = Join-Path $desktop "build\windows\$Arch\runner\Release" }
if (-not $OutDir) { $OutDir = Join-Path $desktop 'build\windows-zip' }
if ($Version -notmatch '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$') { throw "Version '$Version' is not X.Y.Z[-prerelease]" }
$app = Join-Path $Bundle 'harness-desktop.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $app -PathType Leaf)) { throw "no harness-desktop.exe in ${Bundle}: build with flutter build windows --release first" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Launcher -PathType Leaf)) { throw "the launcher ${Launcher} is missing: cargo build --release --bin harness-desktop-launcher" }
$stamped = ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $app).VersionInfo.ProductVersion -split '\+')[0]
if ($stamped -ne $Version) { throw "harness-desktop.exe says it is '${stamped}', not ${Version}: build with --build-name $Version" }

$name = "harness-desktop-$Version-windows-$Arch"
$stage = Join-Path $OutDir $name
$zip = Join-Path $OutDir "$name.zip"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stage) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $zip -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $stage "app\$Version") | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $Bundle '*') -Destination (Join-Path $stage "app\$Version") -Recurse
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Launcher -Destination (Join-Path $stage 'Harness.exe')
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $desktop 'windows\runner\resources\app_icon.ico') -Destination (Join-Path $stage 'Harness.ico')
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $stage 'current'), "$Version`r`n", (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$root = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $stage).Path.TrimEnd('\') + '\'
$archive = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open($zip, [System.IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create)
try {
  foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -File) {
    $entry = $file.FullName.Substring($root.Length).Replace('\', '/')
    [System.IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($archive, $file.FullName, $entry, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null
  }
} finally {
  $archive.Dispose()
}
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force
$hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
Write-Output "$zip $hash $((Get-Item -LiteralPath $zip).Length)"
````

  Create `desktop/scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh` and `chmod +x` it:

````bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Publish the Windows desktop zips to STAGING only (desktop spec section 3.6): both architectures' zips under
# <prefix>/desktop/<version>/, and the `desktop-windows-x64` / `desktop-windows-arm64` keys of
# <prefix>/desktop/metadata.json, the manifest a staging build's DesktopUpdater reads (the release build passes it as
# DESKTOP_UPDATE_METADATA_URL). The production manifest, signing and the installer are sub-project D's; this script
# never writes outside harness/staging.
#
#   bash desktop/scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh <version> <x64 zip> <arm64 zip>
#
# Each zip is scripts/package-windows.ps1's: named harness-desktop-<version>-windows-<arch>.zip, holding Harness.exe,
# current (naming <version>) and app/<version>/harness-desktop.exe. A zip that is not is refused before any upload.
# STAGING_PREFIX (default harness/staging) must be harness/staging or a folder under it. A version whose zips are
# already there is refused before any upload: versioned objects are immutable (the CDN keeps the first bytes). The
# manifest starts from {} only when it is confirmed absent (cli/scripts/lib/gcs.sh), and keeps every other key.
# DRY_RUN=1 DRY_RUN_OUT=<dir> checks the zips, writes them and the manifest into <dir>, and touches no bucket.
set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${1:-}"
X64_ZIP="${2:-}"
ARM64_ZIP="${3:-}"
if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$ ]] || [ -z "$X64_ZIP" ] || [ -z "$ARM64_ZIP" ] || [ $# -ne 3 ]; then
  echo "usage: $0 <X.Y.Z[-prerelease]> <x64 zip> <arm64 zip>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)"
GCS_BUCKET="${GCS_BUCKET:-s3-autonomous-upgrade-3}"
CDN_ASSET_BASE_URL="${CDN_ASSET_BASE_URL:-https://cdn.autonomous.ai}"
STAGING_PREFIX="${STAGING_PREFIX:-harness/staging}"
DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-0}"
if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 0 ] && [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: DRY_RUN must be 0 or 1, not '$DRY_RUN'; nothing was published." >&2
  exit 2
fi
[[ "$STAGING_PREFIX" =~ ^harness/staging(/[a-z0-9_-]+)*$ ]] || {
  echo "error: STAGING_PREFIX '$STAGING_PREFIX' is not harness/staging or a folder under it; nothing was published." >&2
  exit 2
}
for command in node python3; do
  command -v "$command" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "error: $command is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
  command -v gcloud >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "error: gcloud not found; install and authenticate the gcloud SDK" >&2; exit 1; }
fi

source "$REPO/cli/scripts/lib/gcs.sh"

METADATA_PATH="${STAGING_PREFIX}/desktop/metadata.json"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
printf '{}' > "$WORK/entries.json"
UPLOADS=()
for pair in "x64=$X64_ZIP" "arm64=$ARM64_ZIP"; do
  arch="${pair%%=*}"
  zip="${pair#*=}"
  name="harness-desktop-${VERSION}-windows-${arch}.zip"
  [ -f "$zip" ] || { echo "error: $zip is missing" >&2; exit 1; }
  [ "$(basename "$zip")" = "$name" ] || { echo "error: the $arch zip must be named $name, not $(basename "$zip")" >&2; exit 1; }
  # The install's shape, as Harness.exe --install and the updater read it.
  python3 - "$zip" "$VERSION" <<'PY' || exit 1
import sys, zipfile
path, version = sys.argv[1:3]
try:
    archive = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    names = {name.replace("\\", "/") for name in archive.namelist()}
except zipfile.BadZipFile as error:
    sys.exit(f"error: {path} is not a zip: {error}")
for needed in ("Harness.exe", "current", f"app/{version}/harness-desktop.exe"):
    if needed not in names:
        sys.exit(f"error: {path} has no {needed}")
current = archive.read("current").decode("utf-8").lstrip("﻿").strip()
if current != version:
    sys.exit(f"error: {path} says current is '{current}', not {version}")
PY
  object="${STAGING_PREFIX}/desktop/${VERSION}/${name}"
  url="${CDN_ASSET_BASE_URL%/}/${object}"
  size="$(wc -c < "$zip" | tr -d ' ')"
  UPLOADS+=("$zip|$object|$size")
  node "$REPO/cli/scripts/lib/runtimeManifest.mjs" entry "$WORK/entries.json" "desktop-windows-${arch}" "$VERSION" "$url" "$(sha256_of "$zip")" "$size"
done

if [ "$DRY_RUN" != 1 ]; then
  # Every check before any upload: a failure must not leave one immutable zip published without the other.
  for item in "${UPLOADS[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r zip object size <<< "$item"
    if exists "gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${object}"; then
      echo "error: gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${object} already exists. Versioned artifacts are immutable (the CDN keeps the first bytes); publish a new version." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  done
  fetch_manifest "gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${METADATA_PATH}" "$WORK/metadata.json" "$METADATA_PATH"
else
  printf '{}' > "$WORK/metadata.json"
fi
# The two keys over the existing manifest; every other key (the macOS and Linux builds of a staging run) stays.
node --input-type=module - "$REPO/cli/scripts/lib/runtimeManifest.mjs" "$WORK/metadata.json" "$WORK/entries.json" "$WORK/metadata.next.json" <<'JS'
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
const [lib, src, entries, dst] = process.argv.slice(2)
const { readDocument, mergeKey } = await import(pathToFileURL(lib).href)
let document = readDocument(src)
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(JSON.parse(readFileSync(entries, 'utf8')))) document = mergeKey(document, key, value)
writeFileSync(dst, JSON.stringify(document, null, 2) + '\n')
JS

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
  out="${DRY_RUN_OUT:?DRY_RUN=1 needs DRY_RUN_OUT, a folder for the zips and the manifest}"
  mkdir -p "$out"
  for item in "${UPLOADS[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r zip object size <<< "$item"
    cp "$zip" "$out/"
  done
  cp "$WORK/metadata.next.json" "$out/metadata.json"
  echo ">> dry run: zips and manifest in $out"
  exit 0
fi
for item in "${UPLOADS[@]}"; do
  IFS='|' read -r zip object size <<< "$item"
  echo ">> uploading $(basename "$zip") ($size bytes) to gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${object}"
  gcloud storage cp --cache-control='public, max-age=31536000, immutable' "$zip" "gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${object}"
done
gcloud storage cp --content-type=application/json --cache-control='no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' \
  "$WORK/metadata.next.json" "gs://${GCS_BUCKET}/${METADATA_PATH}"
echo ">> published the Windows desktop $VERSION to https://storage.googleapis.com/${GCS_BUCKET}/${METADATA_PATH}"
````

  - replace C1.4's `concurrency:` block with:

````yaml
concurrency:
  # A test run gives way to a newer one on the same branch. A release run never does, and never cancels one: a
  # publish cut short would burn its version. (Quoted: the subject prefix holds ": ".)
  group: "windows-desktop-${{ github.ref }}-${{ (inputs.release || startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'ci(windows): desktop staging ')) && github.run_id || 'test' }}"
  cancel-in-progress: "${{ !(inputs.release || startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'ci(windows): desktop staging ')) }}"
````
  - add this job as the first one under `jobs:`:

````yaml
  # The run's mode: the tests (build-test), or the release mode (release-build, release-staging; desktop spec
  # section 3.6). On workflow_dispatch the inputs decide. The lines marked TEMPORARY go with the push trigger before
  # merging: until this file is on main it cannot be dispatched, so a push whose head commit's subject is
  # `ci(windows): desktop staging release <version>` runs the release mode and publishes, and
  # `ci(windows): desktop staging dry run <version>` runs it as a dry run.
  mode:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      release: ${{ steps.mode.outputs.release }}
      version: ${{ steps.mode.outputs.version }}
      dry_run: ${{ steps.mode.outputs.dry_run }}
    steps:
      - id: mode
        shell: bash
        env:
          RELEASE: ${{ inputs.release }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
          SUBJECT: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }} # TEMPORARY
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release=${RELEASE:-false} version=${VERSION:-} dry_run=${DRY_RUN:-true}
          subject=${SUBJECT%%$'\n'*} # TEMPORARY
          if [[ "$subject" =~ ^ci\(windows\):\ desktop\ staging\ (release|dry\ run)\ ([^[:space:]]+)$ ]]; then # TEMPORARY
            release=true version=${BASH_REMATCH[2]} dry_run=true # TEMPORARY
            if [[ "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" == release ]]; then dry_run=false; fi # TEMPORARY
          fi # TEMPORARY
          if [[ "$release" == true && ! "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::version '$version' is not X.Y.Z[-prerelease]"
            exit 1
          fi
          { echo "release=$release"; echo "version=$version"; echo "dry_run=$dry_run"; } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "mode: release=$release version=$version dry_run=$dry_run"
````

    (the TEMPORARY push trigger, a dispatch without `release`) runs it as before:

  - add these two jobs at the end of `jobs:`:

````yaml
  # Release mode (desktop spec section 3.6): both zips, stamped with the version, published to STAGING only, for the
  # end-to-end run. Production, signing and the installer are sub-project D's. A release is not a test suite
  # (docs/validation-and-release.md): the build-test run is.
  release-build:
    needs: mode
    if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-11-arm
            target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      # Flutter as build-test installs it (a clone of the pinned tag, so arm64 gets its own Dart SDK).
      - name: Install Flutter ${{ env.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 --branch "$env:FLUTTER_VERSION" https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git flutter
          "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\flutter\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append -Encoding utf8
      - name: Check the Flutter pin, and get packages
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: desktop
        run: |
          flutter config --no-analytics
          $version = flutter --version --machine | ConvertFrom-Json
          if ($version.frameworkVersion -ne $env:FLUTTER_VERSION) { throw "Flutter is $($version.frameworkVersion), not $env:FLUTTER_VERSION" }
          flutter pub get
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Build the launcher
        working-directory: pty
        run: cargo build --locked --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --bin harness-desktop-launcher
      # The version goes into harness-desktop.exe's version resource, which package_info_plus reads. HARNESS_STAGING
      # makes it a staging build: it polls the staging manifest (desktop_updater.dart, desktopUpdateMetadataUrl) and
      # installs the staging CLI (environment_provisioner.dart, harnessInstallScriptUrl).
      - name: Build the app
        working-directory: desktop
        shell: bash
        run: >-
          flutter build windows --release --build-name ${{ env.VERSION }} --build-number ${{ github.run_number }}
          --dart-define=HARNESS_STAGING=true
      - name: Package
        shell: pwsh
        run: pwsh desktop/scripts/package-windows.ps1 -Version $env:VERSION -Arch ${{ matrix.arch }} -Launcher pty/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/harness-desktop-launcher.exe
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: harness-desktop-zip-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: desktop/build/windows-zip/harness-desktop-${{ env.VERSION }}-windows-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip
          if-no-files-found: error

  release-staging:
    needs: [mode, release-build]
    if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.release == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      VERSION: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.version }}
      GCS_BUCKET: s3-autonomous-upgrade-3
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.2
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: harness-desktop-zip-windows-*
          path: .zips
          merge-multiple: true
      # A dry run checks the zips and writes the manifest it would publish, and touches no bucket.
      - name: Dry run
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run == 'true' }}
        run: DRY_RUN=1 DRY_RUN_OUT=.dry-run bash desktop/scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh "$VERSION" ".zips/harness-desktop-$VERSION-windows-x64.zip" ".zips/harness-desktop-$VERSION-windows-arm64.zip"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run == 'true' }}
        with:
          name: harness-desktop-windows-dry-run
          path: .dry-run/metadata.json
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Authenticate to GCP (workload identity federation)
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@c200f3691d83b41bf9bbd8638997a462592937ed # v2
        with:
          workload_identity_provider: ${{ secrets.GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER }}
          service_account: ${{ secrets.GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
      - uses: google-github-actions/setup-gcloud@e427ad8a34f8676edf47cf7d7925499adf3eb74f # v2
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
      - name: Publish to staging
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        run: bash desktop/scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh "$VERSION" ".zips/harness-desktop-$VERSION-windows-x64.zip" ".zips/harness-desktop-$VERSION-windows-arm64.zip"
      - name: Read staging back the way the updater will
        if: ${{ needs.mode.outputs.dry_run != 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --input-type=commonjs - <<'JS'
            const crypto = require("node:crypto")
            const manifest = `https://storage.googleapis.com/${process.env.GCS_BUCKET}/harness/staging/desktop/metadata.json`
            const main = async () => {
              const response = await fetch(manifest, { cache: "no-store" })
              if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${manifest} -> ${response.status}`)
              const document = await response.json()
              for (const key of ["desktop-windows-x64", "desktop-windows-arm64"]) {
                const entry = document[key]
                if (!entry || entry.version !== process.env.VERSION) throw new Error(`${key} is ${entry && entry.version}`)
                const served = await fetch(entry.url, { cache: "no-store" })
                if (!served.ok) throw new Error(`${key}: GET ${entry.url} -> ${served.status}`)
                const bytes = Buffer.from(await served.arrayBuffer())
                if (crypto.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex") !== entry.sha256 || bytes.length !== entry.size) throw new Error(`${key}: served bytes differ`)
              }
              console.log(`staging desktop ${process.env.VERSION}: x64 + arm64 verified`)
            }
            main().catch((error) => { console.error(`::error::${error.message}`); process.exit(1) })
          JS
````

  In `desktop/RELEASE.md`, after the Linux section, add:

````markdown
## Windows (staging)

The Windows build is a zip with the per-user install's shape (`scripts/package-windows.ps1`): `Harness.exe` (the
launcher, `../pty/src/desktop`), `Harness.ico`, `current` and `app\<version>\`. Run from anywhere, it installs itself
into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Harness` (`Harness.exe --install`), and it updates by adding a version folder beside the
running one (`lib/update/windows_update_swap.dart`). `Harness.exe` goes back to the previous version after two starts
that end without a window.

Sub-project C publishes to **staging only**: Actions ▸ Windows desktop ▸ Run workflow, with `release` on, a `version`,
and `dry_run` off (`gh workflow run windows-desktop.yml -f release=true -f version=<v> -f dry_run=false`). It builds both zips on their own runners, stamped with `--build-name <version>`. The version lives in
`harness-desktop.exe`'s version resource, which `package_info_plus` reads, so Windows has no `version.txt`.
`scripts/publish-desktop-windows-staging.sh` uploads the zips and merges two keys into the staging manifest. With
`dry_run` on (the default) the run checks the zips and keeps the manifest it would write as an artifact.

```
gs://s3-autonomous-upgrade-3/harness/staging/desktop/metadata.json      (desktop-windows-x64, desktop-windows-arm64)
gs://s3-autonomous-upgrade-3/harness/staging/desktop/<version>/harness-desktop-<version>-windows-x64.zip
gs://s3-autonomous-upgrade-3/harness/staging/desktop/<version>/harness-desktop-<version>-windows-arm64.zip
```

The release build is a staging build (`--dart-define=HARNESS_STAGING=true`): it reads that manifest and installs the
staging CLI (`harness/staging/cli/install.ps1`). A published version is immutable, as everywhere here: publish a new one. The production
manifest, signing and an installer are sub-project D's.
````

### Task C4.8: Install by one command (`install.ps1 -App`)

A browser marks the zip it downloads as coming from the internet (a `Zone.Identifier` stream), and until D signs the
build, SmartScreen then stops the first run at "Windows protected your PC". A file PowerShell downloads carries no
such mark. So a person can install the app with one line, and see no prompt (spec §3.7):

```
irm https://cdn.autonomous.ai/harness/desktop/install.ps1 | iex
```

The line runs B's `install.ps1`, with a new `-App` mode, published a second time as `desktop/install.ps1` with that
mode on by default. Reusing it keeps one tested copy of what the download needs: the native architecture, TLS 1.2,
retries, the sha256 and size check, and `tar.exe` run inside a folder whose path has letters outside the code page.
`-App` downloads the zip the desktop manifest names for this PC and runs the zip's own `Harness.exe --install` (C4.2),
which does every install step and opens the app. The app installs the CLI on its first start (C1.3), as it does after
a zip install, so `-App` installs the app only.

**Files:**
- Modify: `cli/scripts/install.ps1`: the `-App` switch, the `$HarnessInstallApp` line, `ConvertTo-HarnessVersionKey`,
  `Select-HarnessAppEntry`, `Start-HarnessAppInstall`, `Install-HarnessApp`, and the run block.
- Modify: `cli/scripts/upload-install-ps1.sh`: `--app`, and the object path in `--print` mode.
- Modify: `cli/src/scripts/installPs1.spec.ts`: two as-written cases.
- Modify: `cli/src/scripts/uploadInstallPs1.spec.ts`: two cases, plus the path in the existing ones.
- Create: `cli/src/scripts/installPs1App.spec.ts` (Windows only).
- Modify: `.github/workflows/windows-desktop.yml`, job `build-test`: one step at the end.
- Modify: `desktop/RELEASE.md`: one paragraph in "Windows (staging)".

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `Harness.exe --install` (C4.2): exit 0 once the installed Harness is started. On failure it exits non-zero, and
    shows a message box unless `HARNESS_DESKTOP_NO_DIALOG` is set. It honours the overrides
    `HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT`, `HARNESS_DESKTOP_PROGRAMS_DIR` and `HARNESS_DESKTOP_REGISTRY_ROOT`.
  - The zip's shape and the manifest keys (C4.7): `Harness.exe`, `current`, `app\<ver>\harness-desktop.exe`; and
    `desktop-windows-x64` / `desktop-windows-arm64` as `{ version, url, sha256, size }` in
    `<base>desktop/metadata.json`.
  - The bin `harness-desktop-launcher`, which `build-test`'s `cargo test` steps build (C4.1, C4.2) into
    `pty\target\debug\`.
  - B's helpers in `install.ps1`: `Test-HarnessHost`, `Get-HarnessPlatform`, `Get-HarnessJson`, `Resolve-HarnessRef`,
    `Get-HarnessProperty`, `Save-HarnessVerified`, `Expand-HarnessZip`, `New-HarnessStaging`, `Test-HarnessUrl`,
    `Test-HarnessScheme`.
- Produces:
  - `install.ps1 -App [-Manifest <desktop manifest>]`. A copy whose `$HarnessInstallApp` line is `$true` does the
    same with no switch. The exit code (or `$LASTEXITCODE` under `iex`) is 0 when installed, and 1 on failure.
  - `Select-HarnessAppEntry -Document <manifest> -Platform win32-x64|win32-arm64` returns the entry.
    `ConvertTo-HarnessVersionKey <version>` returns `[version]` or `$null`.
  - `bash cli/scripts/upload-install-ps1.sh --app [--production] [--print]` publishes
    `harness/staging/desktop/install.ps1`, or `harness/desktop/install.ps1` with `--production`.
  - The user's command on staging: `irm https://cdn.autonomous.ai/harness/staging/desktop/install.ps1 | iex`. C5.2
    Step 8b runs it on the VM.
- The choice of zip is the updater's (C4.5):
  - an x64 PC takes `desktop-windows-x64`;
  - an arm64 PC takes the newer of the two keys, and arm64 wins a tie;
  - versions compare as `X.Y.Z` only, as `newer` does in C4.2.
- **Ruling: one script, published twice.** `desktop/install.ps1` is `cli/scripts/install.ps1` with one line changed,
  just as staging changes the manifest-base line. A second script would duplicate about a hundred lines of B's
  checked download code.

  Create `cli/src/scripts/installPs1App.spec.ts`:

````ts
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'

// cli/scripts/install.ps1 -App, the desktop app's one-command install (desktop spec 3.7), on Windows only. Its
// as-written checks are in installPs1.spec.ts, and the published copy's one-line change in uploadInstallPs1.spec.ts.
// The launcher is the real Harness.exe (pty/src/desktop); the app it opens is a stand-in that runs two minutes.
const installer = join(process.cwd(), 'scripts', 'install.ps1')
const windows = process.platform === 'win32'
const scratch: string[] = []
const subkeys: string[] = []
const apps: string[] = []

/** A PowerShell single-quoted string of [text]. */
const quote = (text: string) => `'${text.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`

/**
 * This process's environment for Windows PowerShell 5.1, with [extra]. PSModulePath is left out: a PowerShell 7 step
 * (CI) hands on 7's modules first, and 5.1's autoload would load them (installPs1.spec.ts, `powershell7`).
 */
function cleanEnv(extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
  const env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...process.env }
  for (const name of Object.keys(env)) if (['psmodulepath', 'harness_install_manifest'].includes(name.toLowerCase())) delete env[name]
  return { ...env, ...extra }
}

/** [script] in Windows PowerShell 5.1, passed as -EncodedCommand so no quoting reaches it. */
function powershell(script: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}) {
  const run = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-EncodedCommand', Buffer.from(script, 'utf16le').toString('base64')], {
    encoding: 'utf8', env: cleanEnv(env), timeout: 240_000,
  })
  return { status: run.status, stdout: (run.stdout ?? '').trim(), stderr: run.stderr ?? '' }
}

/** A new folder under the temp folder, by its long name: a runner's TEMP is 8.3 (RUNNER~1), a process's path is not. */
function folder(prefix: string): string {
  const dir = realpathSync.native(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), prefix)))
  scratch.push(dir)
  return dir
}

// The stand-in apps first: a folder a running program holds cannot be removed.
afterAll(() => {
  for (const app of apps) powershell(`Get-Process -Name 'harness-desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq ${quote(app)} } | Stop-Process -Force`)
  for (const key of subkeys) spawnSync('reg.exe', ['delete', `HKCU\\${key}`, '/f'], { encoding: 'utf8' })
  for (const dir of scratch) {
    try { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }) } catch { /* left in the temp folder */ }
  }
})

describe.runIf(windows)('install.ps1 -App: the zip this PC takes', { timeout: 120_000 }, () => {
  const entry = (key: string, version: string) => ({ version, url: `https://cdn.example/${key}.zip`, sha256: '0'.repeat(64), size: 1 })

  /** `<version> <url>` of the entry Select-HarnessAppEntry takes from [document] on [platform], or what it throws. */
  function pick(document: object, platform: string): string {
    const text = `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; . ${quote(installer)}; try { $e = Select-HarnessAppEntry -Document (${quote(JSON.stringify(document))} | ConvertFrom-Json) -Platform '${platform}'; "$($e.version) $($e.url)" } catch { $_.Exception.Message }`
    return powershell(text, { HARNESS_INSTALL_LIBRARY: '1' }).stdout
  }

  it('takes the x64 zip on an x64 PC, and never the arm64 one', () => {
    const both = { 'desktop-windows-x64': entry('x64', '1.2.0'), 'desktop-windows-arm64': entry('arm64', '1.3.0') }
    expect(pick(both, 'win32-x64')).toBe('1.2.0 https://cdn.example/x64.zip')
    expect(pick({ 'desktop-windows-arm64': entry('arm64', '1.3.0') }, 'win32-x64'))
      .toBe('The desktop manifest has no Harness desktop app for this computer (win32-x64) yet.')
  })

  it('takes the newer of the two on an arm64 PC, arm64 winning a tie, comparing numbers and not text', () => {
    const doc = (x64: string, arm64: string) => ({ 'desktop-windows-x64': entry('x64', x64), 'desktop-windows-arm64': entry('arm64', arm64) })
    expect(pick(doc('1.2.0', '1.3.0'), 'win32-arm64')).toBe('1.3.0 https://cdn.example/arm64.zip')
    expect(pick(doc('1.10.0', '1.9.0'), 'win32-arm64')).toBe('1.10.0 https://cdn.example/x64.zip')
    expect(pick(doc('1.3.0', '1.3.0'), 'win32-arm64')).toBe('1.3.0 https://cdn.example/arm64.zip')
    expect(pick({ 'desktop-windows-x64': entry('x64', '1.2.0') }, 'win32-arm64')).toBe('1.2.0 https://cdn.example/x64.zip')
    expect(pick({}, 'win32-arm64')).toBe('The desktop manifest has no Harness desktop app for this computer (win32-arm64) yet.')
  })
})

describe.runIf(windows)('install.ps1 -App, installing for real with the real Harness.exe', { timeout: 300_000 }, () => {
  /** The real launcher (pty/src/bin/desktop-launcher.rs): $HARNESS_DESKTOP_LAUNCHER_BIN, or this tree's cargo build. */
  function launcher(): string {
    const candidates = [process.env.HARNESS_DESKTOP_LAUNCHER_BIN, ...['debug', 'release'].map((profile) => join(process.cwd(), '..', 'pty', 'target', profile, 'harness-desktop-launcher.exe'))]
    const found = candidates.find((file): file is string => !!file && existsSync(file))
    if (!found) throw new Error('No harness-desktop-launcher.exe: build it with `cd pty && cargo build --bin harness-desktop-launcher`, or set HARNESS_DESKTOP_LAUNCHER_BIN.')
    return found
  }

  let standIn: string | undefined
  /** A GUI program that shows nothing and runs two minutes: the app Harness.exe opens. Compiled once, by 5.1's csc. */
  function standInApp(): string {
    if (standIn) return standIn
    const out = join(folder('harness-app-standin-'), 'stand-in.exe')
    const made = powershell(`Add-Type -OutputType WindowsApplication -OutputAssembly ${quote(out)} -TypeDefinition 'public static class StandIn { public static void Main() { System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(120000); } }'`)
    if (!existsSync(out)) throw new Error(`could not compile the stand-in app: ${made.stdout} ${made.stderr}`)
    return (standIn = out)
  }

  /** A zip of [version] in package-windows.ps1's shape, and a desktop manifest naming it under both keys. */
  function build(version: string, over: { sha256?: string } = {}): string {
    const dir = folder('harness-app-build-')
    const src = join(dir, 'src')
    mkdirSync(join(src, 'app', version), { recursive: true })
    copyFileSync(launcher(), join(src, 'Harness.exe'))
    copyFileSync(standInApp(), join(src, 'app', version, 'harness-desktop.exe'))
    writeFileSync(join(src, 'current'), `${version}\r\n`)
    const name = `harness-desktop-${version}-windows-x64.zip`
    const tar = join(process.env.SystemRoot!, 'System32', 'tar.exe')
    const made = spawnSync(tar, ['-a', '-cf', join(dir, name), '-C', src, 'Harness.exe', 'current', 'app'], { encoding: 'utf8' })
    expect(made.status, made.stderr).toBe(0)
    const bytes = readFileSync(join(dir, name))
    const ref = { version, url: name, sha256: over.sha256 ?? createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'), size: bytes.length }
    writeFileSync(join(dir, 'metadata.json'), JSON.stringify({ 'desktop-windows-x64': ref, 'desktop-windows-arm64': ref }, null, 2))
    return join(dir, 'metadata.json')
  }

  /**
   * A profile named as Review Focus 1 asks, with its TEMP inside it, so the download is unpacked under that name too.
   * The launcher's overrides keep the real Start Menu, harness:// key and uninstall entry out of reach.
   */
  function world() {
    const home = join(folder('harness-app-home-'), "Nguyễn Văn A' & 100% !x")
    const temp = join(home, 'AppData', 'Local', 'Temp')
    const install = join(home, 'AppData', 'Local', 'Programs', 'Harness')
    const programs = join(home, 'Start Menu', 'Programs')
    mkdirSync(temp, { recursive: true })
    mkdirSync(programs, { recursive: true })
    const registry = `Software\\HarnessTest\\${randomUUID()}`
    subkeys.push(registry)
    const env = {
      USERPROFILE: home, TEMP: temp, TMP: temp,
      HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT: install, HARNESS_DESKTOP_PROGRAMS_DIR: programs, HARNESS_DESKTOP_REGISTRY_ROOT: registry,
      HARNESS_DESKTOP_NO_DIALOG: '1',
    }
    return { temp, install, programs, registry, env }
  }

  const stagingLeft = (temp: string) => readdirSync(temp).filter((name) => name.startsWith('.harness-desktop-staging-'))

  /** How many harness-desktop.exe run as [exe], polled up to 10 s: the installed launcher opens the app a moment after. */
  function running(exe: string): number {
    const script = `$deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10); do { $n = @(Get-Process -Name 'harness-desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -eq ${quote(exe)} }).Count; if ($n) { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); $n`
    return Number(powershell(script).stdout)
  }

  function installApp(manifest: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv) {
    return spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', installer, '-App', '-Manifest', manifest], {
      encoding: 'utf8', env: cleanEnv(env), timeout: 240_000,
    })
  }

  it('checks and installs the zip, opens the installed app, waits for none of it, and leaves no temp folder', () => {
    const w = world()
    const manifest = build('9.8.7')
    const app = join(w.install, 'app', '9.8.7', 'harness-desktop.exe')
    apps.push(app)
    const t0 = Date.now()
    const run = installApp(manifest, w.env)
    const seconds = (Date.now() - t0) / 1000
    expect(run.status, `${run.stdout}\n${run.stderr}`).toBe(0)
    expect(run.stdout).toContain('Harness 9.8.7 is installed, and it is opening now.')
    // The stand-in runs 120 s: the installer waited for the zip's Harness.exe only.
    expect(seconds).toBeLessThan(90)
    expect(readFileSync(join(w.install, 'current'), 'utf8').trim()).toBe('9.8.7')
    expect(existsSync(join(w.install, 'Harness.exe'))).toBe(true)
    expect(existsSync(app)).toBe(true)
    expect(existsSync(join(w.programs, 'Harness.lnk'))).toBe(true)
    const entry = spawnSync('reg.exe', ['query', `HKCU\\${w.registry}\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall\\Harness`, '/v', 'DisplayVersion'], { encoding: 'utf8' })
    expect(entry.stdout).toMatch(/DisplayVersion\s+REG_SZ\s+9\.8\.7/)
    expect(stagingLeft(w.temp)).toEqual([])
    expect(running(app)).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })

  it('installs nothing from a download that fails its checksum, says which step failed, and leaves no temp folder', () => {
    const w = world()
    const run = installApp(build('9.8.8', { sha256: 'f'.repeat(64) }), w.env)
    expect(run.status).toBe(1)
    expect(run.stdout).toContain('Harness could not be installed. The step that failed: Downloading Harness.')
    expect(run.stdout).toContain('failed its checksum')
    expect(existsSync(w.install)).toBe(false)
    expect(stagingLeft(w.temp)).toEqual([])
  })

  it('installs with no switch as the published desktop/install.ps1 under iex, and leaves that PowerShell running', () => {
    const w = world()
    const manifest = build('9.8.9')
    const app = join(w.install, 'app', '9.8.9', 'harness-desktop.exe')
    apps.push(app)
    const source = readFileSync(installer, 'utf8')
    const published = join(folder('harness-app-published-'), 'install.ps1')
    writeFileSync(published, source.replace('$HarnessInstallApp = $false', '$HarnessInstallApp = $true'))
    // As `irm <url> | iex`: the script's text, not a file, so nothing may exit the session.
    const run = powershell(`iex (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath ${quote(published)}); "exit code $LASTEXITCODE"; 'still here'`, { ...w.env, HARNESS_INSTALL_MANIFEST: manifest })
    expect(run.stdout).toContain('Harness 9.8.9 is installed, and it is opening now.')
    expect(run.stdout).toContain('exit code 0')
    expect(run.stdout.endsWith('still here')).toBe(true)
    expect(running(app)).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  })
})
````

  - before `# --- Run ---`, add:

````powershell
function ConvertTo-HarnessVersionKey([string]$Version) {
  # X.Y.Z as a [version], as the launcher's `newer` and the app's updater compare it; a pre-release tag does not order.
  if ($Version -notmatch '^(\d{1,9})\.(\d{1,9})\.(\d{1,9})') { return $null }
  return [version]::new([int]$Matches[1], [int]$Matches[2], [int]$Matches[3])
}

function Select-HarnessAppEntry {
  # The zip this PC takes, as the app's updater chooses it (desktop_updater.dart). An x64 PC takes
  # desktop-windows-x64. An arm64 PC takes the newer of the two, arm64 winning a tie, because the x64 build runs
  # there under emulation until an arm64 one is published.
  param($Document, [string]$Platform)
  $keys = if ($Platform -eq 'win32-arm64') { @('desktop-windows-arm64', 'desktop-windows-x64') } else { @('desktop-windows-x64') }
  $best = $null
  foreach ($key in $keys) {
    $entry = Get-HarnessProperty $Document $key
    $version = ConvertTo-HarnessVersionKey ([string](Get-HarnessProperty $entry 'version'))
    if ($version -and (-not $best -or $version -gt $best.version)) { $best = @{ entry = $entry; version = $version } }
  }
  if (-not $best) { throw "The desktop manifest has no Harness desktop app for this computer ($Platform) yet." }
  return $best.entry
}

function Start-HarnessAppInstall {
  # The zip's own Harness.exe --install (pty/src/desktop/install.rs) does every install step, as when a person runs
  # the zip: the version folder, the Start Menu shortcut, harness:// and the uninstall entry, then it opens the
  # installed Harness. Only Harness.exe is waited for. Start-Process -Wait would wait for the app it opens too,
  # which runs until the person quits it.
  param([string]$Launcher)
  $info = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new($Launcher, '--install')
  $info.UseShellExecute = $false
  $info.WorkingDirectory = Split-Path -Parent $Launcher
  $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($info)
  try {
    $process.WaitForExit()
    return $process.ExitCode
  } finally { $process.Dispose() }
}

function Install-HarnessApp {
  # The Harness desktop app by one command (desktop spec 3.7). Invoke-WebRequest marks no file as downloaded from
  # the internet, so Windows asks no "Run anyway?" for the app, which it does for a browser's download of the zip.
  # The app sets up the CLI on its first start, so only the app is installed here.
  param([string]$Manifest)
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
  $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
  $step = 'Checking this computer'
  $staging = $null
  try {
    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
    $tar = Test-HarnessHost
    $platform = Get-HarnessPlatform

    $step = 'Reading the release manifest'
    $source = "${HarnessManifestBase}desktop/metadata.json"
    if ($Manifest) {
      $source = $Manifest
      if (-not (Test-HarnessUrl $source) -and -not (Test-HarnessScheme $source)) {
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source -PathType Leaf)) { throw "The manifest $source does not exist." }
        $source = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $source).ProviderPath
      }
    }
    $entry = Select-HarnessAppEntry -Document (Get-HarnessJson $source) -Platform $platform
    $version = [string]$entry.version
    Write-Host "Installing the Harness desktop app $version for $platform"

    $step = 'Downloading Harness'
    $staging = New-HarnessStaging -Parent ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) -Name 'harness-desktop'
    $zip = Join-Path $staging 'harness-desktop.zip'
    Save-HarnessVerified -Source (Resolve-HarnessRef -Ref ([string]$entry.url) -ManifestSource $source) -Destination $zip -Sha256 ([string]$entry.sha256) -Size $entry.size

    $step = 'Unpacking Harness'
    $folder = Join-Path $staging 'zip'
    Expand-HarnessZip -Tar $tar -Archive $zip -Destination $folder
    $launcher = Join-Path $folder 'Harness.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The download has no Harness.exe, so it is not a Harness desktop app.' }

    $step = 'Installing Harness'
    $code = Start-HarnessAppInstall -Launcher $launcher
    if ($code -ne 0) { throw "Harness's installer stopped (exit code $code). Its log is launch.log, in Programs\Harness under $env:LOCALAPPDATA." }
  } catch {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host "Harness could not be installed. The step that failed: $step." -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host "  $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host '  Run the installer again, or send this message to Harness support.'
    return 1
  } finally {
    if ($staging) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  }
  Write-Host ''
  Write-Host "Harness $version is installed, and it is opening now."
  Write-Host 'Next time, open it from the Start menu. On its first start it sets up the Harness command line.'
  return 0
}
````

### Task C4.9: Use the Windows PowerShell terminal face by default

The owner's VM screenshots show the Windows Harness terminal rendering wide, poorly spaced text while a standard
Windows PowerShell terminal on the same system is compact and legible. Today Windows takes the Linux default
`DejaVu Sans Mono`, which is not a Windows system font, and then falls through to an uncontrolled Flutter face. A
fresh Windows terminal and Settings → Terminal → Reset must use `Consolas`, the stock Windows PowerShell-style
monospaced face. Keep saved user choices, macOS/iOS, Linux and web behavior unchanged. Do not compensate with global
letter spacing: xterm's cell measurement and box-drawing alignment depend on a real monospaced face.

### Phase C4 rulings

- **The bin** is `harness-desktop-launcher`, renamed to `Harness.exe` by `package-windows.ps1`. A bin named `Harness` and B's `harness` are one file in `target\` on a case-insensitive file system.
- **Layout additions.** `Harness.ico` beside `Harness.exe`, for the shortcut and `DisplayIcon`, because the launcher has no icon resource. `launch-state.json`, the launcher's record of its starts.
- **`--wait-pid <pid>`** on the launch and install forms. With C3.1's single instance, a start while the old app still runs would hand its link to that app and end.
- **Rollback.** A start's end is seen by liveness (pid and creation time) plus the per-version `.started`. The 10 s window applies when the process cannot be looked at. A rollback removes `previous` and the recorded starts, so it cannot bounce. `.started` is written once per version folder and never rolled back afterwards.
- **Uninstall** removes every `.harness\desktop-app*` entry, not `viewer-app-v2`, and ends an app that has not quit 10 s after `WM_HARNESS_QUIT` (the quit contract in C4.3). Its last step starts `cmd.exe` through B's `launcher::start`, not WMI. A refused breakaway is logged in `launch.log`, and the tests allow that one line.
- **An install over a different running version** first asks it to quit.
- **"Older"** compares `X.Y.Z` only, as `semverGt` does.
- **Overrides.** `HARNESS_DESKTOP_INSTALL_ROOT` is refused without `HARNESS_DESKTOP_PROGRAMS_DIR` and `HARNESS_DESKTOP_REGISTRY_ROOT`. `HARNESS_DESKTOP_NO_DIALOG` silences the message boxes.
- **`%` in a profile path.** `%` followed by a digit, `*` or `~` is a known limit of the `harness://` command. Any other `%` works (tested: `100% !x`).
- **The updater** stages into `app\<ver>.staging` during `downloadAndStage`, so `applyStaged` is renames only. Its architecture is the PC's (`IsWow64Process2`).
- **C1.6's updater pieces (reconciliation).** C4.5 removes the `!_isWindows` term of `canCheck` and C1.6's test "Windows offers no update until its own branch exists". It keeps C1.6's `isWindows` parameter, field and default, and adds only `windowsInstallRoot` and `startDetached`. Existing updater tests are pinned `isWindows: false`.
- **The staging manifest (reconciliation)** follows `kHarnessStagingBuild` (`desktopUpdateMetadataUrl`). The release build passes `--dart-define=HARNESS_STAGING=true` only: no `DESKTOP_UPDATE_METADATA_URL` or `HARNESS_INSTALL_PS1_URL`, which stay test overrides.
- **A self-install that cannot start** is logged, and the app keeps running from the zip folder.
- **The staging release needs both zips.** If C1 recorded that arm64 cannot build, publish the x64 key only (drop the arm64 argument and make the script's third argument optional); arm64 PCs then take x64.
- **`dry_run` defaults to true**, so an on-demand run never publishes by accident.
- **The release mode before merge (reconciliation).** `workflow_dispatch` needs the file on `main`, so while the TEMPORARY push trigger exists, a push whose head commit's subject is `ci(windows): desktop staging release <version>` (or `… staging dry run <version>`) runs the release mode. The `mode` job decides, and every job `needs` it. Push such an empty commit while the PR is a draft. A release run has its own concurrency group: it never cancels and is never cancelled. C5.3 removes the path.
- **One-command install (C4.8, added after stitching at the owner's request).** `install.ps1 -App`, published again as `desktop/install.ps1` with its app line on, downloads this PC's zip and runs the zip's `Harness.exe --install`. PowerShell's download carries no mark of the web, so there is no SmartScreen prompt until D signs. It reuses B's download code rather than a second script. The app still installs the CLI itself.
- **Windows terminal font (C4.9, added from the owner's VM screenshot).** A fresh Windows terminal uses `Consolas`
  with real Windows monospace fallbacks. C5.2 visually compares it with standard Windows PowerShell before publishing
  the next staging candidate.
- **The workflow (reconciliation).** `build-test` gets the Rust toolchain once, in C4.1, right after checkout. The release jobs install Flutter as C1.4 does. The release artifacts are named `harness-desktop-zip-windows-<arch>`, apart from build-test's `harness-desktop-windows-<arch>` Release folders.

## Phase C5: Validation

This phase proves C on a real Windows desktop and proves macOS and Linux unchanged. C5.1 builds the end-to-end
tooling in `desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/`, on B's model (`cli/scripts/windows-cli-e2e/`). It runs a GUI app in a test
user's real desktop session on the UTM VM, sees the screen and drives it through UI Automation, reads the app's logs,
serves broken updates from B's fake HTTPS CDN, and cleans up after itself. C5.2 runs the seven scenarios of spec §4.4
with it, and writes `docs/testing/windows-desktop-e2e.md` in the shape of `docs/testing/windows-cli-e2e.md`. C5.3
compares the full desktop suite on macOS test by test against the base, checks that no file under `desktop/macos` or
`desktop/linux` changed, reads the Linux PR CI, removes the TEMPORARY push trigger, and records all of it in the PR.

  - `start-app.ps1`, `stage-zip.ps1`, `desktop-state.ps1`, `desktop-logs.ps1`, `desktop-procs.ps1`;
  - `cleanup.ps1`, `parse-check.ps1`, `selftest.ps1`.
- Reused unchanged from B: `cli/scripts/windows-cli-e2e/first-login.sh`, `fake-cdn.sh` (`make-ca`), `fake-cdn.mjs`
  (`serve`), `vm-cdn.ps1`, `run.cmd`; `cli/scripts/windows-pty-e2e/build.sh` and its driver.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - B: `first-login.sh <user> <password>`; `FAKE_CDN_DIR=<dir> fake-cdn.sh make-ca` (writes `<dir>/ca/fake-cdn-ca.pem`,
    `leaf.pem`, `leaf.key`); `node fake-cdn.mjs serve --root <dir> --cert <pem> --key <pem> --bind <ip> --port 443
    --http-port 0` (any object present under `<root>` is served locally, any other `harness/staging/` path is a 404);
    `vm-cdn.ps1 -Enable | -Disable | -Status` (admin, CA beside it); `windows-pty-e2e/build.sh <out>` (writes
    `<out>/e2e.mjs`), `run.cmd <command>` (`list`, `create <engine>`, `type <id> <text> <ms>`, `screen <id>`).
  - C1: the app's logs under `%USERPROFILE%\.harness\logs` (`app-YYYYMMDD.log`, `cli-YYYYMMDD.log`, from
    `FileAppLog.defaultDirectory` = `HarnessFileStore.defaultDirectoryPath(name: 'logs')`), its state in
    `%USERPROFILE%\.harness\desktop-app-v2\` (`HarnessFileStore.directoryName`) with `errors.log`
    (`crash_log.dart`); `homeDir()` prefers `USERPROFILE`.
  - C4: the install layout and names of the header; `launch.log`; `app\<ver>\.started`; the staging layout
    `harness/staging/desktop/<ver>/harness-desktop-<ver>-windows-<arch>.zip` and the manifest
    `harness/staging/desktop/metadata.json` with the keys `desktop-windows-x64` / `desktop-windows-arm64`
    (`STAGING_DESKTOP_PREFIX` overrides the folder if C4 names it differently).
- Produces:
  - `desktop-e2e.sh <command>`: `preflight`, `user-add [<user>]`, `push [<user>]`, `driver [<user>]`, `kilo [<user>]`,
    `session-on [<user>]`, `session-off [<user>]`, `fetch <version> <arch> [--run <id>]`, `put <zip> [<user>]`,
    `run <script.ps1> [Name=value ...]`, `ps <script.ps1> [Name=value ...]`, `admin <script.ps1> [Name=value ...]`,
    `sh <cmd line>`, `sh-admin <cmd line>`, `shot <name> [Window=… Mask=…]`, `state`, `logs [Log=… Match=… Tail=…]`,
    `procs`, `variant <no-exe|no-start> <zip> <version>`, `truncated <zip>`, `cdn-ca`,
    `cdn-stage <arch>=<zip>[@<claimed zip>] ...`, `cdn-serve`, `cdn-stop`, `cdn-on`, `cdn-off`, `cdn-status`,
    `stamp <label>`, `cleanup [<user>]`. Environment: `VM_HOST`, `E2E_USER` (default `hxe2e`), `E2E_WORK`, `EV`,
    `RUN_TIMEOUT` (default 120 s), `E2E_RAW=1` (no redaction, for a value a later command needs), `UTMCTL`, `UTM_VM`.
  - `e2e_tools.py` functions: `redact(text, home=None) -> str`; `args_b64(pairs) -> str`; `zip_info(path) -> dict`;
    `zip_variant(kind, src, version, out_dir) -> Path`; `truncate(src, out_dir) -> Path`;
    `layout(version, arch) -> dict`; `verify(manifest, arch, zip_path) -> tuple[bool, str]`;
    `cdn_stage(root, specs) -> dict`; `test_results(path) -> dict`; `compare_runs(base, head) -> tuple[int, str]`.
    C5.3 uses `compare-runs`.
  - VM scripts, each with the parameters in its code below. Every script that runs in the desktop session is
    started by `session-run.ps1` through `hxrun.exe`, a GUI program it compiles, so no console window of the tooling
    ever shows on the screen the run is checking.

```python
"""Tests for e2e_tools.py: python3 -m unittest discover -s desktop/scripts/windows-e2e -p 'test_*.py' -v"""
import base64
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

import e2e_tools as t

GOOD = {
    'Harness.exe': b'launcher',
    'current': b'1.4.0\r\n',
    'app/1.4.0/harness-desktop.exe': b'MZ app',
    'app/1.4.0/flutter_windows.dll': b'engine',
    'app/1.4.0/data/app.so': b'aot',
    'app/1.4.0/data/flutter_assets/AssetManifest.bin': b'assets',
}


def make_zip(path, entries=GOOD, backslash=False):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for name, data in entries.items():
            zf.writestr(name.replace('/', '\\') if backslash else name, data)
    return Path(path)


def names(path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        return sorted(i.filename for i in zf.infolist())


class Temp(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = Path(self._dir.name)

    def tearDown(self):
        self._dir.cleanup()


class RedactTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ids_become_their_short_form(self):
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('agent 7e92c45a-1b2c-4d5e-8f90-123456789abc ok', home=''), 'agent 7e92c45a… ok')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact(r'pipe \\.\pipe\harness-41b22efa0123456789abcdef01234567', home=''),
                         r'pipe \\.\pipe\harness-41b22efa…')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('sha 2d6bdfb341be3a6234b24742377f93aa7c7cfb0d9fd64efa9282c87852e57085', home=''), 'sha 2d6bdfb3…')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('hxe2e S-1-5-21-1000000001-1000000002-1000000003-1006', home=''), 'hxe2e S-1-5-21-…-1006')

    def test_no_email_token_or_proof_is_left(self):
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('signed in as person.name+x@example.com.', home=''), 'signed in as <email>.')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('Authorization: Bearer abc.DEF-123_~+/=', home=''), 'Authorization: Bearer <token>')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('jwt eyJhbGciOi.eyJzdWIiOi.c2lnbmF0dXJl end', home=''), 'jwt <token> end')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('x-harness-auth: 41b22efa.deadbeef', home=''), 'x-harness-auth: <redacted>')
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('X-Harness-Proof:abc', home=''), 'X-Harness-Proof: <redacted>')

    def test_the_macs_home_becomes_a_tilde(self):
        self.assertEqual(t.redact('/Users/someone/work/x.log', home='/Users/someone'), '~/work/x.log')

    def test_ssh_destinations_short_hex_and_versions_stay(self):
        line = 'hxe2e@192.168.65.3 admin@WIN-TESTVM pid 7500 build 1.4.0 commit 338e589bc'
        self.assertEqual(t.redact(line, home=''), line)


class ArgsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def decode(self, value):
        return json.loads(base64.b64decode(value).decode('utf-8'))

    def test_values_reach_powershell_exactly_as_typed(self):
        odd = "Downloads\\Nguyễn Văn A' & 100%!\\Harness"
        encoded = t.args_b64([f'To={odd}', 'Seconds=90', 'Probe=true', 'ArgumentList=["--uninstall"]'])
        self.assertEqual(self.decode(encoded), {'To': odd, 'Seconds': '90', 'Probe': 'true', 'ArgumentList': ['--uninstall']})
        self.assertEqual(self.decode(t.args_b64([])), {})

    def test_a_bad_or_repeated_name_is_refused(self):
        for pairs in (['novalue'], ['-Out=x'], ['A=1', 'A=2'], ['1st=x']):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                t.args_b64(pairs)


class ZipTest(Temp):
    def test_info_reads_the_pointer_and_the_app_folder(self):
        info = t.zip_info(make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip'))
        self.assertEqual(info['version'], '1.4.0')
        self.assertEqual((info['name_version'], info['arch']), ('1.4.0', 'arm64'))
        self.assertEqual(info['app_folders'], ['1.4.0'])
        self.assertTrue(info['has_exe'] and info['has_launcher'])
        self.assertFalse(info['current_bom'] or info['backslashes'])

    def test_info_reads_a_zip_written_with_backslashes_and_reports_a_bom(self):
        entries = dict(GOOD, current=b'\xef\xbb\xbf1.4.0\n')
        info = t.zip_info(make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-x64.zip', entries, backslash=True))
        self.assertTrue(info['has_exe'] and info['backslashes'] and info['current_bom'])

    def test_info_refuses_a_zip_without_its_pointer(self):
        entries = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != 'current'}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            t.zip_info(make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip', entries))

    def test_no_exe_moves_the_build_to_the_new_version_without_its_executable(self):
        src = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        dst = t.zip_variant('no-exe', src, '1.4.2', self.dir / 'out')
        self.assertEqual(dst.name, 'harness-desktop-1.4.2-windows-arm64.zip')
        self.assertEqual(names(dst), ['Harness.exe', 'app/1.4.2/data/app.so', 'app/1.4.2/data/flutter_assets/AssetManifest.bin',
                                      'app/1.4.2/flutter_windows.dll', 'current'])
        with zipfile.ZipFile(dst) as zf:
            self.assertEqual(zf.read('current'), b'1.4.2\r\n')
        self.assertFalse(t.zip_info(dst)['has_exe'])

    def test_no_start_drops_the_aot_snapshot_and_keeps_backslashes(self):
        src = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-x64.zip', backslash=True)
        dst = t.zip_variant('no-start', src, '1.4.3', self.dir / 'out')
        self.assertIn('app\\1.4.3\\harness-desktop.exe', names(dst))
        self.assertNotIn('app\\1.4.3\\data\\app.so', names(dst))
        self.assertTrue(t.zip_info(dst)['has_exe'])

    def test_a_variant_needs_another_version_and_something_to_break(self):
        src = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            t.zip_variant('no-exe', src, '1.4.0', self.dir / 'out')
        (self.dir / 'bare').mkdir()
        bare = make_zip(self.dir / 'bare' / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip',
                        {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != 'app/1.4.0/data/app.so'})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            t.zip_variant('no-start', bare, '1.4.3', self.dir / 'out')
        self.assertFalse((self.dir / 'out' / 'harness-desktop-1.4.3-windows-arm64.zip').exists())

    def test_truncate_keeps_the_first_half_in_another_folder(self):
        src = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        cut = t.truncate(src, self.dir / 'cut')
        self.assertEqual(cut.name, src.name)
        self.assertEqual(cut.read_bytes(), src.read_bytes()[:src.stat().st_size // 2])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            t.truncate(src, self.dir)

class VerifyTest(Temp):
    def test_the_zip_must_match_its_manifest_entry(self):
        z = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        body = z.read_bytes()
        good = {'desktop-windows-arm64': {'version': '1.4.0', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), 'size': len(body)}}
        self.assertTrue(t.verify(good, 'arm64', z)[0])
        bad = {'desktop-windows-arm64': dict(good['desktop-windows-arm64'], size=1)}
        ok, line = t.verify(bad, 'arm64', z)
        self.assertFalse(ok)
        self.assertIn('size', line)

    def test_a_manifest_offering_another_version_or_none_is_not_a_mismatch(self):
        z = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        self.assertTrue(t.verify({'desktop-windows-arm64': {'version': '1.4.1', 'sha256': 'x', 'size': 1}}, 'arm64', z)[0])
        self.assertTrue(t.verify({}, 'arm64', z)[0])


class CdnStageTest(Temp):
    def test_the_manifest_claims_the_full_zip_while_the_cut_one_is_served(self):
        full = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.4-windows-arm64.zip',
                        {k.replace('1.4.0', '1.4.4'): (b'1.4.4\n' if k == 'current' else v) for k, v in GOOD.items()})
        cut = t.truncate(full, self.dir / 'cut')
        root = self.dir / 'root'
        stale = root / 'harness/staging/desktop/9.9.9/old.zip'
        stale.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        stale.write_bytes(b'old')
        manifest = t.cdn_stage(root, [f'arm64={cut}@{full}'])
        entry = manifest['desktop-windows-arm64']
        self.assertEqual(entry['version'], '1.4.4')
        self.assertEqual(entry['sha256'], hashlib.sha256(full.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(entry['size'], full.stat().st_size)
        self.assertEqual(entry['url'], 'https://cdn.autonomous.ai/harness/staging/desktop/1.4.4/harness-desktop-1.4.4-windows-arm64.zip')
        self.assertEqual((root / 'harness/staging/desktop/1.4.4/harness-desktop-1.4.4-windows-arm64.zip').read_bytes(), cut.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((root / 'harness/staging/desktop/metadata.json').read_text()), manifest)
        self.assertFalse(stale.exists())

        z = make_zip(self.dir / 'harness-desktop-1.4.0-windows-arm64.zip')
        for specs in ([f'arm64={z}', f'arm64={z}'], [f'ia32={z}'], ['arm64=']):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                t.cdn_stage(self.dir / 'root', specs)


def events(path, tests, start=0):
    """Flutter JSON reporter lines for one file: tests is [(name, result, hidden, skipped)]."""
    lines = [{'type': 'suite', 'suite': {'id': start, 'platform': 'vm', 'path': path}},
             {'type': 'group', 'group': {'id': start + 1, 'suiteID': start, 'parentID': None, 'testCount': len(tests)}}]
    for i, (name, result, hidden, skipped) in enumerate(tests):
        tid = start + 10 + i
        lines.append({'type': 'testStart', 'test': {'id': tid, 'name': name, 'suiteID': start, 'groupIDs': []}})
        lines.append({'type': 'testDone', 'testID': tid, 'result': result, 'hidden': hidden, 'skipped': skipped})
    return lines


def write_log(path, *files):
    rows = [row for f in files for row in f] + [{'type': 'done', 'success': False}]
    Path(path).write_text('Building...\n' + '\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in rows) + '\n')
    return Path(path)


class CompareTest(Temp):
    def run_logs(self, root):
        a = f'{root}/desktop/test/a_test.dart'
        b = f'{root}/desktop/test/linux_menu_bar_test.dart'
        return a, b

    def test_a_regression_a_fix_a_rename_and_a_known_failure(self):
        a, b = self.run_logs('/base')
        base = write_log(self.dir / 'base.log',
                         events(a, [('loading ' + a, 'success', True, False), ('keeps', 'success', False, False),
                                    ('breaks', 'success', False, False), ('was red', 'failure', False, False),
                                    ('known red', 'error', False, False), ('same name', 'success', False, False),
                                    ('same name', 'success', False, False)]),
                         events(b, [('draws the menus', 'success', False, False)], start=100))
        a2 = '/head/desktop/test/a_test.dart'
        c2 = '/head/desktop/test/in_window_menu_bar_test.dart'
        head = write_log(self.dir / 'head.log',
                         events(a2, [('loading ' + a2, 'success', True, False), ('keeps', 'success', False, False),
                                     ('breaks', 'failure', False, False), ('was red', 'success', False, False),
                                     ('known red', 'error', False, False), ('same name', 'success', False, False),
                                     ('same name', 'failure', False, False), ('brand new red', 'failure', False, False)]),
                         events(c2, [('draws the menus', 'success', False, False)], start=100))
        code, report = t.compare_runs(base, head)
        self.assertEqual(code, 1)
        self.assertIn('newly failing (passing, skipped or absent in base): 3', report)
        self.assertIn('  test/a_test.dart :: breaks  (base: pass)', report)
        self.assertIn('  test/a_test.dart :: same name #2  (base: pass)', report)
        self.assertIn('  test/a_test.dart :: brand new red  (base: absent)', report)
        self.assertIn('still failing (failing in base too): 1', report)
        self.assertIn('fixed (failing in base, passing in head): 1', report)
        self.assertIn('  test/linux_menu_bar_test.dart :: draws the menus  (base: pass)', report)
        self.assertIn('  test/in_window_menu_bar_test.dart :: draws the menus  (pass)', report)
        self.assertNotIn('<loading>', report)
        self.assertTrue(report.endswith('verdict: REGRESSIONS\n'))

    def test_no_regression_when_head_fails_only_what_base_failed(self):
        a, _ = self.run_logs('/base')
        a2, _ = self.run_logs('/head')
        base = write_log(self.dir / 'base.log', events(a, [('known red', 'failure', False, False), ('ok', 'success', False, False)]))
        head = write_log(self.dir / 'head.log', events(a2, [('known red', 'failure', False, False), ('ok', 'success', False, False)]))
        code, report = t.compare_runs(base, head)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertTrue(report.endswith('verdict: no regressions\n'))

    def test_a_receipt_reads_its_logs_and_the_loader_retry_replaces_the_first_attempt(self):
        root = '/r'
        a = f'{root}/desktop/test/a_test.dart'
        first = write_log(self.dir / 'desktop-vm.log', events(a, [(f'loading {a}', 'error', False, False)]))
        retry = write_log(self.dir / 'desktop-vm-loader-retry.log',
                          events(a, [(f'loading {a}', 'success', True, False), ('ok', 'success', False, False)]))
        receipt = self.dir / 'receipt.json'
        receipt.write_text(json.dumps({'desktop_root': f'{root}/desktop', 'checks': [
            {'name': 'desktop-vm', 'log': str(first)}, {'name': 'desktop-vm-loader-retry', 'log': '/moved/desktop-vm-loader-retry.log'}]}))
        self.assertEqual(t.test_results(receipt), {('test/a_test.dart', 'ok'): 'pass'})


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
