`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/e2e_tools.py`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Helpers for the Windows desktop end to end (docs/testing/windows-desktop-e2e.md), run on the Mac as
`python3 -I e2e_tools.py <command>`. Standard library only. desktop-e2e.sh calls them; test_e2e_tools.py pins them.

  redact                                     stdin to stdout: ids to their short form; no email, token or Mac path
  args-b64 <Name>=<value> ...                a script's parameters as base64 JSON, for invoke.ps1 and session-run.ps1
  zip-info <zip>                             version, arch, and whether the app folder has harness-desktop.exe
  zip-variant <no-exe|no-start> <zip> <version> --out-dir <dir>   a broken build made from a good zip
  truncate <zip> --out-dir <dir>             the first half of the zip: a download cut short
  layout <version> <arch>                    where staging keeps a desktop zip and the manifest, as name=value lines
  verify <manifest.json> <arch> <zip>        the zip against the manifest's entry for it
  cdn-stage <root> <arch>=<zip>[@<claimed zip>] ...   the fake CDN's desktop objects and manifest
  compare-runs <base> <head>                 the desktop suite, test by test (test-desktop.py receipts or JSON logs)
"""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

CDN_HOST = 'cdn.autonomous.ai'
STORAGE_BASE = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/s3-autonomous-upgrade-3'
STAGING_PREFIX = 'harness/staging/desktop'
EXE = 'harness-desktop.exe'
ARCHES = ('x64', 'arm64')
ZIP_NAME = re.compile(r'^harness-desktop-(?P<version>.+)-windows-(?P<arch>x64|arm64)\.zip$')
VERSION = re.compile(r'^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z]+)*)?$')
# What each broken build lacks: no executable (the launcher's first rollback case), or the AOT snapshot, so the
# runner exits at once and never draws a frame (the "two starts within 10 s without .started" case).
DROPS = {'no-exe': EXE, 'no-start': 'data/app.so'}

# --- redaction --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Order matters: whole credentials first, then emails, then ids. A short id keeps its first 8 characters, as the
# CLI's own output and windows-cli-e2e.md write them.
_RULES = [
    (re.compile(r'(?i)(x-harness-(?:auth|proof):)\s*\S+'), r'\1 <redacted>'),
    (re.compile(r'(?i)\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+'), 'Bearer <token>'),
    (re.compile(r'\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'), '<token>'),
    (re.compile(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b'), '<email>'),
    (re.compile(r'(?i)\b([0-9a-f]{8})-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b'), r'\1…'),
    (re.compile(r'\bS-1-5-21-\d+-\d+-\d+-(\d+)\b'), r'S-1-5-21-…-\1'),
    (re.compile(r'(?i)\b([0-9a-f]{8})[0-9a-f]{24,}\b'), r'\1…'),
]


def redact(text, home=None):
    """[text] fit for the public evidence: no credential, no email, ids short, the Mac's home written `~`."""
    for pattern, replacement in _RULES:
        text = pattern.sub(replacement, text)
    home = str(Path.home()) if home is None else home
    if home and home != '/':
        text = text.replace(home, '~')
    return text


# --- parameters for the VM-side scripts ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_ARG_NAME = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')


def args_b64(pairs):
    """`Name=value` pairs as base64 of a JSON object. A value starting with [ or { is JSON (an array parameter)."""
    params = {}
    for pair in pairs:
        name, sep, value = pair.partition('=')
        if not sep or not _ARG_NAME.match(name):
            raise ValueError(f'expected <Name>=<value>: {pair}')
        if name in params:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} is given twice')
        params[name] = json.loads(value) if value[:1] in ('[', '{') else value
    return base64.b64encode(json.dumps(params, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')


# --- zips ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _norm(name):
    return name.replace('\\', '/')


def zip_info(path):
    """What a desktop zip holds (the install layout: Harness.exe, Harness.ico, current, app\\<ver>\\)."""
    path = Path(path)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        infos = zf.infolist()
        entries = {_norm(i.filename): i for i in infos}
        if 'current' not in entries:
            raise ValueError(f'{path.name} has no current pointer at its root')
        raw = zf.read(entries['current'])
        backslashes = any('\\' in i.filename for i in infos)
    version = raw.decode('utf-8-sig').strip()
    if not VERSION.match(version):
        raise ValueError(f'{path.name}: current names {version!r}, not a version')
    folders = sorted({n.split('/')[1] for n in entries if n.startswith('app/') and len(n.split('/')) > 2 and n.split('/')[1]})
    match = ZIP_NAME.match(path.name)
    return {
        'file': path.name,
        'version': version,
        'name_version': match['version'] if match else None,
        'arch': match['arch'] if match else None,
        'app_folders': folders,
        'has_launcher': 'Harness.exe' in entries,
        'has_exe': f'app/{version}/{EXE}' in entries,
        'current_bom': raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'),
        'backslashes': backslashes,
        'entries': len(infos),
    }


def zip_variant(kind, src, version, out_dir):
    """A broken build at [version] made from a good zip: its app folder renamed and `current` rewritten (a version
    cannot be restamped without a build, and the updater takes only a strictly newer one), minus DROPS[kind]."""
    if kind not in DROPS:
        raise ValueError(f'the kind is one of {", ".join(sorted(DROPS))}: {kind}')
    if not VERSION.match(version):
        raise ValueError(f'not a version: {version}')
    info = zip_info(src)
    if not info['arch']:
        raise ValueError(f'{Path(src).name} is not named harness-desktop-<version>-windows-<arch>.zip')
    old = info['version']
    if version == old:
        raise ValueError('a broken build needs another version than the good one it is made from')
    dst = Path(out_dir) / f'harness-desktop-{version}-windows-{info["arch"]}.zip'
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    was, now = f'app/{old}/', f'app/{version}/'
    drop = now + DROPS[kind]
    dropped = False
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(dst, 'w') as zout:
        for entry in zin.infolist():
            name = _norm(entry.filename)
            data = zin.read(entry)
            if name == 'current':
                text = data.decode('utf-8-sig')
                data = (version + ('\r\n' if text.endswith('\r\n') else '\n')).encode('utf-8')
            elif name.startswith(was):
                name = now + name[len(was):]
            if name == drop:
                dropped = True
                continue
            # The source's separator style is kept, so only the version and the dropped file differ.
            out = zipfile.ZipInfo(name.replace('/', '\\') if '\\' in entry.filename else name, date_time=entry.date_time)
            out.compress_type, out.external_attr, out.create_system = entry.compress_type, entry.external_attr, entry.create_system
            zout.writestr(out, data)
    if not dropped:
        dst.unlink()
        raise ValueError(f'{Path(src).name} has no {DROPS[kind]} in {was}: nothing to break')
    return dst


def truncate(src, out_dir):
    """The first half of [src]'s bytes, under the same name in [out_dir]: what a download cut short leaves."""
    src = Path(src)
    dst = Path(out_dir) / src.name
    if dst.resolve() == src.resolve():
        raise ValueError('the cut copy must go to another folder than its source')
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = src.read_bytes()
    dst.write_bytes(data[:len(data) // 2])
    return dst


# --- staging and the fake CDN --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _prefix():
    return os.environ.get('STAGING_DESKTOP_PREFIX', STAGING_PREFIX).strip('/')


def layout(version, arch):
    """Where the staging release keeps a zip, and the manifest an app built for staging reads."""
    if arch not in ARCHES:
        raise ValueError(f'the arch is x64 or arm64: {arch}')
    if not VERSION.match(version):
        raise ValueError(f'not a version: {version}')
    base = _prefix()
    name = f'harness-desktop-{version}-windows-{arch}.zip'
    obj = f'{base}/{version}/{name}'
    manifest = f'{base}/metadata.json'
    return {
        'zip_name': name, 'zip_object': obj, 'zip_url': f'https://{CDN_HOST}/{obj}',
        'manifest_object': manifest, 'manifest_url': f'{STORAGE_BASE}/{manifest}', 'manifest_key': f'desktop-windows-{arch}',
    }


def verify(manifest, arch, zip_path):
    """(ok, sentence): a zip of the version the manifest offers must have its sha256 and size."""
    key = f'desktop-windows-{arch}'
    entry = (manifest or {}).get(key)
    info = zip_info(zip_path)
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return True, f'the manifest offers no {key}: {info["file"]} is not checked against it'
    if entry.get('version') != info['version']:
        return True, f'the manifest offers {key} {entry.get("version")}, not {info["version"]}: not checked against it'
    body = Path(zip_path).read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
    problems = [what for what, same in (('sha256', sha == entry.get('sha256')), ('size', len(body) == entry.get('size'))) if not same]
    if problems:
        return False, f'{info["file"]} does not match {key} {info["version"]}: {", ".join(problems)} differ'
    return True, f'{info["file"]} matches {key} {info["version"]} (sha256 {sha[:8]}…, {len(body)} bytes)'


def cdn_stage(root, specs):
    """Lay out the fake CDN's desktop folder under [root] and its manifest. Each spec is `<arch>=<served>` or
    `<arch>=<served>@<claimed>`: the manifest names the claimed zip's version, sha256 and size, and the served bytes
    are what a download gets (a cut copy of the claimed zip, for the download check). The folder is emptied first."""
    root = Path(root)
    base = _prefix()
    if (root / base).exists():
        shutil.rmtree(root / base)
    manifest = {}
    for spec in specs:
        arch, sep, rest = spec.partition('=')
        if not sep or arch not in ARCHES or not rest:
            raise ValueError(f'expected <arch>=<zip>[@<claimed zip>]: {spec}')
        served, _, claimed = rest.partition('@')
        claimed = claimed or served
        key = f'desktop-windows-{arch}'
        if key in manifest:
            raise ValueError(f'{key} is given twice')
        info = zip_info(claimed)
        where = layout(info['version'], arch)
        target = root / where['zip_object']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(served, target)
        body = Path(claimed).read_bytes()
        manifest[key] = {'version': info['version'], 'url': where['zip_url'], 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), 'size': len(body)}
    out = root / f'{base}/metadata.json'
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    return manifest


# --- the desktop suite, test by test -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _logs(path):
    path = Path(path)
    if path.suffix != '.json':
        return None, [path]
    receipt = json.loads(path.read_text())
    logs = []
    for check in receipt.get('checks', []):
        log = Path(check.get('log', ''))
        if not log.is_file():
            log = path.parent / log.name
        if not log.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f'{path}: the log of {check.get("name")} is missing')
        logs.append(log)
    return receipt.get('desktop_root'), logs


def _relative(path, root):
    path = str(path)
    if root and path.startswith(root.rstrip('/') + '/'):
        return path[len(root.rstrip('/')) + 1:]
    at = path.rfind('/desktop/')
    return path[at + len('/desktop/'):] if at >= 0 else path


def test_results(path):
    """{(file under desktop/, test name): pass | fail | skip | incomplete}. A later log (the loader retry) replaces an
    earlier one's results. Hidden passing tests (a file's loading, setUpAll) are not tests; a hidden failure is."""
    root, logs = _logs(path)
    results = {}
    for log in logs:
        suites, tests, seen = {}, {}, {}
        for line in log.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
            try:
                event = json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not isinstance(event, dict):
                continue
            kind = event.get('type')
            if kind == 'suite':
                suites[event['suite']['id']] = _relative(event['suite']['path'], root)
            elif kind == 'testStart':
                test = event['test']
                name = test.get('name', '')
                name = '<loading>' if name.startswith('loading ') else name
                key = (suites.get(test.get('suiteID'), '?'), name)
                seen[key] = seen.get(key, 0) + 1
                if seen[key] > 1:
                    key = (key[0], f'{name} #{seen[key]}')
                tests[test['id']] = key
                results[key] = 'incomplete'
            elif kind == 'testDone':
                key = tests.get(event.get('testID'))
                if key is None:
                    continue
                if event.get('hidden') and event.get('result') == 'success':
                    results.pop(key, None)
                    continue
                results[key] = 'skip' if event.get('skipped') else ('pass' if event.get('result') == 'success' else 'fail')
    return results


def _summary(results):
    files = len({file for file, _ in results})
    count = lambda what: sum(1 for r in results.values() if r == what)  # noqa: E731
    return (f'{len(results)} tests in {files} files: {count("pass")} passed, {count("fail")} failed, '
            f'{count("skip")} skipped, {count("incomplete")} incomplete')


def compare_runs(base_path, head_path):
    """(exit code, report). A regression is a test that fails in head and did not in base, including a new test
    that fails. A removed test is listed for the reviewer (a rename shows as one removed and one new), not failed."""
    base, head = test_results(base_path), test_results(head_path)
    bad = lambda result: result in ('fail', 'incomplete')  # noqa: E731
    newly = sorted(k for k, r in head.items() if bad(r) and not bad(base.get(k, 'pass')))
    still = sorted(k for k, r in head.items() if k in base and bad(base[k]) and bad(r))
    fixed = sorted(k for k, r in head.items() if k in base and bad(base[k]) and not bad(r))
    added = sorted(k for k in head if k not in base)
    removed = sorted(k for k in base if k not in head)
    lines = [f'base: {_summary(base)}', f'head: {_summary(head)}']

    def section(title, keys, note=lambda key: ''):
        lines.append(f'{title}: {len(keys)}')
        lines.extend(f'  {file} :: {name}{note((file, name))}' for file, name in keys)

    section('newly failing (passing, skipped or absent in base)', newly, lambda k: f'  (base: {base.get(k, "absent")})')
    section('still failing (failing in base too)', still)
    section('fixed (failing in base, passing in head)', fixed)
    section('new tests', added, lambda k: f'  ({head[k]})')
    section('removed tests (a rename shows as one removed and one new)', removed, lambda k: f'  (base: {base[k]})')
    lines.append('verdict: ' + ('REGRESSIONS' if newly else 'no regressions'))
    return (1 if newly else 0), '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'


# --- command line ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    sub.add_parser('redact')
    sub.add_parser('args-b64').add_argument('pairs', nargs='*')
    sub.add_parser('zip-info').add_argument('zip')
    p = sub.add_parser('zip-variant')
    p.add_argument('kind', choices=sorted(DROPS))
    p.add_argument('zip')
    p.add_argument('version')
    p.add_argument('--out-dir', required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser('truncate')
    p.add_argument('zip')
    p.add_argument('--out-dir', required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser('layout')
    p.add_argument('version')
    p.add_argument('arch', choices=ARCHES)
    p = sub.add_parser('verify')
    p.add_argument('manifest')
    p.add_argument('arch', choices=ARCHES)
    p.add_argument('zip')
    p = sub.add_parser('cdn-stage')
    p.add_argument('root')
    p.add_argument('specs', nargs='+')
    p = sub.add_parser('compare-runs')
    p.add_argument('base')
    p.add_argument('head')
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == 'redact':
            sys.stdin.reconfigure(errors='replace')
            for line in sys.stdin:
                sys.stdout.write(redact(line))
                sys.stdout.flush()
        elif args.command == 'args-b64':
            print(args_b64(args.pairs))
        elif args.command == 'zip-info':
            print(json.dumps(zip_info(args.zip), indent=2))
        elif args.command == 'zip-variant':
            dst = zip_variant(args.kind, args.zip, args.version, args.out_dir)
            print(dst)
            print(json.dumps(zip_info(dst), indent=2))
        elif args.command == 'truncate':
            dst = truncate(args.zip, args.out_dir)
            print(f'{dst} ({dst.stat().st_size} of {Path(args.zip).stat().st_size} bytes)')
        elif args.command == 'layout':
            for name, value in layout(args.version, args.arch).items():
                print(f'{name}={value}')
        elif args.command == 'verify':
            ok, sentence = verify(json.loads(Path(args.manifest).read_text()), args.arch, args.zip)
            print(sentence)
            return 0 if ok else 1
        elif args.command == 'cdn-stage':
            print(json.dumps(cdn_stage(args.root, args.specs), indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        elif args.command == 'compare-runs':
            code, report = compare_runs(args.base, args.head)
            sys.stdout.write(report)
            return code
        return 0
    except (ValueError, OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
        print(f'error: {error}', file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
```


Expected: `Ran 23 tests`, `OK`.

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the VM-side scripts**

All of them are Windows PowerShell 5.1, ASCII only (5.1 reads a BOM-less file as ANSI, so a non-ASCII character in a
script would be misread), and take every value through `invoke.ps1`, so no path passes cmd's or ssh's quoting.

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/invoke.ps1`:

```powershell
# invoke.ps1 -Script <file beside this one> [-ArgsB64 <base64 JSON object>]: run a script of this folder with the
# parameters desktop-e2e.sh encoded (e2e_tools.py args-b64), so no value passes through cmd's or ssh's quoting: a
# path with a space, an apostrophe, & or % reaches the script as it was typed. "true" and "false" become booleans
# (switches); a JSON array becomes an array parameter.
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Script, [string]$ArgsB64 = '')
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch { }
$target = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Script
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Output "no script $target"; exit 2 }
$params = @{}
if ($ArgsB64) {
  $object = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($ArgsB64)) | ConvertFrom-Json
  foreach ($p in $object.PSObject.Properties) {
    $value = $p.Value
    if ($value -is [string] -and $value -eq 'true') { $value = $true }
    elseif ($value -is [string] -and $value -eq 'false') { $value = $false }
    $params[$p.Name] = $value
  }
}
$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
& $target @params
exit $LASTEXITCODE
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/session-run.ps1`:

```powershell
# session-run.ps1 -User <name> -Script <file> [-ArgsB64 <b64>] [-TimeoutSec 120] [-NoWait] | -User <name> -Probe
# Run a script of the user's e2e folder (C:\Users\<name>\e2e) INSIDE that user's desktop session, as a one-shot
# scheduled task with an interactive logon: a GUI app it starts has a desktop, a screenshot sees the screen, and
# input reaches the windows. Run as an administrator (desktop-e2e.sh run). The user must be signed in at the desktop
# (desktop-e2e.sh session-on). No password is stored: an interactive task runs only in the existing session.
# The task starts hxrun.exe (compiled here once, a GUI program), which runs PowerShell with no console window, so
# nothing of the tooling flashes on the screen the run is checking. The output comes back on stdout, then the task is
# deleted. -NoWait leaves it running (keep-awake.ps1) and prints its name; cleanup.ps1 deletes those.
# -Probe only says whether the user has a desktop session (exit 0) or not (exit 3).
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$User,
  [string]$Script,
  [string]$ArgsB64 = '',
  [int]$TimeoutSec = 120,
  [switch]$NoWait,
  [switch]$Probe
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

function Get-DesktopSession([string]$Name) {
  foreach ($p in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='explorer.exe'")) {
    $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $p -MethodName GetOwner
    if ($owner.User -eq $Name) { return $p.SessionId }
  }
  return $null
}

$session = Get-DesktopSession $User
if ($Probe) {
  if ($null -ne $session) { Write-Output "$User has desktop session $session"; exit 0 }
  Write-Output "$User has no desktop session"; exit 3
}
if ($null -eq $session) { Write-Output "$User is not signed in at the desktop: run desktop-e2e.sh session-on first"; exit 3 }
if (-not $Script) { Write-Output 'usage: session-run.ps1 -User <name> -Script <file> [-ArgsB64 <b64>] [-TimeoutSec n] [-NoWait] | -Probe'; exit 2 }

$sid = (New-Object Security.Principal.NTAccount($User)).Translate([Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value
$profilePath = (Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile -Filter "SID='$sid'").LocalPath
$dir = Join-Path $profilePath 'e2e'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir $Script) -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Output "no script $Script in $dir (desktop-e2e.sh push copies them)"; exit 2 }

$hxrun = Join-Path $dir 'hxrun.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hxrun)) {
  Add-Type -OutputType WindowsApplication -OutputAssembly $hxrun -TypeDefinition @'
using System.Diagnostics;
public static class HxRun {
  // hxrun.exe <script.ps1>: Windows PowerShell with no console window; its exit code is passed back.
  public static int Main(string[] args) {
    var shell = System.Environment.ExpandEnvironmentVariables(@"%SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe");
    var start = new ProcessStartInfo(shell, "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"" + args[0] + "\"");
    start.UseShellExecute = false;
    start.CreateNoWindow = true;
    using (var p = Process.Start(start)) { p.WaitForExit(); return p.ExitCode; }
  }
}
'@
}

function Quote([string]$Text) { "'" + $Text.Replace("'", "''") + "'" }
$id = 'HxDesktopE2E-' + $User + '-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8)
$wrapper = Join-Path $dir "$id.ps1"
$out = Join-Path $dir "$id.out"
$done = Join-Path $dir "$id.done"
@"
`$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
`$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
`$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
`$code = 0
try {
  & $(Quote (Join-Path $dir 'invoke.ps1')) -Script $(Quote $Script) -ArgsB64 $(Quote $ArgsB64) *> $(Quote $out)
  `$code = `$LASTEXITCODE
} catch {
  "`$_" | Out-File -Append -LiteralPath $(Quote $out) -Encoding utf8
  `$code = 1
}
Set-Content -LiteralPath $(Quote $done) -Value `$code -Encoding ascii
"@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $wrapper -Encoding utf8

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $hxrun -Argument ('"' + $wrapper + '"')
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId "$env:COMPUTERNAME\$User" -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
$limit = if ($NoWait) { New-TimeSpan -Hours 8 } else { New-TimeSpan -Seconds ($TimeoutSec + 60) }
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -ExecutionTimeLimit $limit -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $id -Action $action -Principal $principal -Settings $settings | Out-Null
$keep = $false
$code = 124
try {
  Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $id
  if ($NoWait) { $keep = $true; Write-Output "started $id (left running; cleanup.ps1 deletes it)"; $code = 0; return }
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($TimeoutSec)
  $startBy = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(20)
  while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $done)) {
    if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName $id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "timed out after $TimeoutSec s: $Script"; break }
    if ((Get-Date) -gt $startBy -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out)) {
      Write-Output "the task did not start (last result $((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $id).LastTaskResult)): is $User signed in at the desktop?"
      break
    }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300
  }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $out) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $out }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $done) { $code = [int](Get-Content -LiteralPath $done -Raw).Trim() }
} finally {
  if (-not $keep) {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $id -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $wrapper, $out, $done -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
}
exit $code
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/winlogon.ps1`:

```powershell
# winlogon.ps1 -Enable -User <name> -PasswordB64 <b64> | -Disable | -Status
# Test only (B5.14's exception, kept to the tests): Winlogon signs <name> in at the next boot, so its desktop session
# exists (session-run.ps1 needs one). Run as an administrator. -Enable saves the values it changes in
# C:\ProgramData\harness-desktop-e2e\winlogon.json first, and refuses to run twice or when a DefaultPassword is
# already stored (somebody's real autologon: never copied, never touched). -Disable puts every value back exactly as
# it was (a value that did not exist is removed again) and removes DefaultPassword. desktop-e2e.sh session-on runs it
# as soon as the session is up, so the password is in the registry for one boot only.
param(
  [switch]$Enable,
  [switch]$Disable,
  [switch]$Status,
  [string]$User,
  [string]$PasswordB64,
  [string]$StateDir = (Join-Path $env:ProgramData 'harness-desktop-e2e')
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon'
$Names = @('AutoAdminLogon', 'DefaultUserName', 'DefaultDomainName', 'AutoLogonCount', 'ForceAutoLogon')
$StatePath = Join-Path $StateDir 'winlogon.json'

function Get-Snapshot {
  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Key
  $present = $item.GetValueNames()
  $values = [ordered]@{}
  foreach ($name in $Names) {
    if ($present -contains $name) { $values[$name] = [ordered]@{ kind = $item.GetValueKind($name).ToString(); value = [string]$item.GetValue($name) } }
    else { $values[$name] = $null }
  }
  $values['DefaultPassword'] = if ($present -contains 'DefaultPassword') { 'present' } else { $null }
  return $values
}

function Show-Snapshot($Snapshot) {
  foreach ($name in $Names + 'DefaultPassword') {
    $v = $Snapshot.$name
    if ($null -eq $v) { "$name : (absent)" } elseif ($v -is [string]) { "$name : $v" } else { "$name : '$($v.value)' ($($v.kind))" }
  }
}

$chosen = @($Enable, $Disable, $Status | Where-Object { $_ }).Count
if ($chosen -ne 1) { Write-Output 'usage: winlogon.ps1 -Enable -User <name> -PasswordB64 <b64> | -Disable | -Status'; exit 2 }

if ($Status) {
  Show-Snapshot (Get-Snapshot)
  Write-Output "set by this script: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath $StatePath)"
  exit 0
}

if ($Enable) {
  if (-not $User -or -not $PasswordB64) { throw 'usage: -Enable -User <name> -PasswordB64 <base64>' }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StatePath) { throw "Autologon is already set by this script ($StatePath): run -Disable first." }
  $before = Get-Snapshot
  if ($before['DefaultPassword']) { throw 'Winlogon already holds a DefaultPassword (a real autologon): this run does not touch it. Stop and ask the owner.' }
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $StateDir | Out-Null
  # The state first, so -Disable can undo a run that stopped halfway.
  $before | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath $StatePath -Encoding utf8
  $password = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($PasswordB64))
  Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name AutoAdminLogon -Value '1' -Type String
  Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name DefaultUserName -Value $User -Type String
  Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name DefaultDomainName -Value $env:COMPUTERNAME -Type String
  Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name DefaultPassword -Value $password -Type String
  foreach ($name in 'AutoLogonCount', 'ForceAutoLogon') { Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  Write-Output "autologon set for $User at the next boot. Before:"
  Show-Snapshot $before
  exit 0
}

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StatePath)) {
  $now = Get-Snapshot
  if ($now['DefaultPassword']) { Write-Output 'No state file, yet Winlogon holds a DefaultPassword: not this script''s, left alone.' }
  else { Write-Output 'Autologon was not set by this script: nothing to do.' }
  Show-Snapshot $now
  exit 0
}
$saved = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $StatePath | ConvertFrom-Json
Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name DefaultPassword -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
foreach ($name in $Names) {
  $v = $saved.$name
  if ($null -eq $v) { Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  else { Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $Key -Name $name -Value $v.value -Type $v.kind }
}
$now = Get-Snapshot
$same = ($now | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) -eq ($saved | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
Show-Snapshot $now
Write-Output "restored exactly: $same"
if ($same) {
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $StatePath -Force
  if (-not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $StateDir -Force)) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $StateDir -Force }
  exit 0
}
Write-Output "The state is kept in ${StatePath}: compare it with the values above."
exit 1
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/keep-awake.ps1`:

```powershell
# keep-awake.ps1 [-Stop] [-Hours 8]: keep this desktop session's display on, and so unlocked, for the run. Run in the
# session with session-run.ps1 -NoWait (it keeps running). A locked screen would turn the screenshots black and drop
# the input. No power setting changes: SetThreadExecutionState holds only while this process lives. -Stop ends it,
# through a stop file beside this script.
param([switch]$Stop, [int]$Hours = 8)
$stopFile = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'keep-awake.stop'
if ($Stop) { Set-Content -LiteralPath $stopFile -Value 'stop' -Encoding ascii; Write-Output 'keep-awake asked to stop'; exit 0 }
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stopFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Awake -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern uint SetThreadExecutionState(uint flags);'
# ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED | ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED
[HxE2E.Awake]::SetThreadExecutionState([uint32]2147483651) | Out-Null
$end = (Get-Date).AddHours($Hours)
while ((Get-Date) -lt $end -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stopFile)) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 }
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stopFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output 'keep-awake ended'
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/screenshot.ps1`:

```powershell
# screenshot.ps1 -Out <png> [-Window <process name>] [-Mask "x,y,w,h;x,y,w,h"]: the screen as this user sees it, run
# in the desktop session (session-run.ps1). Layered windows (toasts, menus) are captured too (CAPTUREBLT). -Window
# crops to that process's main window; -Mask paints black boxes (screen pixels) over anything that must not reach the
# public evidence: an email address, a machine name, a QR code or a sign-in code. A relative -Out is beside this script.
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Out, [string]$Window, [string]$Mask)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Shot -MemberDefinition @'
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct RECT { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr h, out RECT r);
'@
[HxE2E.Shot]::SetProcessDPIAware() | Out-Null
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing
if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Out)) { $Out = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot $Out }
$bounds = [System.Windows.Forms.SystemInformation]::VirtualScreen
if ($Window) {
  $p = Get-Process -Name $Window -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero } | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $p) { Write-Output "no window of ${Window}: the whole screen is taken" }
  else {
    $r = New-Object HxE2E.Shot+RECT
    [HxE2E.Shot]::GetWindowRect($p.MainWindowHandle, [ref]$r) | Out-Null
    $bounds = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle $r.Left, $r.Top, ($r.Right - $r.Left), ($r.Bottom - $r.Top)
  }
}
$bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $bounds.Width, $bounds.Height
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
$copy = [System.Drawing.CopyPixelOperation]::SourceCopy -bor [System.Drawing.CopyPixelOperation]::CaptureBlt
$graphics.CopyFromScreen($bounds.Left, $bounds.Top, 0, 0, $bitmap.Size, $copy)
if ($Mask) {
  foreach ($box in $Mask.Split(';')) {
    $n = @($box.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ })
    if ($n.Count -ne 4) { throw "a mask box is x,y,w,h: '$box'" }
    $graphics.FillRectangle([System.Drawing.Brushes]::Black, $n[0] - $bounds.Left, $n[1] - $bounds.Top, $n[2], $n[3])
  }
}
$graphics.Dispose()
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $Out) | Out-Null
$bitmap.Save($Out, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$bitmap.Dispose()
Write-Output "screenshot $Out ($($bounds.Width)x$($bounds.Height) at $($bounds.Left),$($bounds.Top)$(if ($Mask) { ", masked" }))"
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/input.ps1`:

```powershell
# input.ps1 [-Focus <process>] [-X <px> -Y <px> [-Right] [-Double]] [-Keys <SendKeys>] [-Text <text>]: a person's
# hands, in the desktop session (session-run.ps1): bring a window to the front, click at screen pixels, press keys
# (SendKeys syntax: ^v is Ctrl+V, ^+c Ctrl+Shift+C, {ENTER}, {ESC}), or type text as it is. In that order, each once.
param([string]$Focus, [int]$X = -1, [int]$Y = -1, [switch]$Right, [switch]$Double, [string]$Keys, [string]$Text, [int]$DelayMs = 250)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Input -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern void mouse_event(uint flags, uint dx, uint dy, uint data, UIntPtr extra);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool BringWindowToTop(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr h, int command);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsIconic(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, IntPtr pid);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool AttachThreadInput(uint from, uint to, bool attach);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll")] public static extern uint GetCurrentThreadId();
'@
[HxE2E.Input]::SetProcessDPIAware() | Out-Null
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms

if ($Focus) {
  $p = Get-Process -Name $Focus -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne [IntPtr]::Zero } | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $p) { Write-Output "no window of $Focus to bring to the front"; exit 1 }
  $h = $p.MainWindowHandle
  if ([HxE2E.Input]::IsIconic($h)) { [HxE2E.Input]::ShowWindow($h, 9) | Out-Null }
  # Windows gives the foreground only to the thread that has the input; attach to it for the call.
  $front = [HxE2E.Input]::GetWindowThreadProcessId([HxE2E.Input]::GetForegroundWindow(), [IntPtr]::Zero)
  $me = [HxE2E.Input]::GetCurrentThreadId()
  [HxE2E.Input]::AttachThreadInput($me, $front, $true) | Out-Null
  [HxE2E.Input]::BringWindowToTop($h) | Out-Null
  $ok = [HxE2E.Input]::SetForegroundWindow($h)
  [HxE2E.Input]::AttachThreadInput($me, $front, $false) | Out-Null
  Write-Output "front: $Focus (pid $($p.Id)) $ok"
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $DelayMs
}
if ($X -ge 0 -and $Y -ge 0) {
  [HxE2E.Input]::SetCursorPos($X, $Y) | Out-Null
  $down, $up = if ($Right) { 0x0008, 0x0010 } else { 0x0002, 0x0004 }
  $times = if ($Double) { 2 } else { 1 }
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt $times; $i++) {
    [HxE2E.Input]::mouse_event($down, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
    [HxE2E.Input]::mouse_event($up, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 60
  }
  Write-Output "$(if ($Right) { 'right ' })$(if ($Double) { 'double ' })click at $X,$Y"
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $DelayMs
}
if ($Keys) { [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait($Keys); Write-Output "keys $Keys"; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $DelayMs }
if ($Text) {
  $escaped = -join ($Text.ToCharArray() | ForEach-Object { if ('+^%~(){}[]'.Contains([string]$_)) { '{' + $_ + '}' } else { [string]$_ } })
  [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait($escaped)
  Write-Output "typed $($Text.Length) characters"
}
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/uia.ps1`:

```powershell
# uia.ps1 [-Root App|Tray|Toasts|Menu|All] [-Process harness-desktop] [-Find <name, wildcards>] [-Type <ControlType>]
#         [-Do List|Exists|Rect|Invoke|Click|RightClick] [-Depth 14] [-TimeoutSec 10]
# Windows UI Automation, run in the desktop session (session-run.ps1): what a screen reader sees, so a check finds a
# control by its name instead of by pixels. Roots: App, the windows of -Process (Flutter turns its semantics tree on
# when a UIA client first asks, so the first answer can be thin: -Find waits up to -TimeoutSec); Tray, the taskbar
# and its hidden-icons flyout; Toasts, the notification popups; Menu, an open Win32 popup menu (the tray icon's); All,
# every top-level window. List prints the tree, one element a line: type "name" [automation id] (x,y,w,h). The other
# actions take the first element whose name matches -Find (and whose type is -Type, if given): Exists (exit 0 or 1),
# Rect, Invoke (its Invoke, Toggle, SelectionItem or ExpandCollapse pattern, else a click), Click, RightClick.
param(
  [ValidateSet('App', 'Tray', 'Toasts', 'Menu', 'All')][string]$Root = 'App',
  [string]$Process = 'harness-desktop',
  [string]$Find,
  [string]$Type,
  [ValidateSet('List', 'Exists', 'Rect', 'Invoke', 'Click', 'RightClick')][string]$Do = 'List',
  [int]$Depth = 14,
  [int]$TimeoutSec = 10
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient, UIAutomationTypes
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Pointer -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetProcessDPIAware();
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern void mouse_event(uint flags, uint dx, uint dy, uint data, UIntPtr extra);
'@
[HxE2E.Pointer]::SetProcessDPIAware() | Out-Null
$AE = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]
$Scope = [System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]
$Any = [System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition
$Walker = [System.Windows.Automation.TreeWalker]::ControlViewWalker

function Get-Roots {
  $top = @($AE::RootElement.FindAll($Scope::Children, $Any))
  switch ($Root) {
    'App' {
      $ids = @(Get-Process -Name $Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Id })
      return @($top | Where-Object { $ids -contains $_.Current.ProcessId })
    }
    'Tray' { return @($top | Where-Object { @('Shell_TrayWnd', 'NotifyIconOverflowWindow', 'TopLevelWindowForOverflowXamlIsland') -contains $_.Current.ClassName }) }
    'Toasts' { return @($top | Where-Object { $_.Current.ClassName -eq 'Windows.UI.Core.CoreWindow' -and $_.Current.Name -like '*notification*' }) }
    'Menu' { return @($top | Where-Object { $_.Current.ClassName -eq '#32768' }) }
    default { return $top }
  }
}

function Describe($Element) {
  $c = $Element.Current
  $r = $c.BoundingRectangle
  $box = if ($r.IsEmpty -or [double]::IsInfinity($r.Width)) { '' } else { '({0},{1},{2},{3})' -f [int]$r.X, [int]$r.Y, [int]$r.Width, [int]$r.Height }
  '{0} "{1}" [{2}] {3}' -f $c.ControlType.ProgrammaticName.Replace('ControlType.', ''), $c.Name, $c.AutomationId, $box
}

function Show-Tree($Element, [string]$Indent, [int]$Left) {
  try { Write-Output ($Indent + (Describe $Element)) } catch { return }
  if ($Left -le 0) { return }
  $child = $Walker.GetFirstChild($Element)
  while ($null -ne $child) {
    Show-Tree $child ($Indent + '  ') ($Left - 1)
    $child = $Walker.GetNextSibling($child)
  }
}

function Find-First {
  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($TimeoutSec)
  do {
    foreach ($r in Get-Roots) {
      foreach ($e in @($r) + @($r.FindAll($Scope::Descendants, $Any))) {
        try {
          $c = $e.Current
          if ($c.Name -like $Find -and (-not $Type -or $c.ControlType.ProgrammaticName -eq "ControlType.$Type")) { return $e }
        } catch { }
      }
    }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
  } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)
  return $null
}

function Click-At($Element, [switch]$RightButton) {
  $r = $Element.Current.BoundingRectangle
  $x = [int]($r.X + $r.Width / 2)
  $y = [int]($r.Y + $r.Height / 2)
  [HxE2E.Pointer]::SetCursorPos($x, $y) | Out-Null
  $down, $up = if ($RightButton) { 0x0008, 0x0010 } else { 0x0002, 0x0004 }
  [HxE2E.Pointer]::mouse_event($down, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
  [HxE2E.Pointer]::mouse_event($up, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
  Write-Output "$(if ($RightButton) { 'right-' })clicked $x,$y"
}

if ($Do -eq 'List') {
  $roots = @(Get-Roots)
  if (-not $roots.Count) { Write-Output "no $Root window"; exit 1 }
  foreach ($r in $roots) { Show-Tree $r '' $Depth }
  exit 0
}
if (-not $Find) { Write-Output "-Do $Do needs -Find <name>"; exit 2 }
$element = Find-First
if ($null -eq $element) { Write-Output "not found: `"$Find`"$(if ($Type) { " ($Type)" }) in $Root"; exit 1 }
Write-Output ('found ' + (Describe $element))
switch ($Do) {
  'Exists' { exit 0 }
  'Rect' { exit 0 }
  'Click' { Click-At $element; exit 0 }
  'RightClick' { Click-At $element -RightButton; exit 0 }
  'Invoke' {
    $patterns = @(
      [System.Windows.Automation.InvokePattern]::Pattern,
      [System.Windows.Automation.TogglePattern]::Pattern,
      [System.Windows.Automation.SelectionItemPattern]::Pattern,
      [System.Windows.Automation.ExpandCollapsePattern]::Pattern)
    foreach ($p in $patterns) {
      $pattern = $null
      if ($element.TryGetCurrentPattern($p, [ref]$pattern)) {
        switch ($pattern.GetType().Name) {
          'InvokePattern' { $pattern.Invoke() }
          'TogglePattern' { $pattern.Toggle() }
          'SelectionItemPattern' { $pattern.Select() }
          'ExpandCollapsePattern' { $pattern.Expand() }
        }
        Write-Output "invoked ($($pattern.GetType().Name))"
        exit 0
      }
    }
    Click-At $element
    exit 0
  }
}
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/watch-windows.ps1`:

```powershell
# watch-windows.ps1 [-Seconds 90] [-Probe]: every top-level window that appears in this desktop session while it runs,
# with its process and that process's parents. Run in the session (session-run.ps1, with RUN_TIMEOUT above -Seconds).
# The check is "no console window may flash": a CONSOLE line is a console or terminal window, and a FLASH line is one
# whose process descends from harness-desktop.exe or Harness.exe. Event-driven (EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW), so a window shown
# for one frame is still seen. -Probe starts a console of its own once hooked and says whether it was seen: the
# detector's positive control.
param([int]$Seconds = 90, [switch]$Probe)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
public static class HxWatch {
  delegate void WinEventProc(IntPtr hook, uint ev, IntPtr hwnd, int idObject, int idChild, uint thread, uint time);
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] struct MSG { public IntPtr hwnd; public uint message; public IntPtr wParam; public IntPtr lParam; public uint time; public int x; public int y; }
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] struct PROCESSENTRY32 {
    public uint dwSize; public uint cntUsage; public uint th32ProcessID; public IntPtr th32DefaultHeapID; public uint th32ModuleID;
    public uint cntThreads; public uint th32ParentProcessID; public int pcPriClassBase; public uint dwFlags;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst = 260)] public string szExeFile;
  }
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern IntPtr SetWinEventHook(uint min, uint max, IntPtr module, WinEventProc proc, uint pid, uint tid, uint flags);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool UnhookWinEvent(IntPtr hook);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool PeekMessage(out MSG m, IntPtr h, uint min, uint max, uint remove);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool TranslateMessage(ref MSG m);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern IntPtr DispatchMessage(ref MSG m);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern IntPtr GetAncestor(IntPtr h, uint flags);
  [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int GetClassName(IntPtr h, StringBuilder s, int n);
  [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int GetWindowText(IntPtr h, StringBuilder s, int n);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, out uint pid);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern IntPtr CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(uint flags, uint pid);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, EntryPoint = "Process32FirstW")] static extern bool Process32First(IntPtr snap, ref PROCESSENTRY32 e);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, EntryPoint = "Process32NextW")] static extern bool Process32Next(IntPtr snap, ref PROCESSENTRY32 e);
  [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr h);

  static Dictionary<uint, KeyValuePair<uint, string>> Processes() {
    var all = new Dictionary<uint, KeyValuePair<uint, string>>();
    IntPtr snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(2, 0);   // TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS
    var e = new PROCESSENTRY32();
    e.dwSize = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(PROCESSENTRY32));
    if (Process32First(snap, ref e)) {
      do { all[e.th32ProcessID] = new KeyValuePair<uint, string>(e.th32ParentProcessID, e.szExeFile); } while (Process32Next(snap, ref e));
    }
    CloseHandle(snap);
    return all;
  }

  // "name(pid) < parent(pid) < ..." while the process lives, at most eight levels.
  public static string Chain(uint pid) {
    var all = Processes();
    var parts = new List<string>();
    for (int level = 0; level < 8; level++) {
      KeyValuePair<uint, string> p;
      if (!all.TryGetValue(pid, out p)) { parts.Add("(" + pid + ", exited)"); break; }
      parts.Add(p.Value + "(" + pid + ")");
      if (p.Key == 0 || p.Key == pid) break;
      pid = p.Key;
    }
    return string.Join(" < ", parts.ToArray());
  }

  static List<string> seen;
  static WinEventProc keep;

  public static List<string> Run(int milliseconds, bool probe) {
    seen = new List<string>();
    keep = delegate (IntPtr hook, uint ev, IntPtr h, int idObject, int idChild, uint thread, uint time) {
      if (idObject != 0 || h == IntPtr.Zero || GetAncestor(h, 2) != h) return;   // OBJID_WINDOW, top-level (GA_ROOT)
      var cls = new StringBuilder(256);
      GetClassName(h, cls, 256);
      var title = new StringBuilder(256);
      GetWindowText(h, title, 256);
      uint pid;
      GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, out pid);
      seen.Add(DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss.fff") + "\t" + cls + "\t" + Chain(pid) + "\t" + title);
    };
    IntPtr hookHandle = SetWinEventHook(0x8002, 0x8002, IntPtr.Zero, keep, 0, 0, 0);   // EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, out of context
    if (probe) System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe", "/c ping -n 3 127.0.0.1 >nul");
    var end = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMilliseconds(milliseconds);
    MSG m;
    while (DateTime.UtcNow < end) {
      while (PeekMessage(out m, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, 1)) { TranslateMessage(ref m); DispatchMessage(ref m); }
      Thread.Sleep(5);
    }
    UnhookWinEvent(hookHandle);
    return seen;
  }
}
'@
$consoleClasses = @('ConsoleWindowClass', 'CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS', 'PseudoConsoleWindow')
Write-Output "watching for $Seconds s from $((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss.fff'))"
$lines = [HxWatch]::Run($Seconds * 1000, [bool]$Probe)
$consoles = 0
$flashes = 0
foreach ($line in $lines) {
  $class = $line.Split("`t")[1]
  $tag = 'WINDOW'
  if ($consoleClasses -contains $class) {
    $consoles++
    $tag = 'CONSOLE'
    # The app is harness-desktop.exe and its launcher Harness.exe (capital H); the CLI's bin\harness.exe is not it.
    if ($line -match '(?i)harness-desktop\.exe\(' -or $line -cmatch 'Harness\.exe\(') { $flashes++; $tag = 'FLASH' }
  }
  Write-Output "$tag`t$line"
}
Write-Output "windows shown: $($lines.Count); console windows: $consoles; from Harness: $flashes"
if ($Probe) { Write-Output "probe: $(if ($consoles -gt 0) { 'seen' } else { 'NOT seen: the detector missed a console window' })" }
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/start-app.ps1`:

```powershell
# start-app.ps1 -Path <exe or .lnk> [-ArgumentList <args>] | -Url <link> | -Report   [-Repeat 1] [-WaitSec 60] [-NoWait]
# Start Harness in the desktop session as a person would (session-run.ps1): -Path runs a program or shortcut (the
# zip's Harness.exe, the installed launcher, the Start Menu shortcut; %VARS% are expanded, a relative path is under
# %USERPROFILE%); -Url opens a link through the shell, the way a browser hands harness:// to Windows. -Repeat starts it
# that many times 300 ms apart (a second launch while the first is starting). Then it waits for a Harness window and
# says what runs. -Report only says what runs: each harness-desktop.exe and Harness.exe with its start time, path and
# visible windows.
param([string]$Path, [string[]]$ArgumentList = @(), [string]$Url, [switch]$Report, [int]$Repeat = 1, [int]$WaitSec = 60, [switch]$NoWait)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Windows -MemberDefinition @'
public delegate bool EnumProc(IntPtr h, IntPtr l);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumProc f, IntPtr l);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, out uint pid);
[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] public static extern int GetWindowText(IntPtr h, System.Text.StringBuilder s, int n);
public static System.Collections.Generic.List<string> Visible(uint pid) {
  var list = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
  EnumWindows(delegate (IntPtr h, IntPtr l) {
    uint p;
    GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, out p);
    if (p == pid && IsWindowVisible(h)) {
      var t = new System.Text.StringBuilder(256);
      GetWindowText(h, t, 256);
      if (t.Length > 0) list.Add(t.ToString());
    }
    return true;
  }, IntPtr.Zero);
  return list;
}
'@

function Show-Running {
  $all = @(Get-Process -Name 'harness-desktop', 'Harness' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
  if (-not $all.Count) { Write-Output 'running: no harness-desktop.exe or Harness.exe' }
  foreach ($p in $all) {
    $windows = @([HxE2E.Windows]::Visible([uint32]$p.Id))
    Write-Output ('running: {0} pid {1} since {2:HH:mm:ss} {3} windows {4} {5}' -f $p.ProcessName, $p.Id, $p.StartTime, $p.Path, $windows.Count, (($windows | ForEach-Object { '"' + $_ + '"' }) -join ' '))
  }
  $apps = @($all | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -eq 'harness-desktop' })
  $visible = 0
  foreach ($p in $apps) { $visible += @([HxE2E.Windows]::Visible([uint32]$p.Id)).Count }
  Write-Output "harness-desktop.exe processes: $($apps.Count); visible windows: $visible"
}

if ($Report) { Show-Running; exit 0 }
if (-not $Url -and -not $Path) { Write-Output 'usage: start-app.ps1 -Path <exe> [-ArgumentList ...] | -Url <link> | -Report'; exit 2 }
if ($Path) {
  $Path = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($Path)
  if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Path)) { $Path = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $Path }
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { Write-Output "no such file: $Path"; exit 1 }
}
$t0 = Get-Date
for ($i = 1; $i -le [Math]::Max(1, $Repeat); $i++) {
  if ($Url) { Start-Process -FilePath $Url }
  elseif ($ArgumentList.Count) { Start-Process -FilePath $Path -ArgumentList $ArgumentList }
  else { Start-Process -FilePath $Path }
  if ($i -lt $Repeat) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }
}
Write-Output "started $(if ($Url) { $Url } else { "$Path $($ArgumentList -join ' ')" }) x$([Math]::Max(1, $Repeat)) at $($t0.ToString('HH:mm:ss.fff'))"
if ($NoWait) { exit 0 }
$up = @()
$deadline = $t0.AddSeconds($WaitSec)
do {
  $up = @(Get-Process -Name 'harness-desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { @([HxE2E.Windows]::Visible([uint32]$_.Id)).Count -gt 0 })
  if ($up.Count) { Write-Output ('a Harness window after {0:N1} s' -f ((Get-Date) - $t0).TotalSeconds); break }
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
} while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)
if (-not $up.Count) { Write-Output "no Harness window within $WaitSec s" }
Show-Running
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/clipboard.ps1`:

```powershell
# clipboard.ps1 -Image [-AsPng] | -Files <path>... | -Text <text> | -Read: put something on the clipboard as a person
# would copy it, in the desktop session (session-run.ps1; the clipboard belongs to the session). -Image draws a 480x270
# picture with a marker and the time and copies it as a bitmap (CF_DIB); -AsPng also offers the registered "PNG"
# format, the one Harness reads first. The picture is saved as shots\paste-source.png for the evidence. -Files copies
# files as Explorer does (CF_HDROP). -Read lists the formats now on the clipboard, and its text if any.
param([switch]$Image, [switch]$AsPng, [string[]]$Files, [string]$Text, [switch]$Read)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms, System.Drawing
if ([Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.ApartmentState -ne 'STA') { Write-Output 'the clipboard needs an STA thread (Windows PowerShell 5.1 runs STA)'; exit 2 }
if ($Image) {
  $bitmap = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap 480, 270
  $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bitmap)
  $g.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb(255, 32, 96, 160))
  $marker = 'HX_PASTE ' + (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')
  $g.DrawString($marker, (New-Object System.Drawing.Font 'Segoe UI', 28), [System.Drawing.Brushes]::White, 24, 100)
  $g.Dispose()
  $png = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'shots\paste-source.png'
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $png) | Out-Null
  $bitmap.Save($png, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
  $data = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.DataObject
  $data.SetImage($bitmap)
  if ($AsPng) { $data.SetData('PNG', $false, (New-Object IO.MemoryStream (, [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($png)))) }
  [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetDataObject($data, $true)
  Write-Output "clipboard: image '$marker' $(if ($AsPng) { '(PNG and bitmap)' } else { '(bitmap only)' })"
} elseif ($Files) {
  $list = New-Object System.Collections.Specialized.StringCollection
  foreach ($f in $Files) {
    $full = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($f)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full)) { Write-Output "no file $full"; exit 1 }
    [void]$list.Add((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $full).ProviderPath)
  }
  [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetFileDropList($list)
  Write-Output "clipboard: $($list.Count) file(s), as Explorer copies them"
} elseif ($Text) {
  [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::SetText($Text)
  Write-Output "clipboard: text, $($Text.Length) characters"
}
if ($Read -or -not ($Image -or $Files -or $Text)) {
  $now = [System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetDataObject()
  Write-Output "formats: $((@($now.GetFormats()) | Sort-Object) -join ', ')"
  if ($now.GetDataPresent('Text')) { Write-Output "text: $([System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetText())" }
}
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/browser-link.ps1`:

```powershell
# browser-link.ps1 -Url <harness://...>: a page holding that link, opened in Microsoft Edge in the desktop session
# (session-run.ps1), for the "a link opens from a browser" check. Clicking the link and Edge's "Open Harness?" prompt
# come next (uia.ps1 -Root All -Find 'Open in Harness' -Do Invoke, then -Find 'Open' -Type Button -Do Invoke), or a
# person does them. Edge's first-run pages are skipped where its flags allow.
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Url)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$page = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'link.html'
$safe = [Net.WebUtility]::HtmlEncode($Url)
"<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8><title>Harness link</title><p><a id=hx href=`"$safe`">Open in Harness</a></p>" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $page -Encoding utf8
$edge = @("${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe", "$env:ProgramFiles\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe") | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $edge) { Write-Output 'Microsoft Edge is not installed here'; exit 1 }
Start-Process -FilePath $edge -ArgumentList @('--no-first-run', '--no-default-browser-check', ('"' + ([Uri]$page).AbsoluteUri + '"'))
Write-Output "Edge opened $page, with a link to $Url"
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/stage-zip.ps1`:

```powershell
# stage-zip.ps1 -Zip <zip> -To <folder> [-MarkOfTheWeb]: extract a Harness zip where a person would, as the test user
# (over SSH or in the session). The folder may hold a space, an apostrophe, &, % or ! (Review Focus 1): invoke.ps1
# hands it over unparsed. A relative path is under %USERPROFILE%. The folder is emptied first. -MarkOfTheWeb marks the
# zip and every program in it as downloaded from the internet (Zone.Identifier, ZoneId 3), as Explorer's Extract All
# does with a browser download, so SmartScreen sees them as it sees a person's download.
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Zip, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$To, [switch]$MarkOfTheWeb)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$Zip = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($Zip)
$To = [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($To)
if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($Zip)) { $Zip = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $Zip }
if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($To)) { $To = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE $To }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Zip -PathType Leaf)) { Write-Output "no zip $Zip"; exit 1 }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $To) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $To -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $To | Out-Null
$zone = "[ZoneTransfer]`r`nZoneId=3`r`n"
if ($MarkOfTheWeb) { Set-Content -LiteralPath $Zip -Stream Zone.Identifier -Value $zone }
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory($Zip, $To)
if ($MarkOfTheWeb) {
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $To -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.exe', '.dll' } | ForEach-Object { Set-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Stream Zone.Identifier -Value $zone }
}
Write-Output "extracted to $To"
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $To | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Name)$(if ($_.PSIsContainer) { '\' })" }
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $To 'current'))
$bom = $bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF
Write-Output "current: '$([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes).Trim())' ($($bytes.Length) bytes, BOM $bom)"
Write-Output "files: $(@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $To -Recurse -File).Count); marked as downloaded: $([bool]$MarkOfTheWeb)"
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/desktop-state.ps1`:

```powershell
# desktop-state.ps1 [-InstallRoot <dir>]: what the Harness desktop app has put on this PC for this user, read-only, in
# the desktop session (desktop-e2e.sh state) or over SSH. The install folder and its pointers (bytes checked: one
# line, no BOM), each version folder (its executable, machine type, version resource and .started marker),
# launch.log's last lines, the harness:// key, the uninstall entry, the Start Menu shortcut (target and AUMID), the
# app's own state folder (present or not, never its contents), the sign-in's machine id, and the CLI pieces the app
# relies on. Nothing secret is printed: the daemon token by its size, the pipe by its name (redacted on the Mac).
param([string]$InstallRoot = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Harness'))
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'

function Read-Pointer([string]$Path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return '(absent)' }
  $b = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
  $bom = $b.Length -ge 3 -and $b[0] -eq 0xEF -and $b[1] -eq 0xBB -and $b[2] -eq 0xBF
  $text = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($b)
  $end = if ($text.EndsWith("`r`n")) { 'CRLF' } elseif ($text.EndsWith("`n")) { 'LF' } else { 'none' }
  $lines = @($text -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }).Count
  "'$($text.Trim())' ($($b.Length) bytes, BOM $bom, line end $end, lines $lines)"
}

function Get-Machine([string]$Exe) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Exe -PathType Leaf)) { return 'no executable' }
  $fs = [IO.File]::OpenRead($Exe)
  try {
    $r = New-Object IO.BinaryReader $fs
    $fs.Position = 0x3C
    $fs.Position = $r.ReadInt32() + 4
    switch ($r.ReadUInt16()) { 0x8664 { 'x64' } 0xAA64 { 'arm64' } 0x014C { 'x86' } default { 'unknown machine' } }
  } finally { $fs.Dispose() }
}

function Show-Key([string]$Path) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { "  $Path (absent)"; return }
  $k = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path
  foreach ($n in $k.GetValueNames()) {
    "  $Path : $(if ($n) { $n } else { '(default)' }) = '$($k.GetValue($n, $null, 'DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames'))' ($($k.GetValueKind($n)))"
  }
}

Write-Output "## install folder $InstallRoot"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $InstallRoot) {
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $InstallRoot -Force | ForEach-Object { "  $($_.Name)$(if ($_.PSIsContainer) { '\' } else { " ($($_.Length) bytes)" })" }
  Write-Output "current: $(Read-Pointer (Join-Path $InstallRoot 'current'))"
  Write-Output "previous: $(Read-Pointer (Join-Path $InstallRoot 'previous'))"
  $launcher = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'Harness.exe'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher) {
    $v = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $launcher).VersionInfo
    Write-Output "Harness.exe: $(Get-Machine $launcher), FileDescription '$($v.FileDescription)', ProductName '$($v.ProductName)'"
  }
  $apps = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'app'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $apps) {
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $apps -Force | ForEach-Object {
      $exe = Join-Path $_.FullName 'harness-desktop.exe'
      $started = Join-Path $_.FullName '.started'
      $info = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe) {
        $vi = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe).VersionInfo
        "$(Get-Machine $exe), ProductVersion $($vi.ProductVersion), FileDescription '$($vi.FileDescription)', ProductName '$($vi.ProductName)'"
      } else { 'no harness-desktop.exe' }
      $mark = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $started) { 'written ' + (Get-Item -LiteralPath $started -Force).LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss') } else { 'absent' }
      "app\$($_.Name): $info; .started $mark"
    }
  }
  $log = Join-Path $InstallRoot 'launch.log'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log) { Write-Output '## launch.log, last 15 lines'; Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Tail 15 | ForEach-Object { "  $_" } }
} else { Write-Output '  (absent)' }

Write-Output '## harness:// and the uninstall entry'
Show-Key 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\harness'
Show-Key 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\harness\shell\open\command'
Show-Key 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Harness'

$programs = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Programs')
$lnk = Join-Path $programs 'Harness.lnk'
Write-Output "## Start Menu shortcut $lnk"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lnk) {
  $s = (New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut($lnk)
  Write-Output "  target '$($s.TargetPath)' arguments '$($s.Arguments)'"
  try {
    $item = (New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Namespace($programs).ParseName('Harness.lnk')
    Write-Output "  AUMID '$($item.ExtendedProperty('System.AppUserModel.ID'))'"
  } catch { Write-Output "  AUMID not readable here: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
  foreach ($a in @(Get-StartApps -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'Harness' })) { Write-Output "  Start: '$($a.Name)' AppID '$($a.AppID)'" }
} else { Write-Output '  (absent)' }

$h = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.harness'
Write-Output "## $h (HOME is '$env:HOME')"
foreach ($d in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $h -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'desktop-app*' -or $_.Name -eq 'logs' })) {
  "  $($d.Name)\: $(@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d.FullName -Force).Count) entries"
}
$session = Join-Path $h 'auth\session.json'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $session) {
  # Only the machine id leaves session.json, never its tokens (as B's approve-qr.mts reads it).
  Write-Output "  signed in: machine $((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $session | ConvertFrom-Json).machineId)"
} else { Write-Output '  signed in: no (no auth\session.json)' }
Write-Output "  cli\current: $(Read-Pointer (Join-Path $h 'cli\current'))"
Write-Output "  runtime\current-node: $(Read-Pointer (Join-Path $h 'runtime\current-node'))"
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $h 'runtime\pty') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "  runtime\pty\$($_.Name)\harness-pty.exe: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'harness-pty.exe'))" }
Write-Output "  bin\harness.exe: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $h 'bin\harness.exe'))"
$data = if ($env:ADAPTER_DATA_DIR) { $env:ADAPTER_DATA_DIR } else { Join-Path $h 'cli\data' }
$record = Join-Path $data 'daemon-18473.json'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $record) {
  $r = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $record | ConvertFrom-Json
  Write-Output "  daemon-18473.json: port $($r.port), pipe $($r.pipe), core pid $($r.pid)"
} else { Write-Output '  daemon-18473.json: (absent)' }
$token = Join-Path $data 'daemon-token'
Write-Output "  daemon-token: $(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $token) { "$((Get-Item -LiteralPath $token).Length) bytes" } else { '(absent)' })"
Write-Output "  Harness tasks of this user: $(@(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -eq "Harness harnessd ($env:USERNAME)" }).Count)"
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/desktop-logs.ps1`:

```powershell
# desktop-logs.ps1 [-Log app|cli|errors|launch|daemon] [-Match <regex>] [-Tail 150]: the newest lines of one log the
# Harness desktop app or its daemon writes for this user, read-only (over SSH or in the session):
#   app     %USERPROFILE%\.harness\logs\app-YYYYMMDD.log, the app's narrative (app, ws, api, flutter)
#   cli     %USERPROFILE%\.harness\logs\cli-YYYYMMDD.log, every child process the app ran, as a person reads it
#   errors  %USERPROFILE%\.harness\desktop-app*\errors.log, what threw
#   launch  %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Harness\launch.log, the launcher's starts and rollbacks
#   daemon  %USERPROFILE%\.harness\cli\data\harness.log, the CLI daemon's own log
# The app's state.json holds credentials and is never read here.
param([ValidateSet('app', 'cli', 'errors', 'launch', 'daemon')][string]$Log = 'app', [string]$Match, [int]$Tail = 150)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$h = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.harness'
$logs = Join-Path $h 'logs'
$file = switch ($Log) {
  'app' { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $logs -Filter 'app-*.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1 }
  'cli' { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $logs -Filter 'cli-*.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1 }
  'errors' {
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $h -Directory -Filter 'desktop-app*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
      ForEach-Object { Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.FullName 'errors.log') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } |
      Sort-Object LastWriteTime | Select-Object -Last 1
  }
  'launch' { Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Harness\launch.log') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
  'daemon' { Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $h 'cli\data\harness.log') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}
if ($env:HOME) { Write-Output "note: HOME is set ('$env:HOME'); the app must still use USERPROFILE ($env:USERPROFILE)" }
if (-not $file) { Write-Output "no $Log log yet"; exit 1 }
Write-Output "## $($file.FullName) ($($file.Length) bytes, written $($file.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss')))"
$lines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Encoding UTF8)
if ($Match) { $lines = @($lines | Select-String -Pattern $Match | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }) }
$lines | Select-Object -Last $Tail
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/desktop-procs.ps1`:

```powershell
# desktop-procs.ps1 -User <name>: the Harness processes of one local user, oldest first: the desktop app
# (harness-desktop.exe) and its launcher (Harness.exe), the CLI (harness.exe, node.exe), the terminal host with its
# consoles and shells, and engines. Run as an administrator: WMI answers a standard user only in a desktop or batch
# logon, never over SSH (B5.12).
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$User)
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process |
  Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(harness-desktop|harness|node|harness-pty|harness-launch|OpenConsole|conhost|powershell|pwsh|cmd|kilo)\.exe$' } |
  Where-Object { (Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $_ -MethodName GetOwner).User -eq $User } |
  Sort-Object CreationDate |
  Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, @{ n = 'Start'; e = { $_.CreationDate.ToString('HH:mm:ss') } }, @{ n = 'Cmd'; e = { $c = [string]$_.CommandLine; if ($c.Length -gt 120) { $c.Substring(0, 120) } else { $c } } } |
  Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/cleanup.ps1`:

```powershell
# cleanup.ps1 -User <name>: take the test user and everything the run left off the VM, as an administrator.
#  1. ends the user's processes, after signing its desktop session out;
#  2. deletes the run's scheduled tasks (HxDesktopE2E-<user>-*) and any Harness task of that user;
#  3. puts Winlogon back if winlogon.ps1 -Enable is still in force;
#  4. deletes the user and its profile, force-unloading its registry hives first if a service still holds them (B5.14);
#  5. says what is left: users, profiles, tasks, Winlogon, the fake CDN (hosts and CA), listeners on 1847x.
# Only a test user (hx followed by letters or digits, not an administrator) is removed. C:\work\e2e and the admin
# profile are never opened.
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$User)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
if ($User -notmatch '^hx[a-z0-9]*$') { Write-Output "refusing: '$User' is not a test user's name (hx...)"; exit 2 }
$account = Get-LocalUser -Name $User -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$sid = $null
$profilePath = $null
if ($account) {
  $admins = @(Get-LocalGroupMember -Group Administrators -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Name.Split('\')[-1] })
  if ($admins -contains $User) { Write-Output "refusing: $User is an administrator"; exit 2 }
  $sid = $account.SID.Value
  $profilePath = (Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile -Filter "SID='$sid'").LocalPath
} else { Write-Output "no user $User" }

function Get-Owned { @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { (Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $_ -MethodName GetOwner -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).User -eq $User }) }

Write-Output '## 1. processes and the desktop session'
Add-Type -Namespace HxE2E -Name Session -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("wtsapi32.dll")] public static extern bool WTSLogoffSession(IntPtr server, int session, bool wait);'
foreach ($s in @(Get-Owned | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'explorer.exe' } | ForEach-Object { $_.SessionId } | Sort-Object -Unique)) {
  Write-Output "signing session $s out: $([HxE2E.Session]::WTSLogoffSession([IntPtr]::Zero, [int]$s, $true))"
}
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
foreach ($p in Get-Owned) { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
Write-Output "processes of $User left: $((Get-Owned).Count)"

Write-Output '## 2. tasks'
foreach ($t in @(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like "HxDesktopE2E-$User-*" -or $_.TaskName -eq "Harness harnessd ($User)" })) {
  Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath -Confirm:$false
  Write-Output "deleted task $($t.TaskPath)$($t.TaskName)"
}

Write-Output '## 3. Winlogon'
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'winlogon.ps1') -Disable

Write-Output '## 4. the user and its profile'
if ($account) { Remove-LocalUser -Name $User; Write-Output "user $User deleted" }
if ($sid) {
  $profile = Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile -Filter "SID='$sid'"
  if ($profile) {
    try { $profile | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output 'profile removed' }
    catch {
      Write-Output "profile removal failed: $($_.Exception.Message) Unloading its hives (REG_FORCE_UNLOAD), as B5.14 did."
      Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class HxHive {
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] struct UNICODE_STRING { public ushort Length; public ushort MaximumLength; public IntPtr Buffer; }
  [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] struct OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES { public int Length; public IntPtr RootDirectory; public IntPtr ObjectName; public uint Attributes; public IntPtr SecurityDescriptor; public IntPtr SecurityQualityOfService; }
  [DllImport("ntdll.dll")] static extern int NtUnloadKey2(ref OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES target, uint flags);
  [DllImport("ntdll.dll")] static extern int RtlAdjustPrivilege(int privilege, bool enable, bool thread, out bool previous);
  public static int ForceUnload(string path) {
    bool was;
    RtlAdjustPrivilege(17, true, false, out was);   // SeBackupPrivilege
    RtlAdjustPrivilege(18, true, false, out was);   // SeRestorePrivilege
    var name = new UNICODE_STRING();
    name.Length = (ushort)(path.Length * 2);
    name.MaximumLength = (ushort)(name.Length + 2);
    name.Buffer = Marshal.StringToHGlobalUni(path);
    IntPtr pName = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(UNICODE_STRING)));
    try {
      Marshal.StructureToPtr(name, pName, false);
      var attributes = new OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES();
      attributes.Length = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES));
      attributes.ObjectName = pName;
      attributes.Attributes = 0x40;   // OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE
      return NtUnloadKey2(ref attributes, 1);   // REG_FORCE_UNLOAD
    } finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(pName); Marshal.FreeHGlobal(name.Buffer); }
  }
}
'@
      foreach ($hive in "\Registry\User\$sid", "\Registry\User\${sid}_Classes") { Write-Output ('{0} -> 0x{1:X8}' -f $hive, [HxHive]::ForceUnload($hive)) }
      Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile -Filter "SID='$sid'" | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
  }
  if ($profilePath) { Write-Output "$profilePath exists: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath $profilePath)" }
  Write-Output "ProfileList key exists: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList\$sid")"
}

Write-Output "## 5. what is left ($((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')))"
Write-Output "local users: $((Get-LocalUser | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ', ')"
Write-Output "folders in C:\Users: $((Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Users' -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ', ')"
$tasks = @(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'HxDesktopE2E-*' -or $_.TaskName -like 'Harness harnessd (*' })
Write-Output "run or Harness tasks left: $(if ($tasks.Count) { ($tasks | ForEach-Object { $_.TaskName }) -join ', ' } else { 'none' })"
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'winlogon.ps1') -Status
$cdn = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'vm-cdn.ps1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cdn) { & $cdn -Status }
Write-Output "listeners on 1847x: $(@(netstat -ano | Select-String 'LISTENING' | Select-String ':1847\d\s').Count)"
Write-Output "C:\work\e2e: not opened by this run (exists: $(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\work\e2e'))"
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/parse-check.ps1`:

```powershell
# parse-check.ps1: every .ps1 beside this one parses in this machine's Windows PowerShell 5.1, or its errors are listed.
$failed = 0
foreach ($f in Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PSScriptRoot -Filter *.ps1) {
  $tokens = $null
  $errors = $null
  [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($f.FullName, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors) | Out-Null
  if ($errors.Count) { $failed++; foreach ($e in $errors) { Write-Output "FAIL $($f.Name):$($e.Extent.StartLineNumber) $($e.Message)" } }
  else { Write-Output "ok   $($f.Name)" }
}
Write-Output "$failed file(s) with parse errors"
exit $failed
```

`desktop/scripts/windows-e2e/selftest.ps1`:

```powershell
# selftest.ps1: the session tools work on this machine before a scenario relies on them. Run in the desktop session
# (desktop-e2e.sh run selftest.ps1). One line per check, ok or FAIL; the exit code counts the failures.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$script:fail = 0
function Check([string]$What, [bool]$Ok, [string]$Detail = '') {
  if ($Ok) { Write-Output "ok   $What $Detail" } else { Write-Output "FAIL $What $Detail"; $script:fail++ }
}
$here = $PSScriptRoot
$shot = & (Join-Path $here 'screenshot.ps1') -Out 'shots\selftest.png'
$png = Join-Path $here 'shots\selftest.png'
Check 'screenshot' ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $png) -and (Get-Item -LiteralPath $png).Length -gt 10000) "$shot"
& (Join-Path $here 'clipboard.ps1') -Text 'HX_SELFTEST' | Out-Null
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Check 'clipboard text round trip' ([System.Windows.Forms.Clipboard]::GetText() -eq 'HX_SELFTEST')
& (Join-Path $here 'input.ps1') -X 40 -Y 40 | Out-Null
$pos = [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position
Check 'the pointer moves to screen pixels' ($pos.X -eq 40 -and $pos.Y -eq 40) "($($pos.X),$($pos.Y))"
$tray = @(& (Join-Path $here 'uia.ps1') -Root Tray -Do List -Depth 3)
Check 'UI Automation sees the taskbar' ((($tray | Out-String) -match 'Taskbar')) "$($tray.Count) elements"
$watch = @(& (Join-Path $here 'watch-windows.ps1') -Seconds 6 -Probe)
Check 'the console-window detector sees a console' ((($watch | Out-String) -match 'probe: seen'))
Write-Output "$($script:fail) check(s) failed"
exit $script:fail
```
